articleTitle: Research on Effective Asset Risk Assessment of Power Grid Enterprises Based on LBWA-Vague Set
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Controlling the risks faced by effective assets of power grid enterprises and enhancing the effective asset management capabilities are important issues for power grid enterprises to enhance their business sustainability under the new power system. This paper firstly establishes a risk evaluation index system for effective asset projects of power grid enterprises from three dimensions of regulation, operation, and compliance, which contains 17 three-level indicators, and then establishes a project risk evaluation model based on LBWA-Vague Set. Finally, an empirical analysis is conducted with an effective asset project of a power grid enterprise to verify the effectiveness of the proposed model, which can improve the risk prevention level and response capability of the power grid enterprise.

Author Keywords: effective asset of power grid enterprises

articleTitle: Comprehensive Cost-Benefit Assessment of Offshore Wind Power Based on Improved VIKOR Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For offshore wind power, the comprehensive cost-benefit assessment is the basis of planning and construction. Unreasonable planning will bring huge economic losses. In this regard, an improved VIKOR evaluation method integrating Vague set is proposed to evaluate the comprehensive cost-benefit of offshore wind power, including the life cycle cost, benefit from electricity sales, environment and carbon tax. First of all, a life cycle cost (LCC) model of offshore wind power is introduced to realize the separation of various cost, fully considering the impact of various cost indicators on the comprehensive cost-benefit of offshore wind power. Then, benefit indicators are established from the perspective of electricity sales, environment and carbon tax. On this basis, the improved VIKOR method is used to evaluate the offshore wind power schemes based on different grid connection modes, with the Vague set used to calculate index weight, and the optimal grid connection scheme is given. Finally, a typical offshore wind farm example is given to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed evaluation method.

articleTitle: Research on the Day-Ahead Dispatch Strategy for Multi-Energy Power Systems Considering Wind and PV Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The day-ahead dispatch strategy for multi-energy power systems can be used to schedule unit start-up and shutdown, units' output, and power flow. However, integrating wind and solar energy into the power system brings strong uncertainty, leading to deviations in traditional scheduling results. This paper research the day-ahead dispatch of the multi-energy power systems, including wind power, photovoltaics, thermal power, gas power, pumped storage, cluster electric vehicles, and other forms of power generation. Considering the physical characteristics of different forms of power generation and aiming for optimal system network security and operating economy, a multi-energy power system scheduling model was established. Finally, the commercial software package CPLEX was called using the MATLAB platform to complete mixed-integer programming optimization. The results show that the proposed day-ahead dispatch approach can achieve the optimal system operating cost and reduce the wind curtailment rate.

articleTitle: Systematic Controller Design for DFIG-Based Wind Turbines to Enhance Synchronous Stability During Weak Grid Fault
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Wind turbines are susceptible to synchronous instability during weak grid fault, due to the complex control loop coupling relationship. It is essential to design system control loops that can adapt to severe operating conditions. In this paper, in order to improve the synchronous stability of the doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) based wind turbines, the D-partition method is introduced to determine the stable region of the system. Then, multiple indexes such as dynamic performance and steady-state performance of the system are used as constraints to further divide the system parameter region. The results demonstrate that compared to traditional methods, the proposed method can accurately locate the stable parameter region of the system without repeated attempts, and can be presented in a specific graphical form. The simulation analysis verifies the accuracy of the theory.

articleTitle: The Distributed Coordinated Operation Strategies of Distribution Network and Multi-Micro Energy Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the proliferation of micro energy grids, the interactive operation issue between distribution network and micro energy grids has been a burning question. This paper proposes a coordinated operation model from the perspective of social welfare. In order to protect the privacy of each participant, the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) is employed to decompose the original centralized optimization model into distributed local optimization models. A distributed interactive algorithm is also proposed to solve the optimal operation strategies. Simulation results on the modified IEEE 15-node system show that the proposed model can protect the privacy of participants and solve the operation strategies efficiently. Besides, the coordinated operation of the distribution network and micro energy grids can realize security and economic operations of the whole system.

articleTitle: A Definition and Prediction Method for Wind Power Low Output Events
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Low output event refers to the phenomenon of continuous low output fluctuation in the process of new energy power generation. Accurate prediction of low output event can detect the adverse effects of weather processes on power generation in advance, and provide assistance in ensuring the safety and stability of power consumption. This paper proposed a definition and prediction method for wind power low output events. First, the definition rules are proposed based on the fluctuation process partitioning and the selection of time and threshold value. Second, the historical power sequence is processed by high and low frequency filtering. Then, the low output event prediction model is constructed based on wind power prediction. Finally, the evaluation indexes are proposed to assess the prediction result. The case study of a wind farm in Northeast China shows that the low output event prediction method proposed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Pumped Storage Capacity Allocation of Cascade Hydro-Wind-Solar-Pumped Storage Hybrid System Considering Economy and Operational Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Under the background of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” and the high proportion of wind and solar resources connected to the power grid, how to maximize the use of water resources in the southwest region to achieve the absorption of wind-solar power and the stability of fluctuations has widely attracted attention. Therefore, this paper proposes a capacity configuration method for hybrid pumped storage stations with a cascade hydro-wind-solar-pumped storage complementary system, which takes into account construction economy and running stability. Firstly, the steady-state output models of cascade hydro-wind-photovoltaic-pumped storage power stations are established considering the prediction error. Secondly, considering the investment cost recovery of pumped storage, a hybrid pumped storage capacity configuration model is constructed, which aims to maximize the daily benefit of the complementary system and minimize the peak-valley difference of the remaining load. Finally, the scenario optimization method is adopted to reduce the influence brought by the uncertainty of runoff-wind-solar. Three cascade hydropower stations and planned wind-photovoltaic power stations downstream of a basin on a typical day are taken as an example. The result shows that the peak-valley difference of the hybrid system is reduced by 1326.86MW and 35.68% with an extremely small cost compared with the system without pumped storage, which can provide theoretical support for the capacity configuration of hybrid pumped storage.

articleTitle: Full Topology Simulation Model and Control Strategy for Photovoltaic System and Energy Storage System under New Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of renewable energy power generation systems into the grid, its randomness have brought a huge burden to the stable operation of the grid. As one of the effective solutions to this problem, hybrid energy storage system has gradually become a research hotspot at home and abroad. This paper focuses on the full topology model of the hybrid energy storage system, the study of its control strategy and its simulation verification. Firstly, the modelling methods for three types of energy storage systems - battery, supercapacitor and flywheel - as well as bidirectional DC/DC converters and grid-connected inverters are studied, and the modules are modelled and simulated. Secondly, the traditional control strategy for hybrid energy storage systems has been improved. An overcharge and over-discharge module for hybrid energy storage systems has been included. Finally, the stability of the hybrid energy storage system under perturbation is investigated by varying the light intensity and load mutation. Simulations are carried out by MATLAB/Simulink. The results verify the practicality and effectiveness of the modelling approach and the control strategy.

articleTitle: Dynamic Voltage Support Capability Assessment of Distributed Generators in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Assessment of node importance is essential for the reliable operation of microgrids. The absence of key nodes for voltage support during voltage deviation may significantly escalate the severity of an incident. Distributed generators in microgrids are highly susceptible to going off-grid during disturbances and are more likely to experience node failure. This study proposes a voltage support capability assessment method for distributed generators, which integrates the electrical characteristics of microgrids with the structural features of graph theory, enabling an accurate assessment of the voltage regulation capabilities of distributed generators. The concurrence of time-domain simulation and calculation results demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method in identifying key nodes for voltage support.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Dispatch of Park Integrated Energy System under Electricity-Carbon-Green Certificate Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of marketization of the power industry, park integrated energy systems (PIESs) need to reduce the cost of electricity purchase and reduce carbon emissions. It has become an important study for the development of the PIES to make effective use of the interaction between the electricity market, the carbon market, and the green certificate market (GCM) to promote green electricity consumption and low-carbon development. This paper constructs green certificate-energy consumption (GC-EC) equivalent offset mechanism and proposes a green and low-carbon dispatch method for PIES considering the coupling of the electricity-carbon-green certificate market. Finally, to minimize the total system cost, a low-carbon economic dispatch model for PIES under the electricity-carbon-green certificate market is constructed. The result of the example shows that this method can make the PIES more flexible to participate in markets to improve green electricity consumption and reduce the system's carbon emissions and improve the economy and low-carbon.

Author Keywords: green certificate-energy consumption equivalent offset mechanism

articleTitle: Hybrid Power Systems for Vessels with Lithium-Ion Battery System: An Application Case
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The activities of vessels impose an increasing impact on the environment through fossil fuel consumption and massive emissions. The stringent energy efficiency standard prompts the development of efficient and environmentally friendly powertrains. Hybrid power systems with lithium-ion battery energy storage have been used widely due to their multiple advantages. As an application case, a lithium-ion battery energy storage system is applied to an ocean-going carrier with advanced battery management technology. Meeting the requirement of the emission control areas, the carrier can ensure 3.43 hours duration in 24 nautical miles sailing distances at 7 knots, while 1.14 hours in 12.5 nautical miles at 11 knots. The application of the hybrid power system greatly improves the vessel's efficiency in the emission-control areas.

articleTitle: Mathematical Analysis of Time-Series & Meteorological Factors in Electricity Demand Forecasting Based on Carbon Neutrality
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the modernization of the electric power system and the increase of renewable energy, there is a significant need for various energy management systems (EMSs), in which electricity demand forecasting technology plays a remarkable role. Moreover, the load dispatching center operator regulates the supply-demand balance in the service area to meet the ever-changing electricity demand based on the demand forecasting results. Unfortunately, climatic and natural disaster factors bring uncertainties in the demand forecast process, which leads to the low prediction accuracy of the existing forecast techniques with failing to fully consider these factors affecting load fluctuations. In this paper, the importance of major time-series, meteorological and business-categorical energy consumption influencing factors applied to electricity demand forecasting is thus comprehensively and systematically illustrated through the correlation and regression analysis methods based on the real electricity demand data and various influencing factors data affecting electricity demand variation. The simulation results analysis in this study can assist load forecasters in more rationally identifying the influencing factors of maximum electricity consumption at various periods, thereby improving the overall accuracy of load forecasting.

articleTitle: Characteristic Parameters Analysis of Bond-Wire Failure for Multi-Chips Parallel IGBT Modules
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Multi-chips parallel IGBT module is widely used in new energy power grid connection, flexible AC and DC transmission, electric vehicles and charging devices, rail transit electric traction and other fields, and the reliability of their operation is very important. Therefore, how to select the characteristic parameters that can characterize the aging state of multi-chips parallel IGBT device is particularly important for system active operation and maintenance and reliability improvement. This paper takes the widely used multi-chips parallel IGBT module as the research object. According to the failure mode of bond wire lift-off, the degradation law of electrothermal and magnetic characteristic parameters in the aging failure process of the multi-chips parallel IGBT module was studied, and finally the magnetic flux density was selected as the aging state monitoring parameter of the multi-chips parallel IGBT module.

articleTitle: Joint Energy and Frequency Regulation Market Clearing Considering Wind Power Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Efficient integration of renewable power such as wind energy in electricity markets is among the highest priorities. However, the deterministic market designs may not effectively adapt to the uncertainty of renewable power. In this paper, we investigate a joint energy and frequency regulation market clearing considering wind power uncertainty. By introducing the chance-constrained market design, we propose a joint market-clearing strategy for both conventionally deterministic units and uncertain wind farms. By the simulation based on real market data, we show that as the confidence level increases, system stability improves, but this comes at the expense of increased wind abandonment losses and higher operating costs in the market. Simultaneously, a higher penetration of wind power leads to lower market operating costs and energy shadow prices.

Author Keywords: joint energy and frequency regulation market

articleTitle: Optimal Battery Swapping and Charging Strategy Considering On-Site Solar Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Battery swapping stations (BSSs) are considered as the most promising approach to provide the electric vehicles (EVs) refueling services, due to the process of battery swapping is rapid, taking up less space and aggregating the charging load with uncertainty. Optimizing the charging operation scheduling plays an important role in the operation of BSS, since it can reduce the operation cost and is conducive to the operation of BSS. This paper considers that the on-site solar generation in the BSS which is composed of fully battery inventory, depleted battery inventory and charging area. This paper focuses on the problem of optimizing the charging operation scheduling of BSS, and proposes an operation model of BSS, modeling the charging operation scheduling problem as an integer nonlinear programming problem, which is transformed into an integer linear programming problem through linearization. The case study shows the charging operation scheduling of BSS considering on-site solar generation, and verifies the feasibility of the operation model of BSS.

articleTitle: Optimal Virtual Power Plant Operation and Incentive Compatible Profit Allocation Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy in the power system, integrated peak regulation resources are urgently needed to improve the regulation capacity of the power system. Through effective control strategies, the virtual power plant can integrate distributed resources and support the power system to realize capacity regulation. This paper intends to consider the aggregation of electric vehicles (EVs), distributed energy storage and renewable energy in the virtual power plant under the background of renewable energy. We model it as a mixed integer linear programming, so that the virtual power plant (VPP) can maximize the profit under the condition of meeting the system load demand. At the same time, the profit allocation system is established by using Shapley value, which provides a feasible reference for the operation and profit allocation of virtual power plant in the real situation.

articleTitle: Coherency Identification for VSC Interfaced DERs Considering Network Topologies
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Since a great share of renewables is integrated into the grids in the form of distributed energy resources (DERs) by Voltage Source Converters (VSCs), there is an increasing need to improve order-reduction techniques for analyzing grids due to the high order of VSCs. Coherency identification and equivalence is a method traditionally used for building reduced-order models of synchronous machines (SMs). With the electrification of power grids, there are researches focusing on the aggregation of VSCs. However, most of the existing researches assumed that all the VSCs are connected to one bus and only took control and filtering parameters into consideration. In this paper, certain network structures are also considered as control and filtering parameters in coherency identification. An order-reduced model for a distribution network with PQ-controlled VSCs integration considering network topologies is proposed. Kron reduction is conducted after coherency identification to simplify the model and intuitively show the relationship between the coherency of VSCs and the connection impedance. Finally, validations of the equivalent model are verified in a modified IEEE 33-bus distribution network model.

articleTitle: Generic EMT Modelling of PMSG Wind Turbine for Digital-Analog Hybrid Bulk Grid Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to investigate the impact of integrating large-scale wind energy into the power grid, the electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation is required. The EMT wind turbine model is essential to conduct corresponding research since the manufacturer-specific model limits the study of internal dynamic mechanisms. On the other hand, the digital-analog hybrid simulation is a powerful technology to conduct bulk grid simulation, which has few unique requirements for the EMT model such as comprehensive function, long-duration stable operation, generality, real-time simulation, etc. This paper presents a generic permanent magnet synchronous generator (PMSG) wind turbine EMT model, which can be used for digital-analog hybrid bulk grid simulation. The developed model has been validated by a black box model through extensive simulation. The case study for wind turbine integrated into the bulk grid simulation is presented.

articleTitle: Integrating Power to Hydrogen in a Virtual Power Plant: A Cost-Benefit Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Converting a part of power generated from renewables to hydrogen has recently become a topic worthy of discussion. Cost-benefit analysis for selling electricity at the market price or converting power to hydrogen is of great significance to the investors. This paper presents a comprehensive economic analysis of implementing a virtual power plant (VPP) in 220 residential dwellings in South Korea, with a total electricity consumption of 1200 kWh. This VPP includes wind Turbine, rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV), battery and hydrogen tank, and distributed generation (DG). For analyzing the data, we used a platform which optimized hydrogen and electricity networks separately in GAMS environment. In addition, with supposing fixed and variable costs of a VPP, financial cost and revenues are estimated by using the COMFAR software. Results show that by implementation of the VPP, expenditure cost of energy for consumers is decreased by up to 28%. Moreover, an 15% rate of return will be provided with less than nine years for the payback period for the owner.

articleTitle: Monopolar Fault Reconfiguration for Resilient Protection of Bipolar DC Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In bipolar DC distribution system, a ground fault on a single line can easily cause a chain fault on the non-fault pole. To reduce the disturbance of such faults on the system, this paper analyzes the influence mechanism of two factors on the monopolar fault reconfiguration. The two factors are the power shortage on the non-fault pole and the protection delay of the voltage balancer. To reduce the disturbance of these factors on the non-fault pole, this paper proposes a non-fault pole load shedding scheme and voltage balancer protection scheme based on di/dt of the fault current. Finally, simulation verification was carried out in MATLAB/PLECS, and a bipolar DC distribution system experimental platform was built. The simulation and experimental results verify that the proposed monopolar fault reconfiguration scheme can effectively improve the supply reliability of the bipolar DC system.

articleTitle: Study of Transformer Loss and Temperature Rise Under DC Bias Magnetism Based on Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to analyze the temperature rise of the transformer body under AC-DC conditions, this paper investigates the transformer losses under DC bias magnetism based on the finite element method. The electric-magnetic-thermal coupling model of the three-phase three-column transformer is established, and the transient electromagnetic field is calculated by using COMSOL software, and the electromagnetic calculation results are coupled to the temperature field cell by cell according to the grid to obtain the distribution of transformer core and winding losses and three-dimensional temperature field under different DC bias magnetization. The results show that the DC bias leads to the increase of core and winding losses, and the losses in the area where the core column meets the upper and lower yoke are most affected by the DC bias, and the losses in the horizontal path of the core are more affected by the DC bias than the vertical path; the winding losses are unevenly distributed, and the DC bias has more influence on the winding losses than the core losses. With the increase of DC bias current to 5A, the maximum temperature of transformer winding rises to 147.3°C.

articleTitle: Wind Turbine Blade Damage Detection Based on the Improved YOLOv5 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Regular inspection and maintenance of wind turbine blades can effectively avoid possible structural failures of wind turbines. A large number of high-resolution images of wind turbines can be obtained through drone inspection shots. This experiment performs data pre-processing and manual annotation of wind turbine blade damage for these images, and is based on YOLOv5 for the object detection of the blade damage. The experimental results show that the model can eventually predict the location and class of blade damage with almost human-level accuracy. It is further shown that for the smaller training set like this experiment, image enhancement before training can better improve the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Simulation Model Building and Experimental Verification of LCC-S Wireless Power Transfer System Applied to Autonomous Underwater Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To optimize the design process, a simulation model of the LCC-S wireless power transfer system applied to autonomous underwater vehicles was established. Through this model, the operating parameters of each device in the system can be predicted, which provides a theoretical basis and reference for the construction of the prototype. The model has a batch simulation function, which can quickly analyze the impact of system parameter changes on transmission performance. The built prototype was verified experimentally in a simulated seawater environment, fully proving the accuracy of the simulation model.

articleTitle: Research on Cost Optimization of Integrated Energy System Based on Power Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, demand response is introduced to stimulate the role of demand-side users in saving system operating costs through realtime changes in electricity prices. In this paper, the relevant models of electric power network, natural gas network and thermal network are established, and the mathematical model of user behavior of electricity price demand response is established according to the elasticity matrix of electricity price and user benefit maximization theory, and the operation cost minimization model of comprehensive energy system based on power demand response is established by piecewise-linearization algorithm. Finally, an integrated energy system consisting of IEEE-39 node power subsystem, Belgium 20-node natural gas subsystem and 6-node thermal subsystem is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm and the established model.

articleTitle: High-frequency Oscillation Suppression Strategy Based on Arm Current Feedforward Virtual Damping in SVG for Photovoltaic Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the large-scale grid connection of renewable energy, there exists the oscillation problem, causing equipment damage and large power loss. Recently, some oscillation suppression strategies do not consider the influence of SVG on stability. However, a high-frequency oscillation problem caused by SVG is found in an actual PV plant. Therefore, this paper proposes a high-frequency oscillation suppression strategy based on arm current feedforward virtual damping in SVG for PV plants. The proposed strategy can eliminate the oscillation problem without affecting the original dynamic performance. Finally, the simulation results are presented to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed oscillation suppression strategy.

articleTitle: A Thevenin Model for Internal Electromagnetic Transient Characteristics Study of the MMCs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Modular multilevel converters (MMCs) are essential parts of power transmission systems. Studying internal transient processes in the case of system transient faults is required to enhance the insulating protection of the internal MMC devices, which necessitates modeling the detailed internal MMC structure. This study proposes a Thevenin equivalent model based on the associated discrete circuit (ADC) switching model (ADC-Thevenin) and then generates a parameter configuration method for the recommended model based on the principle of minimum energy. The suggested model addresses the shortcoming of the current Thevenin models, which ignore internal electromagnetic transient processes to speed up the calculation and is verified by the simulations of the single-terminal MMC system. Finally, the effect of stray parameters on the MMC impulse characteristics is examined using the ADC-Thevenin model.

articleTitle: Space Charge Ellipsometry Detection Method for the Multi-Energy Conversion Equipment Insulation Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: So as to meet the stricter requirement of the high frequency insulation for the multi-energy conversion equipment, research on insulation material evolution under complex transient stress becomes an important development direction in the area. Therefore, it is urgent to develop the space charge detection technology with spatial resolution of nanometer level and temporal resolution of microsecond level. In this paper, a space charge detection topological structure based on ellipsometry principle is proposed. By constructing the ellipsometry measurement platform and carrying out series of experiments, the measurement reliability of the proposed space charge system is preliminarily evaluated. According to the results, it is found that the proposed measurement method has the potential to achieve the tracking of the charge perturbation elastic wave with higher signal-to-noise ratio and broader system bandwidth, which could provide a technical methodology for the space charge measurement.

articleTitle: Thermal-Hydro-Renewable Joint Stochastic Dispatch Considering Hydro Unit Forbidden Zones and Renewable Curtailments
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increased penetration of renewable energy sources in power systems, we need to strike a balance between rising consumption of renewable energy and secure power supply. This paper presents a thermal-hydro-renewable joint day-ahead dispatch model that produces reasonable renewable energy curtailment plans, which improves the power dispatching and reserve allocation under controlled risk. The new strategy to constrain crossing of forbidden zones in hydro unit guarantees the security and economy. The numerical test on a modified system from actual power grids is conducted to validate the efficiency of the proposed model. The results show our framework can effectively reduce operational costs as well as consider the regular forbidden zone crossing constraints of hydro units.

articleTitle: A Carbon Emission Measurement Method and Module System for the Steel Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The steel industry in China is a key industry supporting the national economy. However, it also has the characteristics of large energy consumption and high emission. To meet the low-carbon economic developing tendency, the steel industry is confronted with huge pressure for energy conservation and emission reduction. Based on the analysis of the production technology and technological features, we study the direct carbon emission and the indirect carbon emissions in the process, and analyze the factors affecting the carbon emissions of steel enterprises; refine the carbon emission factors of the grid in time dimension for different energy consumption patterns of steel enterprises, and establish an enterprise carbon emission accounting model, so as to realize a refined carbon footprint measurement study. Ultimately, it will help steel enterprises to develop effective energy-saving and emission abatement plans to realize sustainability objectives.

articleTitle: Accounting for Carbon Emission Factors Measured by Electricity Users with Proportional Power Flow Tracking Considering Industry Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper provides a proportional power flow tracking method to account for the carbon emission factor of electricity consumption. The method considers the characteristics of the industry. Firstly, it obtains the grid tide data, and to apportion the network loss to each load according to the grid tide. Then, based on the corrected load, the grid power flow data is obtained and combined with some typical enterprise's electricity consumption characteristics, such as cement plant and steel plant. Finally, based on the proportional power flow tracking method, the carbon emission factor of each node is derived. The method proposed by the paper provides a basis for the enterprise to realize a refined user-side carbon emission factor.

articleTitle: Calculation of Errors in Current Transformer with DC Magnetic Bias
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Current transformer is the basic unit of measurement in the power system. With the rapid development of the new power system, the access of a high proportion of new energy makes DC component exist in the system, which leads to the working point deviation of current transformer and DC magnetic bias. DC magnetic bias changes the ideal linear transmission characteristics of current transformer, leading to large errors in electric energy measurement, which seriously affects the economic benefits of the power market. To calculate the errors of current transformer with DC magnetic bias, this paper proposes a method of fitting the magnetization curve of current transformer core with hyperbolic function. According to the physical and electromagnetic characteristics of current transformer, this paper uses the Taylor expansion and Fourier series of hyperbolic function and obtains the expressions of the excitation current and errors based on the electromagnetic equation of current transformers. The simulation example proves that the proposed method has good calculation accuracy.

articleTitle: Single-Phase Grid-Connection Inverter Control Strategy Based on Echo State Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Single-phase inverters are becoming increasingly important and popular because of the rise of distributed renewable energy. The mainstream single-phase inverter control methods include proportional resonance (PR) control and proportional integral (PI) control, which need to adjust parameters according to manual experience. In this article, an echo state network (ESN) controller is designed to control L-filter single phase inverter. Firstly, the relevant factors affecting the modulation wave required by PWM are selected by analyzing the working principle of the inverter circuit. Secondly, the nonlinear relationship between them and the modulated wave is established by ESN and gradient descent (GD) algorithm to achieve high-precision approximation of the modulated wave, which avoids the problem of artificial parameter adjustment. Finally, the simulation is carried out on MATLAB/Simulink platform. The experiments show that the ESN controller can not only accurately approximate the modulation signal required to realize the inverter control, but also compared with PR controller and PI controller, the ESN controller can realize stable grid-connection without adjustment in the initial state, and has good dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Suppression of Low-frequency Oscillations Under Different Operation Modes Based on SVG Additional POD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Low-frequency oscillation is an inherent property of the system, and continuous oscillation will jeopardize the safe and stable operation of the power system. In this work, it is proposed to suppress low-frequency oscillation based on static var generator (SVG) additional power oscillation damping (POD) controller to ensure the safety and high-quality operation of the power system. First of all, the principle of low-frequency oscillation suppression based on SVG additional power oscillation damping control strategy is analyzed. What's more, a damping controller of SVG is designed with the principle of phase angle compensation, the design controller continuously reduces the oscillation energy between regions to suppress low-frequency oscillation. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed low-frequency oscillation suppression control strategy is verified using PSCAD simulation.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for a Two-Stage PV Grid-Side Inverter with Active Participation in Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Massive PV grid penetration squeezes the functional space of traditional synchronous generating units in the power system, decreasing inertia for the grid itself. For this reason, this paper presents a control strategy for frequency regulation based on the dynamic characteristics of the grid-side DC capacitor. Initially, the control method for the PV inverter is optimized, and the mechanism for the dynamic response model of grid frequency under PV penetration is analysed; secondly, a three-machine and nine-node simulation model is erected; ultimately, this paper analyses the capability of inertial power support for the FR strategy under diverse control parameters and proves the effectiveness for the control method.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecast Based on Feature Reconstruction and Bidirectional LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Short term load forecasting is a guarantee for the safe, stable, and economic operation of the power system. With the large-scale integration of distributed new energy, load fluctuations increase, and the input feature data dimension increases during forecasting. Therefore, it is particularly important to screen and process input features reasonably when using deep neural networks for prediction. In response to the varying degrees of influence of various feature factors at different time points, this paper proposes a feature screening and input feature reconstruction method based on the maximum information coefficient of MIC, which achieves feature impact analysis, screening, and input feature reconstruction at sampling point granularity. The BI-LSTM neural network with stronger information mining ability is introduced to achieve high-precision short-term load forecasting. The results show that using the proposed input feature reconstruction strategy and assigning input feature weights according to the degree of influence significantly improves the prediction accuracy of deep neural networks. The method proposed in this paper has good adaptability to load fluctuations..

articleTitle: Study on the Control Strategy of Input-Series Output-Parallel Phase-Shifted Full Bridge Converter Based on Virtual DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper studied the input-series output-parallel (ISOP) phase-shifted full bridge converter and analyzed the input and output characteristics of the ISOP converter. Then, a three-loop control strategy based on virtual DC motor control is proposed, and its introduction to virtual damping resistance can better suppress the fluctuation of input voltage. A small-signal model is also developed for the ISOP converter, and stability analysis is performed for each control loop. The stability of the ISOP system under this control strategy is given by the analysis of the Bode and Nyquist diagrams. Finally, the phase-shifted full-bridge converter is selected as the base unit, and the simulation results are used to verify the input voltage sharing and output current sharing with the system under the three-loop control strategy based on virtual DC motor control.

articleTitle: An Island Partition Method for New Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Under the “Dual Carbon” vision, the traditional power distribution network will transform into a new type of clean and low-carbon distribution network mainly based on renewable energy. The integration of microgrids in the new type of power distribution network can effectively avoid the random and intermittent impacts of distributed power sources under fault conditions. In order to fully tap the potential of coordinated power supply between microgrids and distributed power sources, this article proposes a new method for island partitioning in power distribution networks. Firstly, the island partitioning in the new type of power distribution networks needs to consider principles such as prioritizing the restoration of important loads and maximizing the amount of restoration. Secondly, a goal model for island partitioning in power distribution networks containing microgrids and distributed power sources was constructed. Then, an improved genetic simulated annealing algorithm was used for solving the problem. Finally, a simulation analysis was conducted using the PG&E 69-node system in the United States as an example. The simulation results showed that the proposed method can accurately achieve the optimal strategy for island partitioning in power distribution networks, verifying the effectiveness and superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Battery Energy Storage Health Index Based on Equipment Health Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Battery energy storage is widely used in renewable energy sources due to their high specific energy value. However, safety and reliability of battery energy storage is the main bottleneck restricting its wide application. Online monitoring and evaluating the operating effect are particularly important to the safety and reliability of battery energy storage. This paper proposes a framework of battery energy storage health index (BESHI) based on equipment health model, which characterizes the health status of battery cells, battery modules, energy storage units and energy storage station from dimensions such as operating status, life cycle, and performance. It can realize rapid online evaluation of battery energy storage from component level to system level, and plays an important role in improving the operational reliability and preventing equipment failures in energy storage system.

articleTitle: Energy Management Strategy for Fuel Cell Vehicle Based on Working Condition Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A rational formulation of energy management strategy can regulate the power distribution among various energy sources, prolong the service life of vehicle power system and improve the fuel economy of the whole vehicle. In this paper, the energy management strategy is studied by combining the working condition recognition algorithm and the fuzzy controller optimized based on the particle swarm algorithm. The results show that compared with the three energy management strategies without condition identification, the equivalent energy consumption of the vehicle is reduced by 6.2%, 4.8% and 4.9%, respectively, and the change of power battery charge state (SOC) is relatively smooth and kept in a reasonable range., which effectively extends the battery life.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Mixed Game for Coordinated Planning of PV Capacity in Distribution System with Multiple Integrated Energy Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-stage mixed game model for coordinated planning of photovoltaic (PV) capacity in distribution system (DS) with multiple integrated energy microgrids (IEMs). Firstly, the framework of two-stage mixed game for PV planning is described. In the first stage, the distribution system operator (DSO) and the IEMs alliance play a Stackelberg game as leader and follower respectively, which make strategic decisions of PV capacity through interactive pricing and electricity. In the second stage, IEMs reach an agreement on electricity prices to fairly share cooperative benefits through cooperative game. Then, it proposes a coordinated planning model of DS and IEMs based on Stackelberg game, which also presents an IEMs alliance cooperative game model based on Nash bargaining. Thirdly, the bi-level model of Stackelberg game is transformed into linear single-level model via Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) optimality condition and linearization techniques. And the cooperative game model is solved by the prediction-correction-based alternating direction method of multipliers (PCB-ADMM). Finally, several cases in the modified IEEE 33-bus DS with multiple IEMs verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Economic Operation of CCHP Microgrid with Heat Pump and Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) microgrid can realize complementary advantages and unified coordinated work between multiple energy sources, and is a novel and efficient energy supply method, which can achieve multienergy complementary. In order to analyze the economic and energy-saving effects of heat pumps and energy storage devices, under the conditions of time-of-use electricity prices and micro-grid operation, a system including wind turbine, photovoltaic cell, fuel cell, CCHP system, ground source heat pump and energy storage device is established with the objective function of the minimum total operating cost in the dispatch period. The objective function of the proposed method is solved by the mixed integer programming method. The simulation result indicates that heat pumps and energy storage devices can change the coupling relationship between cooling, heating and electricity in the system, increase flexible system adjustment capacity and bring big economic benefits.

articleTitle: The Coordinated Charging Pricing Approach for Charging Stations with Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the number of electric vehicles on the road increases, there is a corresponding rise in the number of charging facilities available. To entice electric vehicle owners to utilize their services, more operators are entering the market with competitive pricing incentives for charging. However, it is important to implement a pricing mechanism that strikes a balance between supply and demand and avoids the issues of under or over-supply, ultimately leading to rational utilization of resources. An appropriate pricing mechanism can also promote healthy and sustainable growth of the industry. To achieve the desired outcome and develop the synergy of charging facility operators in a competitive environment, we propose a multi-intelligence-based collaborative pricing mechanism for charging facility operators. This mechanism ensures a balance of revenue among multiple operators and prevents harmful price competition between charging facility operators. To learn the coordinated charging pricing strategy, we adopt the multi-agent deep deterministic policy gradient method. This approach incorporates the response pattern of mobility-on-demand vehicles to provide an optimal solution for charging pricing strategies.

articleTitle: Interactive Power Prediction Model for Virtual Power Plant Based on Wave-Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Virtual power plant technology has emerged as a crucial technical solution for addressing the challenges related to scheduling of new energy and distributed power grids. However, the interactive power characteristic of virtual power plant is affected by the power generator, renewable energy and load, which results in the characteristics of non-linearity, time series coupling and time variation. To better depict the interactive power characteristics of virtual power plants, this paper proposes a wave-attention network based interactive power prediction model. The proposed wave-attention network adopts casual convolutional layers and residual connections to extract the time series feature of interactive power, and uses attention mechanism to capture the internal relationship of virtual power plant. This prediction model has the advantages of model-free and quick response compared with the traditional optimization methods. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the analysis of several virtual power plants. The case study shows that the proposed wave-attention network has the advantages of higher prediction accuracy and better robustness compared with other deep learning methods.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Seaport Integrated Energy Systems with Coordination Between Logistic and Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The introduction of multiple energies and the electrification of equipment are coupling logistic systems (LS) and energy systems (ES) tightly together in seaports. This paper proposes an optimal coordinated operation strategy of LS and ES in seaport integrated energy systems (SIES) with the purpose of minimizing the sum of logistic operating and energy service costs. In the proposed cooperative framework, ships and quay cranes (QCs) are regarded as the load of ES, so that the berth allocation of ships and the QC assignment are determined under both logistic and energy operation constraints. The temporal-spatial shifting of logistical loads is achieved while meeting the logistic requirements, thereby the dock resources and multiple energies are both fully utilized. The proposed original nonlinear model is reformulated in a linear form and solved by the commercial solver. Numerical experiments show that the proposed method can effectively promote multiple energy integration and reduce carbon emission by utilizing the logistic flexibility. The total costs significantly reduce with a negligible impact on transportation efficiency.

articleTitle: Chain Reaction Analysis of Integrated Energy System Considering Energy Hub Failures
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the development trend of future energy systems, the safe operation of integrated energy systems has always been the focus of research. The coupling degree of multi energy flow is increasingly deepening, and analyzing the impact of energy hub (EH) faults on the safe and stable operation of the system is of great significance. At the same time, the flexible adjustment ability of EH should also be considered. In response to the above issues, an integrated energy system chain reaction analysis method considering EH faults is proposed. Adjust the output based on the specific situation of EH faults and analyze the flow changes of each network. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified using an industrial integrated energy system with a 6-bus power system and a 6-node thermal system as examples.

articleTitle: The Extraction Method of Critical Indexes for Transmission Systems with Low Carbon Consideration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Electricity indexes are an important quantitative measure to reflect regional socio-economic development, power development, and upgrading. In response to the problem that the existing index-based evaluation system of electric power does not reflect the low carbon background, this paper proposes a method for extracting and assessing critical indexes of electricity power. Firstly, low-carbon-related indexes are investigated and integrated with the original evaluation system to form a comprehensive index set. Secondly, the critical indexes are screened by a reduction method based on the correlation coefficient method, and the corresponding weights of critical indexes were also calculated by the entropy value method and the coefficient of variation method. Different trapezoidal attribution functions are constructed based on the critical indexes characteristics, and a comprehensive score is assigned to evaluate the power network development.

articleTitle: Scenario Reconstruction Model for Wind and Photovoltaic Power Considering Spatio-temporal Correlation and Credibility
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the new power system, the viability of planning scheme depends largely on the suitability of the wind and photovoltaic (WP) output scenario. A scenario reconstruction model for wind and photovoltaic power considering the spatio-temporal correlation and credibility is proposed in this paper. The probability density of scenario about each moment is obtained by kernel density estimation. The Copula function is used to obtain the WP output correlation and generate the reconstructed scenario in each season. The credibility of WP output from historical data and reconstructed data are calculated respectively. It can be obtained from the credibility comparison results that the scenario reconstruction model can fully reflect the real situation.

articleTitle: Model Predictive-Based Load Frequency Control Considering Hybrid Pumped-Battery Storages
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Owing to the serious worldwide greenhouse gas pollution, renewable energy utilization has been deeded as a crucial effort for low-carbon development. However, the intermittent and uncertain nature of renewable sources brings a great challenge for power systems in maintaining frequency. To compensate for the power disturbance and regulate the frequency, a hybrid pumped-battery storage is introduced herein to participate in load frequency control for a single-area county-level power system. Moreover, a model predictive control strategy is developed to coordinate the pumped-battery storage and minimize the frequency deviation. To verify the effectiveness and advantages, a case study is conducted under the proposed control method based on a county-level power system in Huanggang, China. Simulation results indicate that the proposed model predictive-based control can regulate the output power of the hybrid pumped-battery storage and mitigate the frequency deviation.

articleTitle: Grounding Optimization Design of Integrated Grounding Device for Low and Medium Speed Maglev Trains
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to reduce the electric corrosion caused by the excessive current flowing through the grounding brush during the deceleration of the low and medium speed maglev trains into the station, this paper constructs a low and medium speed maglev train impedance model and a comprehensive grounding device model by MATLAB/Simulink software to simulate the car motion during the deceleration of the train into the station. Analyze the changes of the current flowing into the car body, the grounding point current, and the potential of the grounding point to the ground before and after the train is connected to the integrated grounding device, and compare the simulation data to conclude that the car body connected to the integrated grounding device can effectively reduce the current flowing into the car body, the grounding brush current, and thus reduce the electric corrosion to the grounding brush. On this basis, the design of the integrated grounding device is further improved, and the optimized design scheme of the integrated grounding device is proposed, and the simulation results prove that this scheme can effectively suppress the grounding brush current, the current flowing into the car body and the voltage from the car body to the ground, reduce the grounding brush galvanic corrosion, and improve the stability of the train grounding system. The optimized design scheme is practical for improving the safety level of low and medium-speed magnetic levitation trains, and the simulation results obtained have some reference value for the design of comprehensive grounding devices for trains.

Author Keywords: Medium and low speed magnetic levitation transportation

articleTitle: A Low Group Delay Phasor Estimation Algorithm for Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the most effective technical means to record the dynamic process of power system, synchronous phasor estimation technology can provide reliable data for the protection and control of power system. Therefore, synchronous phasor estimation of power signals is the basis for ensuring safe and reliable operation of power systems. However, with the increasing proportion of distributed renewable energy connected to the distribution network, traditional synchronous phasor estimation methods are no longer applicable to new distribution network systems. Therefore, a low group delay phasor estimation algorithm for distribution networks is proposed, which can provide fast and accurate data for protection control. This paper first analyzes the principle of phasor estimation algorithm based on FIR filter, reveals its group delay characteristics, and compares and selects the filter design methods. Further, the group delay requirements of the power signal synchronous phasor estimation for the filter passband and blockband are analyzed. Based on this, a low-latency synchronous phasor estimation algorithm based on nonlinear phase FIR filter is proposed. Simulation tests show that the proposed algorithm effectively reduces the estimation delay, and the estimation accuracy in the single test specified by PMU is higher than the standard requirement by more than one order of magnitude, which can provide a fast and reliable data base for the protection control of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Data Quality Verification Service Based on Power Marketing System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Based on the power marketing system, this work investigates and constructs the data quality verification service including three functional modules: verification engine, verification management and verification application, and carries out data quality verification on the topic of electricity bill accounting. The results indicate that the data quality verification service based on power marketing system is scientific and complete. The verification results are accurate, and the verification efficiency is high. The data quality of electricity bill accounting topics performs well in the prefecture and professional dimensions, meeting the standard of 95% data compliance rate. Abnormal data is mainly caused by human factor, data migration factor, and data updates factor.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Electricity Market Price Risk Evaluation Based on Price Elasticity Indicator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The violent electricity price fluctuations pose negative affections on the market operation, especially as renewable energy with high uncertainty increases. The accurate evaluation of price risks can aid market operators in taking prompt measures to maintain market stability, and also assist market participants in avoiding economic losses. To address this challenge, we propose a data-driven framework to evaluate the market price risk based on real price data. First, a novel price elasticity indicator is developed, which is calculated based on the publicly available data of supply and demand bidding curves. Then, the price risk evaluation rule based on elasticity is proposed in a data-driven way. Empirical analysis demonstrates the high effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Prediction Based on Typical Daily Feature Selection and Time Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate load forecasting is the guarantee of safe and economic operation of the power system. With the progress of the power system, data acquisition and analysis equipment continue to improve, which increases the amount of data involved in the process of load forecasting, improves the feature dimension, and increases the complexity of load forecasting when massive power load data and feature data increase available information. At the same time, the prediction accuracy will be reduced due to the existence of redundant data. Therefore, this paper uses k-means method to cluster historical loads based on load feature clustering, uses feature selection method based on maximum information coefficient to screen input variables for typical days of different types of loads, trains TCN time convolution network respectively, and uses different input variables according to different types of days during forecasting, so as to enhance the adaptability of the model and improve the forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: A Borden Cable-Based Energy Harvester for Low-Frequency Rotary Motion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The advancement of semiconductor and MEMS manufacturing techniques has significantly propelled the integration of embedded technology and sensor technology into smart devices. Additionally, the emergence of lightweight wireless sensor networks has opened up expansive possibilities for deploying artificial intelligence technology based on cloud computing, edge computing, or on-chip implementation in distributed wireless nodes. Nonetheless, the adoption of a more robust wireless sensor network inevitably entails increased energy consumption. Currently, batteries serve as the prevailing energy storage solution, but batteries cannot sustain high-intensity work for a long time. Moreover, the maintenance, replacement, and environmentally friendly disposal of batteries pose significant challenges for the widespread adoption of smart wearable devices. Harvesting mechanical energy from monitored object is a very promising solution for continuous power supply of future wearable devices. Techniques for harvesting mechanical energy through rotational motion have been extensively studied. However, these technologies do not take into account the application conditions that the energy transducer end and energy capture end are separated by a certain distance, so there are great limitations in flexible arrangement. In this paper, a Borden cable-based energy harvester joint was developed, and the energy harvesting characteristics were tested and evaluated under different working conditions. This study also tests and evaluates the power consumption of typical wireless sensor nodes, which provides a reference for future research on power-adjustable flexible energy harvesters under different working conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Self-Balancing Scheduling Control Strategy for Distribution Network Based on Soft Open Points Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of the development of new power systems, problems such as voltage rise restrict the access capacity of renewable energy, and its randomness and volatility put forward higher requirements for the ability of distribution networks to cope with uncertainty. In this paper, a scheduling strategy is proposed to alleviate the uncertainty of the source and load in the network and improve the consumption of renewable energy, considering the flexible load and soft open points, in order to achieve the improvement of the regional self-balancing operation capability by means of power space-time adjustment. The model is verified by using the distribution network data of a certain place in Quanzhou, Fujian Province, and the validity of the model is finally proved.

articleTitle: A Source-Load Coordinated Control Strategy in an Industrial Aluminum Production Mircrogrid for Smoothing Wind Power Fluctuations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The wind power fluctuations smoothing issues in an actual industrial microgrid are investigated in this paper. The electrolytic aluminum load (EAL) owns great potentials on providing regulation capacity. Based on that, the detailed control method of ELAs and the source-load coordinated control model for smoothing wind power fluctuations are discussed in the paper. By using model predictive control (MPC) method, the source-load coordinated controller is designed after considering the regulating ratio of thermal generators and EALs. The proposed coordinated control strategy is validated to be effective via the numerical simulation. The results reveal the positive dynamic performance on smoothing wind power fluctuations by applying the proposed source-load coordinated controller.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching Considering the Participation of Flexible Resources on the Load Side in Deep Peak Regulation Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the construction of new power system in China, the shortage of peak regulation resources in China's power system and the serious dilemma of abandoning wind and solar energy have become increasingly severe. It is urgent to fully mobilize the peak regulation potential of flexible resources on the load side. In view of the situation that traditional thermal power units and flexible resources on the load side participate in the market together, the day-ahead market mechanism and optimal dispatching model considering deep peak regulation are proposed. On the basis of considering the load characteristics of virtual power plant (VPP), the market mechanism based on deep peak regulation quotation is designed. It provides a mechanism basis for flexible resources on the load side to participate in the power market and provide flexible regulation services for the power grid. And the participation of VPP has effectively reduced the market cost of deep peak regulation market. The effectiveness and applicability of the model are proved by analyzing the cases of IEEE-30 bus system and IEEE-118 bus system.

articleTitle: Construction Scheme and Operation Simulation Analysis of Hybrid AC-DC Distribution Networks with High-Proportion Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The high proportion of distributed photovoltaic connected to the urban distribution network generates power return and voltage limit problems, as well as the capacity mismatch caused by the scale of renewable energy charging piles connected to the station area under the background of new infrastructure, which brings new challenges to the operation control of low-voltage distribution network. At present, the urban distribution network has problems such as load density, high load, expansion difficulty, etc. The low-voltage AC-DC hybrid distribution network has flexible power regulation capability, so the construction frame scheme of source-net load-storage AC-DC hybrid distribution network is proposed to realize the flexible regulation of power dynamics among multiple zones. In this paper, CloudPSS-IESLab2 software is used to simulate the operation, analyze and evaluate the impact of source-grid-load-storage AC-DC on the power quality of distribution network, and verify the feasibility of the proposed construction scheme.

articleTitle: Response Capability Evaluation of Virtual Power Plant Containing Multiple Distributed Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The virtual power plant (VPP) aggregates various distributed resources in the distribution network into a whole, which not only improve the global response capability of the aggregated resources, but also participate in power grid dispatching and power market transactions as a whole to improve the performance of resources. The recent studies about the evaluation of VPP are not comprehensive. Therefore, an evaluation model of response ability is established in this paper, and more comprehensive evaluation indexes including response time and duration are proposed. Then, an evaluation method for the overall response capability of VPP is proposed, which takes the safe operating conditions of distributed resources as constraints, optimizes and solves the multidimensional quantitative indexes of response capability, and obtains the overall response capability of aggregated resources. Finally, the response capability curve of VPP within 24 hours is obtained through an example, and the effectiveness of the method in this paper is verified by analysis. The overall response capability information calculated by the method in this paper can be reported as the basis for power grid regulation, and the proposed index can intuitively evaluate the aggregated response capability, which is helpful for the analysis and control of VPP response capability.

articleTitle: A Novel Controllable Oscillating Homopolar Coupling DC Circuit Breaker for VSC-Based DC Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The DC circuit breaker (DCCB) is one of the key devices to ensure the stable operation of VSC-based DC grids. Compared to solid-state and hybrid DC circuit breakers, mechanical DC circuit breakers have the advantages of low on-state losses and good economics. However, existing mechanical DC circuit breakers still suffer from problems such as high voltage level of pre-charging system, inability to achieve continuous interruption, and poor economics when applied to high voltage levels. To address these problems, a novel controllable oscillating homopolar coupling DC Circuit Breaker (COHC-DCCB) is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the mathematical model of the controllable oscillating circuit is constructed, and its oscillation mechanism is analyzed. Then, the operation principle of the proposed COHC-DCCB is described. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed COHC-DCCB is verified by extensive simulations with PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Research on Torque Control Current Injection Method of PMSM in Flywheel Energy Storage Based on Electromagnetic-Thermal Bidirectional Coupling Numerical Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the numerical calculation process of electromagnetic-thermal bidirectional coupling of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), as the temperature increases, the residual magnetism and coercive force of the PM gradually decrease, which leads to weakening of the magnetic field and further leads to electromagnetic (EM) torque decreasing in numerical calculation. However, the temperature rise caused by EM torque decreasing is not considered in numerical calculation process, which leads to weaker electromagnetic field and smaller motor loss than those of actual values. Therefore, the calculated temperature in motor is inaccurate. To solve this issue, a control method is proposed to keep the torque as a constant value during numerical calculation process to improve the accuracy of the numerical results of electromagnetic-thermal bidirectional coupling method.

Author Keywords: Numerical calculation of electromagnetic-thermal bidirectional coupling

articleTitle: Fault Emergency Repair Strategy Considering the Integration of Distribution Networks and Transportation Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the process of post-disaster recovery, the distribution network and the transportation network are closely related. The resource transportation of the distribution network needs to be realized by the transportation network, and the normal operation of the transportation facilities also requires that the distribution network can supply electricity normally. Therefore, this paper proposes a fault repair strategy considering the integration of distribution network and transportation network. The paper takes resource scheduling as the optimization variable, and takes the maximum load and road traffic recovery within a specified time as the objective function, and expresses the recovery process as a mixed integer linear programming model, and network reconfiguration is considered in the recovery process to ensure the user's electricity demand. The optimal policy can be obtained by solving the model with the solver. Finally, the conclusion is drawn by using the data of IEEE-33 nodes to verify the calculation example.

Author Keywords: Integration of distribution network and transportation network

articleTitle: Resource Demand Analysis of IoT Terminal Chips Based on Atomic Service Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The diversity of smart city scenarios makes it difficult for Internet of Things terminals (IoTT) to accurately match their differential demands for computing, storage, and communication resources with general-purpose MCU chips, leading to resource redundancy and cost increases. Due to the lack of resource demand analysis for IoT application scenarios, traditional customized chip design methods cannot be directly used for the design of IoTT chips. To address this issue, we propose building a decoupled atomic service set to analyze the resource demands of practical IoT application scenarios. Specifically, we use timed automata to model the atomic services of IoTT, characterize the event attributes and time constraints of atomic services, and use UPPAAL to verify the reachability of the timed automata model of the proposed atomic services. Finally, these atomic services are mapped to the resource call situation of RISC-V instructions to guide the architecture design of specialized chips for IoTT.

articleTitle: Interpolated Average Value Model of Voltage Source Converter for Real-Time Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Voltage source converter (VSC) is being widely applied in power systems due to the development of renewable energies. Electromagnetic transient simulation can describe the dynamic characteristics of power systems with high penetration of power electronics more accurately than electromechanical transient simulation. In this paper, a VSC modeling method based on interpolated average value model (AVM) is proposed to realize the efficient and accurate modeling of different VSC topologies. The high precision simulation of VSC system is realized by interpolation of switching function combined with the AVM. The proposed modeling method can effectively improve the accuracy of VSC simulation with a large simulation step. The performance of the proposed method is validated by simulation and compared with a detailed model as the reference.

articleTitle: Multimode Bipolar Hybrid Asymmetrical Dual Active Bridge Converter for Bipolar DC System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A bipolar hybrid asymmetrical dual active bridge (BiHADAB) converter is proposed in this paper. The BiHADAB converter can reconfigure and operate in the quasi-parallel or series modes by rearranging the switching pattern. Power transfer and current stress of the converter with the two modes are analyzed. It is revealed that the converter can achieve higher power transfer capability with the quasi-parallel mode. In light-load cases, the current stress can be lower if the converter switch to the series mode. Theoretical analysis is verified with simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Continuous Fault Ride-Through Control of Wind Turbine Using Energy Storage Based DVR
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Continuous fault ride-through (CFRT) of wind turbines (WTs) requires WTs to go through continuously from a low voltage stage to a high voltage stage which has a different voltage dynamic process compared with single fault ride-through. And CFRT has a long fault duration. One of the solutions to alleviate the mentioned problems is a dynamic voltage restorer (DVR). However, the expensive cost and large storage requirement of the energy storage system (ESS) in dc link hamper the practical implementation of DVRs.
