To avoid this drawback, this paper presents a novel control consisting of adaptive mode switching and adaptive coordinated control. The adaptive mode switching control combines advantages of two basic DVR compensation solutions to decrease the DVR injected voltage amplitude and compensates for the phase jump. For CFRT, an adaptive coordination coefficient is introduced to distribute the unbalanced energy between ESS and WT rotor inertia. Furthermore, to validate the operation of the proposed control, simulations and HIL results are provided.

articleTitle: Reasonable Value Calculation of Synchronous Line Loss in Power Distribution Station Area
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The calculation of the reasonable value of synchronous line loss in power distribution station area is an important method to locate the station area with abnormal line loss and help reduce line loss accurately. In this paper, a calculation model of synchronous line loss based on the feature parameters of the station area is established. The complex influencing factors of synchronous line loss are decomposed and dimensionally reduced to avoid using the parameters of the power grid structure which are difficult to obtain accurately, so the calculation method is of engineering application value. Based on the feature parameter solving method, using the historical data such as synchronous line loss rate and power supply, analyze correlatively the parameter values of the same type of station areas, and research the benchmark value and reasonable range of feature parameters, so the benchmark value and reasonable range of synchronous line loss under different power supply in the power distribution station area can be calculated. The rationality and effectiveness of the algorithm model are proved by actual applications.

articleTitle: Research on Microgrid Stability Control Based on Improved High-Order Sliding Mode Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A group of solutions to problems brought by the uncertainty of unknown upper bound in microgrid grid connection control and island control are given by an improved high-order sliding mode controller to conduct finite time stability control. For the microgrid grid connection control, the improved method integrates a compensation controller and an adaptive parameter controller into the traditional high-order sliding mode hyper twisting algorithm, which realizes finite time stability control and in another hand facilitates the setting of parameters without too large parameters causing instability in system. With regard to the islanding control, the traditional high-order sliding mode hyper twisting algorithm is extended to match the second-order system where the compensation controller and adaptive parameter controller are introduced. The simulation shows that proposed algorithms can achieve system stability control under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Configuration of Hydrogen Storage Systems Connecting the Electricity-Heat Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The goals of emission peak and carbon neutrality dictate the importance for the development of the new power system based on the renewable energy sources (RESs). It is significant to install the large-scale energy storages (LESs) because of the peak and frequency modulation problems, causing by the substantial increase of RESs in the power system. Compared with the traditional LESs, the hydrogen storage system (HSS) lies in the ability of cogeneration, fast response, long-term and clean storage. Whitin this context, in order to investigate the role of the HSS in the new power system, an optimal capacity configuration for seasonal HSS in electricity-heat network (EHN) is proposed in this paper. What's more, the seasonal storage ability of HSS is considered and analyzed in terms of the carbon emissions, investment cost and operation cost. Finally the corresponded case studies are analyzed. Simulation results reveal that, compared with the conventional storage the HSS can effectively improve the comprehensive energy efficiency and renewable energy comsumption of the EHN, reduce carbon emissions and energy consumption simultaneously.

articleTitle: Dynamic Scheduling Method of Multi-Element Energy Storage System Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of the rapidly evolving integrated energy system and the increasing integration of renewable energy sources, optimizing and scheduling energy storage is of paramount importance in maintaining a balance between the system's supply and demand while ensuring efficient operation. However, traditional energy storage scheduling strategies lack the necessary flexibility to adapt to dynamic environmental changes. This article proposes a dynamic scheduling approach for multi-energy storage systems using deep reinforcement learning. Firstly, the dynamic scheduling problem for multi-energy storage systems is mathematically formulated. Then, a deep reinforcement learning framework is utilized to describe the decision-making process of scheduling, followed by the application of an improved Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) algorithm for dynamic decision-making. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated through simulation examples.

Author Keywords: Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient Algorithm

articleTitle: Research on Transient Reactive Power Support Enhancement Technology for Doubly Fed Wind Turbine Generator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing installed capacity of wind power, the issue of weak transient reactive power support capability of wind turbines has become more prominent. As a mainstream type of wind turbine, the Doubly-Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) is of significant importance to study methods for improving the reactive power support capability during the fault period. In this paper, the mathematical model and control structure of the DFIG are briefly introduced. Then, based on the mathematical model of the DFIG, a model for solving the maximum transient reactive power output capability considering multiple constraints is established. The corresponding solution method is proposed and the original control structure is improved. Finally, a simulation model of the DFIG is built on the Real Time Digital Simulator (RTDS), and simulation validations are conducted with scenarios of voltage drop faults and voltage delay recovery. The results indicate that the proposed approach can fully exploit the transient reactive power support capability of the DFIG and effectively enhance its grid adaptability.

articleTitle: Analysis of Short Circuit Protection Failure and Component Defect of Low Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Low voltage switchgear is the main short circuit protection equipment in low voltage distribution networks. When key internal components fail to work, the short circuit fault current can not be broken, posing a threat to the safety of power equipment and system. The working principle of low voltage switchgear protection devices are analyzed, the reasons for non breaking of short circuit current and arc extinguishing failure of switchgear are analyzed, the distribution of component defects of key components are obtained, and the process and hazards of failure of key components are analyzed by combining test waveforms and physical images in the paper. It also proposes some methods for conducting short circuit withstand strength testing of key components after conducting component function pre testing, and some product performance optimal design methods.

articleTitle: Interharmonics Suppression Scheme in PV System with Reference Phase Correction MPPT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In general, the conventional perturbation and observation maximum power point tracking (P&O MPPT) algorithm has been widely used to ensure the maximum power output of photovoltaic (PV) arrays. When the maximum power point is found, the P&O MPPT method will generate a three-point oscillation at the maximum power point, which introduce interharmonics injection. And it can lead to a deterioration in power quality, and when multiple PV inverters are connected in parallel, the deterioration will be exacerbated. Especially, the most serious situation will occur when the MPPT of each battery in all parallel inverters is disturbed in phase, which caused large interharmonics in the grid. To address the above issues, a reference phase correction scheme for interharmonics control of PV systems was proposed in this paper. when the PV system operates stably at a maximum power point (MPP). The disturbance phase of its DC-link MPPT was calculated by one parallel unit, then sends it to another parallel unit. The shift phase required to offset the disturbance of the first parallel unit was calculated by the receiving parallel unit based on the received phase and its own MPPT disturbance phase. In addition, due to communication delays, a phase compensation method is adopted, which is compensating phase required was calculated by using delay measurements on the communication channel. The compensating phase and previously calculated shift phase are added, the final phase adjustment of the second parallel unit is determined. After phase adjustment, effective mitigation of equivalent total DC disturbances is reduced, and interharmonics injection was suppressed effectively. The effectiveness of the proposed control scheme was shown by simulation results.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis and Category Recognition of Insulating Paperboard Surface Pattern Based on Image Morphology Calculation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to detect the types of insulating paperboard, this paper built an insulating paperboard image acquisition platform and collected 6 different types of insulating paperboard surface images. According to the differences in the surface patterns of the images, an image morphologic feature analysis method was proposed, which eliminated the image surface noise and extracted the characteristic regions of different insulating paperboard surfaces. Three feature statistics were carried out for each type of image feature area, including feature area, roundness and rotation degree. According to the statistical information of feature area, 6 kinds of insulated paperboard with different patterns could be distinguished.

articleTitle: A Convolutional Neural Network Model-Based Approach for Multi-Fault Diagnosis of Asynchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In view of the low accuracy of fault diagnosis for asynchronous motors, this paper constructs an stacked fault diagnosis model based on stacked autoencoder and convolutional neural network. The model uses stacked autoencoder to reduce the dimensionality and noise of the asynchronous motor fault data, and inputs the processed data into the convolutional neural network for fault diagnosis. By removing the pooling layer in the traditional convolutional neural network and using LeakyRelu activation function, the robustness and generalization of the diagnosis model are further improved, and the accurate diagnosis of fault types is realized. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy of multi-fault diagnosis for asynchronous motors, and has excellent performance.

articleTitle: Transformer State Data Cleaning Method Based on DBSCAN and ESN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To address the problem of noise in transformer status monitoring data, this paper proposes a transformer status data cleaning method based on density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise (DBSCAN) and echo state network (ESN) to improve data quality. Firstly, all historical moment data are clustered by DBSCAN to get a number of normal clusters. Secondly, for the data to be cleaned that do not belong to the normal clusters, they are distinguished as device status abnormalities and sensor abnormalities according to this abnormality detection rule. Finally, the state parametric data due to sensor anomalies are repaired by using echo state network. The results show that this method can effectively detect the noise of transformer state parameter data, and the data repair effect is good, which verifies the effectiveness of this method.

Author Keywords: density-based spatial clustering of applications with noise

articleTitle: Research on Network Security Defense in Depth Technology in Cross-Regional Power Transmission Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Power grid enterprises are an important component of the national infrastructure, and their network security protection is of great importance. With the rapid development of digital technology, power grid enterprises are facing more and more network security threats and attacks, and traditional single defense measures are no longer sufficient to meet the network security needs. Therefore, building a network security defense-in-depth system has become a necessary measure for power grid enterprises to ensure network security.

articleTitle: A Sequence Component Based Power Flow Algorithm for Islanded Hybrid AC/DC Microgird
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: AC/DC hybrid microgrid can give full play to the benefits of AC and DC microgrid to realize the efficient use of new energy and the ease of AC/DC load power supply. In this paper, a sequence component based forward-backward sweep method (FBS) for AC/DC hybrid microgrid is proposed. Firstly, the microgrid's islanded operation mode and the AC subgrid's three-phase imbalance characteristics are taken into account, and a droop control model is constructed where distributed power sources take part in voltage and frequency regulation. Then, the symmetric component method is used to decompose the three-phase unbalanced power flow into three sub-problems, and the line sequence current compensation method is used to deal with the coupling between the three-sequence network of the AC subgrid, and the whole AC subgrid is completely decoupled, and then the three-sequence network is solved in parallel. Furthermore, the coupling relationship between AC frequency and DC voltage on both sides of AC/DC interlinking converter (ILC) is established, which effectively solves the power balance problem between two subgrids. The modified example of the IEEE and other standard distribution systems is used to demonstrate the accuracy of the suggested approach.

articleTitle: Information-Flow-Based Cyber-Physical Power System Unified Modeling and Analysis for Automation Applications in Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: One of the characteristics of modern power systems is the deep coupling of cyber and physics. The cyber system of power system with collection, calculation and control as the core is playing an increasingly important role in the modern power system. From a security point of view, the impact events and extent of cyber security issues on cyber-physical systems are increasing. So it is necessary to combine cyber systems with physical systems for co-analysis and security assessment. This paper establishes a cyber system model based on information flow, constructs a unified model for the cyber-physical power system under different control scenarios, and conducts simulations to analyze the potential impact of cyber system anomalies on the operation of the power system. The simulation results in IEEE-39 nodes AGC system shows the efficiency of our methods.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Excitation Characteristics of Trans-Former Considering DC Bias Magnetism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The current simulation method of DC bias magnetization simulation cannot guarantee the simulation of magnetization curve and excitation current of transformer under DC bias magnetization with sufficient accuracy under the premise of real-time simulation and easy implementation. In this paper, we propose a method to simulate the ex-citation characteristics of transformers considering DC bias magnetization, and use the magnetization curve under DC bias magnetization to calculate the distortional excitation current of transformers.

articleTitle: Lightweight Data-Driven Planning Method for Hybrid Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The integration of a hybrid energy storage system (HESS) in the new power system is beneficial for alleviating the uncertainty and inflexibility caused by the high penetration of renewable energy sources (RES). However, the multi-time scale coupling characteristics of HESS pose challenges to conventional planning methods in the modeling process. To improve the applicability of planning model, a lightweight data-driven planning method with decoupled operation and planning stage is proposed in this paper. First, the demand function of the new power system is quantified for HESS based on the production simulation. Second, a graphical model is established to describe the multiple time-scale characteristic of HESS. Then considering the investment cost, a lightweight data-driven planning model is proposed to optimize the capacities of HESS. Finally, the proposed method is verified using a regional test case. Case studies illustrate that the proposed lightweight data-driven planning method for HESS can effectively solve the planning problems of HESS.

articleTitle: Adaptive Ensemble Ultra-Short Term Forecasting of Wind Power Considering Curtailment Data Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate wind power forecasting plays an important role in secure and economic operation of power system with renewables. This paper proposes an adaptive ensemble ultra-short term wind power forecasting approach considering wind curtailment data identification. Firstly, the data processing is carried out to identify the wind curtailment data by the horizontal and vertical quartile method. Secondly, the basic wind power forecasting models based on ELM, XGBoost and LSTM are established and trained respectively. Then, the weights of basic wind power forecasting models are adaptively assigned based on the errors on the verification set. Multiple basic forecasting models are adaptively integrated to realize wind power forecasting. Finally, the statistical analysis of the probability distribution of forecast error is carried out under multivariate conditions. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by case analysis.

articleTitle: Study on Day-ahead Optimization Strategy of Integrated Energy System Based on Distributionally Robust Optimization in Electricity Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The participation of new emerging market entities represented by integrated energy system(IES) is an important trend of China's electricity spot market development, also brings new challenges to IES economic optimization caused by much more uncertain variables. Focusing on electricity day-ahead spot market, a financial cost model of IES considering market participation is proposed based on the common mechanism of China's electricity market, together with one IES day-ahead optimization model. By introducing the distributionally robust optimization(DRO) algorithm, an uncertain set of distribution functions including multiple uncertain variables like electricity price, renewable energy output, cooling, heating and power load is established, with the deterministic constraint condition expression of robust chance constraints model is derived. On the nonlinear uncertainty problem of objective function caused by electricity price uncertainty factors, a method of uncertainty sinking is proposed to turn the objective function into a deterministic mixed integer linear optimization model. Case study shows that the method proposed in the paper can effectively solve the problem of multiple uncertainties met by IES participating in electricity spot market, therefore improve the economic level of IES optimization decision.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of the Renovation of Decommissioned Thermal Power Unit to High Inertia Sychronous Compensator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the widespread integration of renewable energy in the power system, a large number of thermal power units will be decommissioned in the next decades. The decommissioning of thermal power units and the integration of renewable energy into the grid lead to a large amount of the reactive power requirement, which can be sastisfied by the renovation of decommissioned thermal power units to sychronous compensator. However, traditional decomissioning method just takes the advantge of power generation, which abandon the inertia in the steam turbine of thermal power units and lack of inertia support ability. In this paper, a renovation method is firstly demonstrated to transform thermal power units into sychronous compensator with high inertia that can provide reactive power and inertia support. And then the economics of the renovation method is analyzide by the annual cost value method and the benefit increment ratio analysis method (iB/C method). Finally, four decommissioning schemes are compared to select the best scheme.

articleTitle: An Optimal Multi-Mode Power Allocation Strategy for Fuel Cell and Battery Hybrid System Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Fuel cell vehicles are the ideal direction for the development of new energy vehicles in the future. In order to improve the dynamic performance of fuel cell systems, fuel cells are usually used in combination with lithium batteries, supercapacitors or other energy storage devices. Its energy management strategy is a top priority for hybrid energy to improve its performance. In this paper, a multi-mode power allocation strategy based on a rule-based method is proposed for its fuel cell and lithium battery hybrid system. On this basis, In order to enhance the system's dynamic performance and cut down on its hydrogen consumption, a strategy of using the adaptive inertia weight particle swarm optimization algorithm is developed to optimize the parameters of the rule-based power allocation algorithm is proposed. In order to make the strategy suitable for different road conditions, a driving cycle including three types of different road conditions is proposed. The suggested power distribution plan was then tested using a mixed drive cycle. The results of the simulations indicate that the suggested EMS approach may successfully cut the hydrogen consumption by 8.9% while increasing the lithium batteries' range of use.

articleTitle: Directional Relay of Wind Farm Transmission Line Based on Traveling Wave Polarity Comparison
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The amplitude and phase of the equivalent positive sequence impedance of the wind farm considerably fluctuate during a fault, and the extraction of the sequence fault component is affected by the frequency deviation. As a result, the operating performance of traditional directional relay is affected. This paper proposes a directional relay based on the polarity comparison of traveling waves. First, the polarities of the voltage and current traveling waves are analyzed under the forward and reverse faults. Second, an improved wavelet transform algorithm based on the complementary detail coefficients of adjacent windows is proposed to detect the fault traveling wave. This algorithm eliminates the signal loss problem of wavelet transform. Finally, the Pearson correlation coefficient is introduced to measure the correlation between voltage and current traveling waves, and the action criterion of the directional relay is constructed to realize fault direction discrimination. PSCAD/ETMDC simulation results show that the proposed directional relay can identify the fault direction correctly.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Assessment and Recovery Strategy of Highway Energy System Based on Earthquake Disaster Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the proposal of the integrated development strategy of national transportation and energy integration, the coupling degree between highway system and energy system is deepening. However, there is a lack of disaster emergency assessment methods considering the integration of highway system and energy system. Therefore, this paper proposes a disaster emergency assessment method and recovery strategy for highway energy system (HES) against the background of earthquake. Firstly, analyze the ground motion attenuation model, establish a seismic vulnerability model for the HES, and calculate the failure probability of the system equipment. Secondly, it is proposed to use load loss rate, load recovery rate, and emergency energy reliability as emergency evaluation indicators for the HES, and generate transmission line loss scenarios for the HES based on the roulette wheel algorithm. Finally, the case study was used to demonstrate the rationality of the proposed indicators and the effectiveness of the repair strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Secondary Frequency Regulation of Thermal Power Unit Assisted by PV Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The massive access to new energy sources has brought tremendous challenges to the frequency regulation capability of the power grid. By using photovoltaic energy storage system to assist traditional generating units such as thermal power, secondary frequency regulation can be achieved to improve the frequency situation of the power system. Then, a new control strategy combining energy storage control strategy with inverter control strategy is proposed. The inverter control strategy is a kind of non-differential droop control with frequency compensated secondary control strategy. At last, the effectiveness and superiority of the new control strategy are proved by using the Matlab/Simulink simulation software.

articleTitle: A Review of Estimation Methods for the State of Energy of Lithium Batteries for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The state of energy (SOE) of lithium battery is a particularly important line component in the battery management system, which can reflect the operation of the battery and accurately predict the driving distance of the battery in the electric vehicle, providing protection for the battery while further improving the utilization rate of the battery. The paper minutely introduces the meaning of lithium battery SOE, summarizes several common lithium battery SOE estimation methods, and discusses the problems in various estimation methods.

articleTitle: Bus Load Prediction Method Based on SSA-GRU Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Bus load forecasting is of great significance for safe and stable dispatching of the power grid. For the characteristics of historical data of bus load changes such as complexity and time series, this paper proposes a bus load forecasting model (Sparrow Search algorithm-Gate Recurrent Unit, SSA-GRU) using the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) to optimize the parameters of gated cyclic units. The method first constructs a GRU neural network to capture the information available in the future of the time series. Secondly it uses the sparrow search algorithm to search for the optimal hyperparameters to obtain the optimal learning rate, the number of hidden layer neurons and the number of iterations, so as to improve the prediction accuracy and generalization. Finally the results validate the effectiveness and applicability of the proposed method through an example analysis of 220 kV busbars with different load attributes.

articleTitle: Hybrid Energy Storage Control Based on Prediction and Deep Reinforcement Learning Compensation for Wind Power Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of output power fluctuations and uncertainty in wind power generation systems, a hybrid energy storage control method based on prediction and deep reinforcement learning (DRL) compensation was proposed. Firstly, a CNN-BiLSTM network was employed in predicting the wind power, and an adaptive moving average filtering algorithm was used to set the smooth output power reference curve in the future time, determining the total power reference values of the hybrid energy storage system (HESS). Then, low-pass filtering was employed in allocating the power of the HESS, and the deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) in the DRL was used to learn to compensate for the allocation values of the low-pass filtering, determining the new control targets of HESS. Finally, according to the control objective, a model predictive control was employed in controlling the charging and discharging of the HESS, so as to smooth the wind power and ensure that the state of charge of the HESS was maintained within a reasonable range. A simulation experiment was conducted using the data of a real wind farm and the experimental results show that the grid-connected power fluctuations are effectively reduced, the overcharge and over-discharge of HESS are prevented, and the working life of HESS is extended with the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Study on Operation Mechanism of Balancing Market in Germany and Its Enlightenment for China
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The goals of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” and the access of large-scale new energy bring challenges to the balance of supply and demand as well as to the safe and reliable operation of the new power system. In order to ensure a balance of power system, there is an urgent need to propose a suitable balancing mode for the new power system. Based on the successful experience of Balancing Responsible Party (BRP) in German electricity market to solve the balance problem of supply and demand in real-time operation of power system with the improvement of the operational economy, this paper provides a thorough analysis of electricity balancing mechanisms with BRP and transaction settlement patterns in the German electricity balancing market. Moreover, the status of China's new electricity market is involved with suggestions for the future development of the balancing market.

articleTitle: Research on Hybrid Energy Management Strategy for Zero-Carbon Ships
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The hybrid energy management strategy of pure electric ships has the problem of few considerations, especially in the aspects of transient response speed and fuel consumption, which does not fit the ship operation scenario. In order to speed up the optimization speed and improve the economy of electric ship hybrid system, the equivalent fuel consumption minimization strategy (ECMS) energy management strategy is applied to the zero-carbon ship based on fuel cell/battery in this paper. First, the system topology of the zero-carbon ship is given, and the fuel cell, battery and DC/DC converter are modeled. Secondly, the optimal output power of DC/DC converter under ECMS strategy is solved to improve the efficiency of the hybrid system. Then, the working conditions of zero-carbon ships are divided and the power demand curve is designed. Finally, the simulation results show the economy and reliability of the system, which ensures the stability of the DC bus and the coordinated operation of the fuel cell/battery.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Reliability Analysis under Large-Scale Photovoltaic Access
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Based on the background of high penetration rate photovoltaic access to rural distribution network, the impact of high penetration rate of distributed photovoltaic on the reliability analysis of urban power grid access was analyzed. Before carrying out the reliability analysis work, the maximum access capacity of photovoltaic was estimated for the rural distribution network in Pingliang County, Gansu Province, taking the maximum access capacity of photovoltaic as the optimization goal and the power flow constraint and grid architecture as the constraints. Secondly, in order to better protect important power loads, this paper will adopt the strategy of formulating power load levels; The reliability evaluation algorithm of rural distribution network was redesigned by using sequential Monte Carlo simulation method. Finally, the reliability evaluation of the rural power grid in Pingliang County, Gansu Province is carried out through the proposed algorithm, and the reliability index in the regional power supply mode is calculated by the calculation case analysis, and the reliability index changes of different levels of electricity load under the change of photovoltaic penetration rate are compared. Therefore, the new reliability evaluation method designed provides a reference for reliability analysis and power planning of regional distribution networks with large-scale renewable energy.

articleTitle: Non-Cooperative Game Theory-Based Optimization Strategy of P2P Power Usage Quotas Transaction in Communities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the promotion of electricity market reform and the rapid growth of demand-side load, the community power energy management is facing great pressure of power dispatching. In order to better meet the demand of community electricity, this paper proposed an optimization strategy of community Peer-to-Peer (P2P) power usage quotas (PUQs) based on non-cooperative game, combining with the sharing economy mechanism. Firstly, a P2P transaction model of community PUQs is established with the goal of minimizing the cost. Secondly, the dynamic price mechanism of PUQs is established through the initial PUQs and load demand of the community. Thirdly the non-cooperative game model of community transaction is constructed based on the dynamic price mechanism. Then the existence and uniqueness of Nash equilibrium of the no-cooperative game model is proved. Finally, in order to protect the privacy of the community, the distributed algorithm is used to optimize the solution. Simulation results show that the proposed method can not only improve the community load curve, but also decrease the cost of the community.

articleTitle: A Simple Average Current Sampling Method for Three-Phase Interleaved Three-Level DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A novel average current sampling method (ACSM) for three-phase interleaved three-level DC-DC converter (TPTLC) is proposed in this paper. The proposed method effectively reduces the cost of current sensors by utilizing two dc-side current sensors to represent the average currents of six inductors. ACSM reduces the sampling frequency and the calculation burden on the Digital Signal Processor (DSP) by sampling at the lowest point of the triangular wave based on carrier modulation. Furthermore, ACSM mitigates sampling errors in steady-state operation. However, it is important to note that in non-ideal cases, the presence of ripple modulation waves can introduce sampling errors in ACSM. The main objective of this paper is to provide a detailed illustration of the ACSM method. To evaluate its performance, simulation models incorporating ACSM and voltage-current dual-loop control are developed. These models are used to qualitatively analyze the dynamic behaviors and compare them with traditional sampling techniques. The results obtained from the simulations confirm the effectiveness of the proposed ACSM, and indicate that any resulting errors have minimal impact on the output parameters. The proposed carrier-based sampling method demonstrates promising performance, offering a new degree of freedom for PWM converters.

articleTitle: Research on Micro-Grid Planning Technology Under the Background of Carbon Neutrality and New Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of carbon neutrality and new power system construction, the large-scale access of renewable energy such as wind and solar brings great challenges to the safe and stable operation of the power system. This paper constructs a multi-agent, multi-objective, and multi-layer micro-grid collaborative planning model that comprehensively considers the transmission of multi-layer optimization problems based on the different objectives of multiple entities such as micro grid operators. This model achieves collaborative planning and optimization between renewable energy equipment, energy storage equipment, and network architecture at different time scales, and provides important technical solutions for improving the economic benefits of various entities and promoting the clean transformation of energy and power systems. Finally, this paper designs a simulation case based on the IEEE-33 node system to verify the effectiveness of the model. The results show that the coordinated configuration of renewable energy equipment and energy storage equipment in the micro-grid can significantly improve the absorptive capacity of renewable energy sources on the basis of ensuring the economic benefits of various entities, and thus provide important support for the construction of carbon neutrality and new power systems.

articleTitle: Development of a Steady-State Model of a District Heating System Based on Heatcurrent Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of heat networks, there is an urgent need to establish efficient models. In this regard, a heat current model for both the heat exchanger and the primary network of the district heating system is developed based on the heat current method. The objectives of optimizing the operation of the heating system are defined as the sum of entransy dissipation and the sum of characteristic temperature difference. A specific project is taken as an example to demonstrate the achievement of optimization goals through flow distribution optimization under a given heat load. A comparison of the two objectives reveals a difference in optimization effect of less than 1%, indicating that minimizing inlet dissipation corresponds to minimizing the equivalent temperature difference. These findings contribute to the advancement of efficient modeling approaches for complex heat networks.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Instantaneous Calculation Method of Commutation Voltage Magnitude for Predicting CF in HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Commutation failure (CF) is one of the most common issue in traditional high voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission system. It will threat the safe and stable operation of the system. Therefore, accurate and fast prediction of CF is a necessary premise to suppress commutation failure. One of the methods for predicting CF is the critical voltage prediction method. However, it has some problems such as slow speed, single sampling point and complex control. This paper proposes an enhanced instantaneous calculation method of communication voltage magnitude by fitting. The proposed considers multiple time quantities, improves the prediction speed and accuracy of the traditional method, and has more engineering significance. Finally, the proposed method is verified in the standard model of CIGRE HVDC transmission system and compared with the widely-used method. The accuracy and rapidity of the proposed method are proved by simulation results.

articleTitle: Distributed Optimization Operation of Multimicrogrid with Electricity-Carbon Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed optimization operation method for multi-microgrids (MMGs) with electricity-carbon trading. First, a bi-level cooperative dispatch model of distribution networks and MMGs is established. The distribution locational marginal price (DLMP) is used to guide MMGs participating in electricity trading. Second, the ladder carbon trading is introduced in MMGs to achieve low carbon production. The alternating directional multiplier method (ADMM) is applied to calculate the proposed lower model and coordinate peer-to-peer (P2P) electricity trading among MMGs. Finally, the upper and lower models are solved iteratively based on the information of pass-through trading quantities and DLMP between the distribution network and MMGs, which realizes the coupling electricity-carbon trading of the MMGs as well as reflects the win-win situation of both low-carbon and economic aspects.

articleTitle: Generator Self-Excitation and System Over-Voltage Calculation of Black Start in Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Generator self-excitation and system over-voltage may threaten system's devices, leading to failure again during the black start recovery process. To address this problem, this paper leverages the overvoltage calculation method for the target grid frame in the black start partition to compile a set of calculation models for generator self-excitation, no-load long line overvoltage, load rejection overvoltage at the end of long line and terminal single-phase grounding non-fault phase overvoltage to strengthen the power system's security. These models are applied to analyze generator self-excitation and system over-voltage the for the target grid in the black start partition of the Shanxi power grid so that feasible black start plan can be obtained. Then, the proposed models are simulated and verified via the PSCAD/EMTDC electromagnetic transient software, which demonstrates the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed models to satisfy operation requirements for the black start scheme to maintain the security operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Research on the Pricing Mechanism of Wheeling Cost Suitable for Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The implementation of the market-based distributed generation trading is beneficial for promoting the nearby consumption of renewable energy, and improving the level of green power consumption of enterprises. Checking and ratifying the wheeling cost is an important prerequisite for market-based trading of distributed generation. Based on the concept of balance of payments, by comparing the changes of the permitted revenue recovery modes of power grid enterprises before and after the market-based distributed generation trading, this article proposes a calculation method of wheeling cost, which is conducive to recover the cost of enterprise investment, operation and maintenance of provincial power grid enterprises, and then obtain the reasonable asset returns.

articleTitle: Analysis of Market Equilibrium under the Coupling of Carbon Market and Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The construction of a carbon market is in full swing all over the world nowadays, and the carbon market is bound to have a certain impact on power producers. It is of great significance to study the market equilibrium under the coupling of carbon market and electricity market for improving the market mechanism and guiding power producers to participate in the market. This paper establishes a market equilibrium model under the coupling of carbon market and electricity market, which can simultaneously consider the game behavior of power producer in the electricity market and carbon market. Firstly, the mathematical models of power producer's participation in the carbon market and the electricity market are established, and then the market equilibrium model under the coupled market including fossil energy power producers and clean energy power producers is established. According to the established model, using the coevolutionary algorithm to solve the Nash equilibrium, analyze the decision-making and market competitiveness of each power producer, and compare with the electricity market equilibrium state without considering the carbon market, and analyze the impact of the carbon market on the electricity market and power producers.

articleTitle: A Multi-DT Fast Networking Based on CoAP-MODBUS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The distribution Internet of Things (IoT) is an important technology of smart distribution network, but the existing research mainly focuses on the single communication protocol, less to explore the combined value of multiple communication protocols. Therefore, this paper proposes a plug-and-play networking technology for distribution IoT equipment based on CoAP-MODBUS, which uses the low-power characteristics of CoAP to carry out end-to-end data transmission, and combines the versatility of MODBUS to realize the automatic identification of the main station for various plug-and-play distribution equipment, giving full play to the advantages of various communication protocols. Firstly, the plug-and-play architecture of the distribution IoT is constructed; Secondly, the end-to-end communication model of the distribution IoT based on the CoAP-MODBUS communication protocol is established, including the primary and secondary equipment of the distribution network; To realize the automatic recognition of physical device plug and play by the system, the plug and pull mode based on USB interface is established and the automatic adaptation software is written; Furthermore, based on the above work, the automatic configuration process of distribution terminal access is described; Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed technology is verified through a typical practical engineering case in Tai'an, China, with a view to providing reference for the construction of the distribution IoT.

articleTitle: Demand Response Control of Aggregated HVACs for Providing Peak-Shaving Services Considering Diversified User Requirements
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The burgeoning information and communication technologies have made more and more flexible loads, especially heating, ventilating, and air-conditioning (HVAC) loads, assist in system balance between supply and demand. However, parasitic power requirements of users during demand response are diversified, which makes it hard to achieve the stable control of aggregated HAVCs, and the power system safety faces serious threat. This paper takes heat pumps for example and analyzes the demand response characteristics of both individual heat pump and aggregation model of heat pumps. Moreover, a novel control strategy for eliminating the parasitic power instability is proposed. Numerical studies illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transient Response Time for PV Source Simulators and a Design of PV Source Simulator Test Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A photovoltaic (PV) source simulator is an essential tool for researching maximum power point tracking (MPPT) algorithms and control strategies in PV power systems. However, the transient response time of a PV source simulator will significantly impact the MPPT and control strategy of a PV power system. This paper conducts a theoretical analysis of the transient response time of a PV source simulator, aiming to provide the upper limit of the frequency for PV MPPT. To verify the analysis, the ITECH IT6018C-l500-40 model is selected as the PV source simulator, and a hardware prototype of a PV source simulator test platform is built. Through the quantitative analysis of the influence of the transient response time on PV MPPT by setting different MPPT frequencies, this study demonstrates that the transient response time of the PV source simulator has a significant impact on the performance of PV MPPT. Finally, based on the experimental results, the accuracy of voltage and current acquisition, and the efficiency of the PV power system, this study proposes a recommended frequency of 20 Hz for PV MPPT.

articleTitle: Linear Programming Method of Dynamic Fault Restoration for Distribution Network Considering Balanced Node
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A linear programming method for fault restoration is proposed, which considering the dynamic island partition and balanced node. Firstly, the analytical expression of the mapping between the network topology matrix and the island partition is expressed, while the balanced node selection strategy is proposed. From this, the dynamic fault restoration model for distribution network is established. Secondly, the linearization of island partition map is realized based on Koopman theory, and the mixed integer linear programming form of fault dynamic restoration model is established by combining the big M method. The effectiveness of this method is tested by a 43-node system. The results show that the proposed method can achieve the coordination of network topology and distributed generations(DGs), and effectively improve the resilience of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Terahertz Nondestructive Testing for Debonding Defects of Insulating Paperboard
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to detect debonding defects in insulating paperboard, a method based on THz-TDS is proposed. The propagation refractive index of terahertz signal in different media is used to judge whether the material has defects through flight time, and the thickness of defects can be calculated according to the length of time and reflected signal. The experimental results show that the reflection terahertz time-domain spectroscopy system can measure the defects in the insulating paperboard with a thickness of 3 to 5mm.

articleTitle: Cluster Dynamic Partitioning Strategy Based on Distributed Photovoltaic Output Prediction and Improved Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of distributed photovoltaic power stations, such as wide distribution and difficult scheduling, a cluster dynamic partitioning strategy based on distributed photovoltaic output prediction and improved clustering algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the output data of photovoltaic power station is analyzed for correlation, and new sample data is constructed and sent to the deep recurrent neural network for prediction, so as to obtain reliable output prediction results. Then, the grey wolf optimization algorithm is used to improve the K-means clustering algorithm, which is used to analyze the data set containing the output value and environmental parameters of photovoltaic power plants, so as to obtain the distributed photovoltaic power plant cluster with the best dynamic supply and demand balance. Finally, based on the IEEE 33 node system, the proposed strategy is tested and analyzed. The experimental results show that the modularity and dynamic supply and demand balance values of its cluster division are 0.783 and 0.819 respectively, and the photovoltaic output prediction effect is ideal.

Author Keywords: dynamic supply and demand balance of cluster

articleTitle: Bus Load Prediction Based on Subtraction Clustering and XGboost
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Bus load in the power system has the characteristics of large number and high load fluctuation. The traditional bus load forecasting method fails to fully consider the influence of weather, week and holidays, etc. which have already cannot fit the demand of prediction accuracy. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a bus load prediction method based on subtraction clustering (SCM algorithm) and extreme gradient enhancement (XGBoost). Firstly, subtractive clustering is used to cluster historical similar daily loads. Based on the clustering results, a decision tree is established to obtain the type of bus load on the day to be measured, and the daily load of bus on the day to be measured is predicted. Experimental results show that the proposed method has better prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Reconfiguration of Distribution Network Based on Gardener Diagram Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a method for multi-objective distribution network reconfiguration. By introducing the gardener diagram to analyze network structure, the switch combinations that deteriorate objectives are eliminated, and the search space is reduced. Taking power loss, minimum node voltage, number of operation switches, and the load rate dispersion as objectives, the concept of the Pareto optimal solution is utilized to balance the conflicts among multiple objectives. By learning existing information to generate adaptive parameters, an improved harmony search algorithm is proposed to solve this nonconvex model. Case studies on the 33-node system validate the efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Model Order Reduction Method of PMSG-Based Wind Farm for Large Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents a multi trajectory piecewise linear (MTPWL) based method for reducing the order of wind farm for large disturbance. Firstly, the nonlinear system of wind farm is linearized at multiple linearization points along multiple training trajectories, and then the subsystems is reduced by Iterative rational Krylov algorithm (IRKA). Then, the dynamic characteristics of the wind farm nonlinear model are approximated by the weighted combination of low-order linear subsystems. Finally, the modified system with the PMSG-based wind farm is used as the test system. By applying different faults to the test system and comparing the responses obtained by full order model (FOM) with reduced order model (ROM), the effectiveness of the proposed method in capturing the dynamic behavior of PMSG-based wind farm in fault scenarios is verified.

articleTitle: Voyage Optimization for Swappable Battery-Powered Inland Containerships: Considering Heterogenous Flow Velocity and Multi-Battery Swapping
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Ships equipped with containerized battery packages and refuelled via battery swapping are now regarded as one of the most promising solutions to shape green inland shipping. The technical progress has proposed higher requirements for voyage scheduling in terms of the emerging issue of battery swapping and the necessity to be jointly processed with energy management. Aiming to help ship operators make the optimal decision on sailing speed and battery swapping, an optimization model that considers the practical inland navigation environment and multi-battery swapping demand is proposed to minimize the energy-related cost. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the multi-battery swapping strategy based on the proposed methodology. Impacts of battery state of charge limits and electricity price are also investigated.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration of Converter Transformer Under DC Bias Magnetism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: During operation, the converter transformer may experience DC bias, leading to increased vibration. In order to solve this problem, this paper comprehensively considers the electromagnetic field theory and Solid mechanics theory, and establishes a Multiphysics simulation coupling model of converter transformer. Based on this model, simulate and analyze the changes in magnetic flux density, stress, and displacement parameters of the converter transformer core and winding during the process of increasing the DC bias coefficient from 0 to 1.5, in order to explore the vibration characteristics of the converter transformer under the influence of DC bias. The results indicate that with the addition of DC components, the magnetic flux density, stress, and displacement of the core and winding of the converter transformer increase, indicating that the overall vibration of the converter transformer intensifies. In terms of specific performance, the increase in magnetic flux density of the iron core and winding decreases as the iron core approaches saturation. In terms of stress, the trend of core stress change is the same as that of magnetic flux density change, but the winding stress maintains a stable growth with the increase of DC component.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Topology Identification Based on Multi-Prosumer Data
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate distribution network topology is important for stable operation of the distribution network. However, the addition of distributed resources in the distribution network makes the network structure of the distribution network more complex, which is more unfavorable to the topology identification. Besides, the topology identification of distribution network also faces the problems of insufficient multi-cycle measurement data and low utilization of multi-prosumer data. In this paper, a deep neural networks framework based on multi-user fused data is proposed to identify topology. The framework uses the multi-user data timescale alignment method of PMU to obtain multi-prosumer data fusion. Finally, the framework uses deep neural networks to mine the mapping relationship between the sectional volume data and the topology.

articleTitle: State of Health Estimation for Lithium-Ion Batteries by Using Partial Battery Data with a Hybrid Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The growing utilization of lithium-ion batteries in new energy vehicles is emerging as a promising solution to address the global energy crisis and issues related to environmental pollution. Ensuring battery safety and reliability relies heavily on the precise assessment of the SOH, which is of utmost importance. However, the historical state information of batteries used in most data-driven methods may be incomplete or missing, especially in scenarios with small data sizes. In this research, we introduce a sliding window method to reconstruct battery charge and discharge data. This approach involves extracting voltage and current data segments during the battery's charging and discharging stages. These segments are used to construct a VI matrix. We propose a CNN-LSTM deep neural network model for estimating the SOH of lithium-ion batteries. Our model uses two CNN neural network layers to extract frequency domain information from the battery segment data and an LSTM neural network layer to extract the time-domain features of the data. The superiority and generalization capability of the proposed model was validated on the lithium-ion batteries dataset from CALCE by comparing the estimation results with those of single CNN and LSTM models.

articleTitle: Construction and Model Analysis of Boost Boost Circuit Based on Fuzzy and Cascaded PI Dual Control
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the establishment of the goal of “double carbon” and “double high”, it is crucial to establish a safe and stable new power system, and power electronic converters play an important role in this process, which can effectively improve the reliability and safety of the power grid. Therefore, this paper considers the problem of slow dynamic response speed in the traditional PI cascade control strategy for the step-up rectifier control circuit, builds a model to apply fuzzy control to the PFC circuit, and discusses the optimization of the dynamic response speed of the system under the fuzzy control strategy. The PFC circuit is constructed under the traditional PI cascade control strategy, its voltage, and current waveforms are observed, and its dynamic response speed and oscillation are simulated. The fuzzy control is applied to the PFC circuit and repeated experiments are conducted; finally, the two are compared and it is concluded that the fuzzy control strategy can effectively improve the dynamic response speed of the system and improve the voltage oscillation problem, which is of great significance to the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: A Communication Capability Enhancement Scheme for Power Load Management System Based on 5G Backhaul Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The channel capacity of single station in the data transceiver private network limits the communication ability of power load management system. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an innovative networking scheme in which 5G technology is responsible for the 230MHz network backhaul. This paper first introduces the technical pain points of power load management system, and then presents the ideas of solving this problem, compares two kinds of wireless networking schemes, and finally puts forward the communication scheme combined by 5G network and 230MHz data transceiver. This scheme gives full play to the characteristics of 5G with large bandwidth and low delay, and ensures the data security of the private network through network slice, and solves the pain points of high cost and difficult implementation in the expansion construction of the original private network.

articleTitle: Hybrid Double Deep Q Network for Active Distribution Network Equivalent Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As more and more distributed renewable energy generation is connected to the active distribution network (ADN), the power interaction between the ADN and the backbone network becomes more complex. In addition, due to the lack of numerous branches of power measurement units, it is difficult to accurately simulate the power flow in ADN. Therefore, we proposes an equivalent model of ADN, consisting of a motor and a synthetic ZIP load. Equivalent modeling utilizes a Hybrid double deep Q-network (HDDQN) to track the dynamics of the original ADN, using a small amount of power measurements in the boundary to achieve high accuracy. In HDDQN, select the types of ZIP loads and motors from the load pool to obtain the dynamic equivalent modeling of the first layer ADN. Through the powerful feature extraction ability of deep learning and the optimization decision-making ability of reinforcement learning, determine the weight of the model, and obtain the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$PQ$</tex> components of the motor and ZIP loads in the second layer. The results indicate that HDDQN can accurately equivalent ADN compare with DQN.

articleTitle: Faulty Diagnoses of PMSM in Flywheel Energy Storage Based on Phase Current Signal and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Flywheel energy storage system, as a high-efficiency physical energy storage method, has superior performance in the field of regenerative braking for urban rail vehicles. As an energy conversion device with wide speed range, high efficiency and high power density, the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is more suitable for application in flywheel energy storage system. However, a disadvantage of PMSM is that the permanent magnets on the motor rotor may generate demagnetization failure under severe operating conditions, which will further lead to other safety hazards. Therefore, the diagnosis of PMSM demagnetization faults is crucial for the safe operation of flywheel energy storage systems. Traditional fault diagnosis methods mainly rely on manual extraction of signal features and combine with machine learning for fault classification, while the drawback of this method is that it relies too much on expert knowledge and diagnostic experience. Therefore, an automatic diagnosis method based on deep learning is proposed in this paper. The method first converts the three-phase current data of PMSM into an image signal using a Gaussian mixture model (GMM) and trains a convolutional neural network (CNN) to achieve demagnetization fault detection. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed model, three PMSMs current data with different health conditions are used for training the model in this paper, and the trained model is also compared with a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D CNN). The experimental results show that the proposed method has better fault diagnosis accuracy than the 1D CNN.

articleTitle: Generation Method for Medium and Long-Term Photovoltaic Power Time Series Considering Variable Order Time Series Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For PV power time series generation in a single station, the traditional fixed order Markov chain model has the advantage of using limited training data for time series modeling. However, it has the problem that the fixed order and high state space complexity lead to the low restoration of the statistical characteristics of the generated time series. To solve the problem, the paper proposes a variable order Markov model (VOMM) for generating power time series. First, to reduce the computational complexity, a finite alphabet is obtained by traversing the training series, and Trie is used to represent the transition relationship between the power levels. Then, the Prediction by Partial Match (PPM) algorithm is used to compute the conditional transition probability between the nodes in Trie. The “escape” mechanism is introduced in PPM to characterize accidental events. Finally, the power time series is generated by the trained VOMM. The numerical example shows that compared with the current mainstream statistical learning methods, VOMM can improve the statistical measurements, such as the mean, variance, and quartile of the power time series, and are suitable for the medium and long-term power time series of PV simulation and generation.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism of Reactive Circulation Generation and its Inhibition in New Energy Stations
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the rapid development of the new energy industry, the penetration rate of new energy continues to increase, and the static var generator (SVG) is widely used in new energy stations. The problem of SVG reactive power circulation is gradually becoming prominent. This paper studies the mechanism of reactive power circulation between SVGs based on two research scenarios: parallel operation of SVGs between T-connected new energy stations and parallel operation of SVGs within the same new energy station. For two different scenarios, the mechanism of reactive power circulation based on the influence of power flow constraints between grid nodes and inconsistent parameter settings is proposed. For each scenario, corresponding suppression measures are proposed and simulated in PowerFactory. The results show that the proposed suppression measures can effectively prevent or suppress reactive power circulation between SVGs. This paper innovatively proposes the mechanism of reactive power circulation between SVGs, providing a new research idea for suppressing reactive power circulation.

articleTitle: Interaction Characteristics Modeling of Microgrid Clusters Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The interaction characteristics modeling of microgrid clusters is important for its optimal operation. Most of the existing modeling methods are centralized learning and inevitably have the risk of privacy disclosure. In this paper, a modeling approach of microgrid interaction characteristics based on federated learning is proposed. It mainly includes the steps of data sample generation, Bi-LSTM network design and federated learning modeling, and we discuss the detailed technical implementation. It is expected to that the presented approach can provide useful reference material for research on the behaver modeling of microgrid clusters.

articleTitle: A Novel Storage Energy Dispatch Improvement Model Based on Chameleon Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of renewable energy sources including wind and photovoltaic power generation, integration has become a big challenge due to nature features of renewable energies. Combining the energy storage units into renewable energy system is able to make the power output more reliable. However, it brings much economic difficulty to battery power charging and discharging due to the volatility of electricity prices. Considering minimizing the operating cost to achieve economic optimization, in this paper, a novel energy dispatch model based on chameleon swarm algorithm (CSA) is established. Firstly, we convert the complicated chance constraints into a set of deterministic inequalities. Subsequently, a new objective function is formulated with the aim of minimizing the operating costs of the system. Finally, the program is established based on CSA. By adjusting the ratio of fuel cells, batteries, and grid-connected electricity sales, the operating cost is minimized. Program results are compared with commonly used particle swarm optimization algorithms (PSO), genetic algorithms (GA), and artificial bee colony algorithms (ABC). The case study shows that the optimal power allocation determined by the CSA algorithm proposed in this paper effectively reduce the total system cost by 0.6%-3.4% compared with other methods.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of an Isolated Two-Stage Battery Storage Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the fossil fuels depletion, renewable energy resources have become an alternative choice in many different areas. However, it has many limitations for its volatility and instability. The integration of energy storage system can be a promising solution to overcome these limitations. In many energy storage systems, battery storage systems are widely used due to its high specific energy, less cost, easy installment and slow self-discharge rate. However, the extension of battery's lifespan and security problems do not be considered in many cases. In this paper, an isolated two-stage battery storage converter is presented, which is designed using Dual active bridge (DAB) converter with a high-frequency transformer and a neutral point clamped (NPC) three-level inverter. What's more, a seamless transfer by controller's desaturating from constant-current charging mode to constant-voltage charging mode is realized and a constant-current discharging control strategy is also presented in this article. In the end, the effectiveness and validation of the control strategy are verified by simulation and experiment. In this way, the safety of battery storage converter can be guaranteed and lifespan of battery is improved which is of great significance in the applications.

articleTitle: Optimization of CPS Control for Double Deep Q Learning Based on Function Regularization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Markov decision process (MDP) is a decision model based on probability theory and control theory, which is widely used in the field of automation control. Automatic generation control is a common MDP issue in the linked power grid. Q-learning is a reinforcement learning algorithm based on MDP, which can achieve dynamic optimization decision-making and online learning. The NERC's control performance standard(CPS) value may be employed as a reward signal to optimize the strategy since the automatic generation control(AGC) system is an uncertain stochastic system. Moreover, replacing Bellman error with function regularization may increase the AGC system's flexibility and resilience while successfully avoiding overfitting issues. Through simulation experiments, this paper proves that the double deep Q-learning algorithm with function regularization can significantly improve the CPS pass rate, and has practical application value.

articleTitle: Phase Current Based Fault Section Location for Single-Phase Grounding Fault in Non-Effectively Grounded Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Zero-sequence voltage and current based single-phase grounding (SPG) fault detection and location methods in non-effectively grounded distribution network have limitations in practical use due to lack of zero-sequence CT and PT in some cases. To deal with this problem, the phase current characteristics under SPG fault are analyzed and the SPG fault detection method and section location method is proposed. PSCAD-based simulation results show that the proposed method behaves well when SPG fault with different impedances occurs in different sections. The proposed method can select the faulty phase automatically without using voltage signals, which is suitable for all IEDs.

articleTitle: Bidding Strategy of Energy Storage Clusters Facing High Penetration New Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In China, Energy Storage Clusters (ESCs) are increasingly being installed in new energy generations to smooth the volatility of new energy generation and increase revenue in the electricity market. This paper proposes a two-stage optimisation model using “Ontology Optimisation + Market Clearing”, using reinforcement learning (RL) to train the ESC to obtain the optimal charging and discharging power. For the two stages of this model, the upper model is a optimisation of the ESC, with the objective of maximising the benefit of the ESC, optimising the charging and discharging operation and obtaining the power generated. The lower is the market clearing process, with the minimum cost of the entire power system as the objective. Finally, an example analysis shows that ESC can facilitate the consumption of new energy and reduce the total system generation cost. Because there are losses in energy storage, this increases the total generation capacity in the system. Overall, ESC participation in the electricity market has different implications for each member of the electricity system.

articleTitle: Research on a Novel Multi Port Energy Router Architecture and Collaborative Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the core equipment of the energy internet, energy routers are related to the efficient consumption of new energy and the security and stability of the power grid. A novel multi port energy router architecture and collaborative control strategy research are proposed to address the shortcomings of existing energy router topologies. Firstly, analyze the topology of the energy router and propose control methods for each port based on the functional requirements of the energy router; Secondly, the energy router working modes are divided based on the distributed energy connected to the energy router and the State of Charge of the energy storage unit. Then, the mode switching is achieved through the fluctuation of DC bus voltage, SOC and other state data of the energy storage unit; Finally, a simulation system model was built using MATLAB software to verify the feasibility of the topology structure and mode switching of the energy router.

articleTitle: PSO Algorithm-Based Capacity Optimization Method for Synchronous Condensers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The AC-DC hybrid power system is faced with severe voltage stability challenges. Synchronous condensers(SC) can provide dynamic reactive power support and reduce the risk of DC commutation failure, thus attracts wide attention to improve systems' strength. A capacity optimization method for SCs is proposed in this paper, based on Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) algorithm. Firstly, the capacity optimization model of SC is established. Secondly, the PSO algorithm is applied to solve the optimization model. To improve the computation efficiency, the MatLab/DIgSILENT combined simulation is carried out, which is based on file interaction. Finally, the effectiveness and computational efficiency of the proposed method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Hosting Capacity Quantification of Smart PV Inverters in Distribution Networks Based on Difference-of-Convex Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Smart inverters bring new reactive power regulation resources, and the control and evaluation of distribution networks have become a new problem. In this paper, we propose an optimization model to quantify the hosting capacity of smart PV inverters in distribution networks based on different-of-convex programming (DCP).
