First, a second-order cone programming-based model is proposed to relax the non-convex equality constraints and obtain the initial solution. Second, a DCP-based model is proposed to recover a feasible solution that eliminates the relaxation error. At last, the model is tested on a modified 13-bus system, and the results show the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Optimization of Mechanical Properties of Insulation Materials for Dry-Type Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to optimize the mechanical properties of insulation materials for dry-type transformers. In order to improve the mechanical properties of epoxy resin composites, inorganic rigid particles were added by blending. Epoxy resin materials with mass fractions of stable <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\alpha}- \mathbf{Al_{2}O_{3}}$</tex> content of 0%, 1%, 2%, 3%, 4%, and 5% were prepared through blending, ultrasonic dispersion, heating stirring, and vulcanization molding steps. Tensile and impact tests were carried out according to standards. The test results showed that the mechanical properties of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\alpha}-\mathbf{Al_{2}O_{3}}$</tex> composites first improved and then deteriorated as the mass fraction of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\alpha}-\mathbf{Al_{2}O_{3}}$</tex> increased. The composite material with a mass fraction of 4% <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\alpha}-\mathbf{Al_{2}O_{3}}$</tex> had the optimal mechanical properties, with a 24.3% increase in tensile strength and a 24.4% increase in impact strength compared to pure epoxy resin. This conclusion will help to prepare insulation materials for dry-type transformers with better mechanical properties and ensure the safe and stable operation of transformers.

articleTitle: Voltage/Frequency Control Based on Adaptive Sliding Mode Control in Off-Grid Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, photovoltaic systems with DC/DC converters and DC/AC inverters are demonstrated to be stable via the combination of backstepping and sliding mode controllers. It involves extracting the linear form of the canonical brunovsky model of the system for solving the system's nonlinearity, caused by nonminimum phase of the boost converter. After that, the voltage/frequency in AC part with an uncertain resistive load was controlled by a hybrid sliding mode controller. Furthermore, backstepping control and sliding mode control can be combined to achieve the intended control method and optimum stability. The investigation considers both linear and non-linear loads so as to create a feasible scenario. Based on detailed simulations, the suggested controller offers less steady-state error, less total harmonic distortion, and faster response to a wide range of loads. The suggested controller is simulated in the MATLAB software package as a way of demonstrating its efficiency. The outcomes demonstrate its superior dynamic efficiency and enhanced robustness.

articleTitle: A Stochastic Optimal Planning Methodology for User-Side Energy System with Multiple Energy Forms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Developing a user-side integrated energy system holds significant importance in advancing China's energy revolution. However, the complexity of such systems, consisting of numerous interconnected forms of energy, presents a daunting challenge for optimal planning. This manuscript proposes a stochastic mixed integer linear programming model to tackle this challenge and plan user-side integrated energy systems effectively. The model's objective function aims to minimize investment costs in the system's surge phase. Separate operating constraint models are established for the electrical, heat, cooling, and gas equipment involved. Commercial solving software is employed to obtain optimized solutions based on typical scenarios. The proposed model offers the best planning scenario, including equipment type and capacity, and operational strategies. The model is then applied to the planning of user-side integrated energy systems, verifying the effectiveness of the model and its solution methodology.

articleTitle: Optimal Investment Strategy for Wind Power under Electricity-Carbon-Green Certificate Trading: Based on Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The carbon emission trading market and the trading green certificate market promote the realization of carbon reduction targets, and they are coupled with the electricity market. This paper analyzes the market equilibrium of wind power investment strategy under these three markets. The wind power output samples are obtained by Latin hypercube sampling, and the investors take into account the risk preference represented by Conditional Value at Risk in addition to the average income. The multi-agent deep reinforcement learning method is applied to solve the equilibrium of wind power investment strategy. The example shows that the algorithm is convergent and the investment strategy equilibrium can be found. Moreover, the wind power investment under different carbon reduction efforts and different renewable energy consumption responsibilities is compared.

articleTitle: Real-Time Congestion Management of Power Transmission Grid Based on Measurement Data Cleaning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the growing proportion of renewable energy and increased load demand, the transmission network requires the use of dynamic thermal rating (DTR) to augment the capacity of transmission lines. However, DTR fluctuates dynamically due to environmental factors, which can cause congestion in the transmission system in real-time power markets. This paper proposes a framework for real-time congestion management, which is based on measurement data cleaning technology. Firstly, the paper applies data cleaning technology to cleanse the measured data and then accurately evaluates the state of transmission network nodes and lines through state estimation. Secondly, the transmission congestion is eliminated by utilizing a source-load collaboration method, with the aim of minimizing the adjustment amount. Finally, the validity and feasibility of the proposed framework are verified through an IEEE-39 node transmission network with real network data from Liaoning Province, China.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Joint Planning and Profit Distribution Under the Liberalization of Incremental Power Distribution Service
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The new electricity reform have issued a series of policy documents that the incremental distribution business is one of the core content. In this paper, a joint planning and operation model of distribution network is established under the condition of the deregulation of the distribution network. Three fictitious distribution networks are used to establish all possible combined planning and operation model. There are 5 possible programming models and the numerical example shows that the cost of the alliance including all the players is the smallest. The profit distribution model of cooperative game based on shapely value is also established in this paper, compared with the average distribution model finding that the Shapely allocation model can make the alliance stable that can optimize the allocation of resources also affect the long-term cooperation among stakeholders.

articleTitle: A Modeling and Simulation of Optimization-Based Methods in Microgrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Energy management system (EMS) and energy storage system (ESS) can be of great significance to coping with issues of microgrid. In this paper, a microgrid consists of variable load, stable load, photovoltaic generation and battery storage system. It's an effective way to make most of solar power. The microgrid with EMS and ESS can not only help reduce the emission of carbon dioxide but make the cost less than before. So the main goal of the article is to minimize the residental electricity cost and store the solar power when the weather is sunny. Two weather-based scenarios are formulated to deal with the photovoltaic generation (PVG) and ESS. Linear optimization programming (LOP) is applied in this paper to address the issue of saving electricity cost and make renewable energy sources (RESs).

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Dispatch of Park-Level Integrated Energy System Considering Carbon Trading and Flexible Response of Supply Side
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To reduce the carbon emissions of park-level integrated energy system (PIES) and achieve the low-carbon economic operation of PIES, a low-carbon economic dispatch strategy for PIES that considers ladder-type carbon trading mechanism and flexible response of supply side is proposed. Firstly, carbon trading model is introduced in PIES to preliminarily constrain carbon emissions. Secondly, Kalina cycle that can use waste heat to generate electricity is introduced, and combine it with gas turbine (GT) and waste heat boiler (WHB) to construct the combined heat and power (CHP) unit to achieve flexible response on the supply side. Then, carbon trading and flexible response on supply side are jointly optimized to establish a low-carbon economic dispatch model of PIES. Finally, the superiority of proposed model in improving system economy, low carbon, and exergy efficiency is verified by multiple scenarios.

articleTitle: Spatiotemporal Precise Routing Strategy for Multi-UAV-Based Power Line Inspection Using Hybrid Network of FANET and Satellite Internet
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Multiple unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) based power line inspection is the key technology for diagnosing faults and facilitating rapid power restoration in disaster-affected power systems. However, due to limited UAV battery capacity and disrupted ground communication during disasters, the inspection range and operational duration of UAVs are limited. This paper utilizes a hybrid network composed of UAV flying ad hoc network(FANET) and satellite internet to provide communication support for multi-UAV-based power line inspections under disasters. With the aim of achieving stable communication time delay and balanced energy consumption within the UAV swarm, the multi-agent Q-learning algorithm is employed for training, and the obtained spatiotemporal precise routing strategy enables UAVs to select the optimal routing path at each time point, so as to improve video transmission quality and inspection coverage capability, and realize the real-time precise monitoring and diagnosing of power line damage during disaster. Simulation results show that the proposed method outperforms traditional routing algorithms in terms of end-to-end delay stability and energy consumption balance.

articleTitle: Power Balancing Control Method for Flexible Interconnected Three-Phase Four-Wire Low-Voltage Distribution Area
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the policy of whole-county PV(Photovoltaic), distributed PV has been connected to the distribution network in large numbers. The large quantity of distributed PV has brought problems to the distribution network such as voltage crossing and power return. By connecting two AC distribution network through flexible interconnection components, the PV power can be transmitted through DC lines, which can improve the PV consumption rate and alleviate the problems such as voltage crossing and load rate imbalance. In addition, by regulating the output power of the voltage source converter of the flexible interconnection component, the load rate of the interconnected distribution network can be balanced to ensure the stable operation of the distribution network. In this paper, we propose a power balancing control method for flexible interconnected three-phase four-wire low-voltage distribution areas, which adjusts the output power of flexible interconnected elements according to the load rate of interconnected distribution areas at the current moment, so that the load rates of interconnected distribution areas are similar; finally, the effectiveness of the method is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Wind Power Prediction Under Extreme Weather Conditions of Low Temperature Based on TimeGAN and GWO-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The existing wind power prediction models rarely consider the impact of cold wave weather events, and are usually not suitable for such extreme weather conditions, which makes it difficult to meet the operation requirements of power system dispatch department. In order to improve the accuracy of wind power prediction under low temperature extreme weather conditions, this paper proposes a wind power prediction method based on TimeGAN sample data expansion and GWO-BiLSTM. First, the target data set is obtained by screening original data set according to the definition of cold wave weather event. Then, TimeGAN algorithm is used to expand the sample set of the meteorological and wind power data during the cold wave period. Finally, the wind power prediction model is established based on GWO-BiLSTM. The results show that the RMSE and MAE of wind power prediction under low temperature extreme weather conditions have decreased by 2.89% and 2.25% respectively, which effectively improves the prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: A Multi-Discriminator Weighted Adversarial Network for Cross-Domain Unknown Wind Turbine Fault Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The practical cross-domain fault diagnosis methods in wind turbines based on transfer learning have been widely studied, where most of the existing transfer learning methods assume that test data and training data have the same label space. However, this assumption is not realistic in practical wind turbines because the data in the target domain wind turbine often presents new fault categories during the testing phase, which can affect the accuracy of the model. A multi-discriminator weighted adversarial network (MWAN) is proposed here to handle the above problem. The proposed method can automatically identify outliers in the source domain and unknown fault classes in the target domain by introducing a hybrid weighting balanced strategy and using an auxiliary discriminator to weigh source and target domain samples. Adversarial training is introduced to achieve shared class-level alignment in the two domains. Experiments verify that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art methods for wind turbine fault diagnosis applications.

articleTitle: Short-term Wind Power Prediction Based on HDBSCAN with Outlier Factor Method and CNN-BiLSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The existing data-cleaning method often disrupt the chronology of wind power data set, which is not conducive to models learning data features. In order to optimize the data-cleaning process and improve the accuracy of Wind Power Prediction (WPP), a novel short-term WPP method based on HDBSCAN with Outlier Factor (OF) data-cleaning method and CNN-BiLSTM is proposed in this paper. In the first stage, the Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) and wind power are plotted as a scatter plot after normalization. In the second stage the HDBSCAN algorithm is applied to detect outliers in the raw NWP data, then the Outlier Factor (OF) method is proposed to optimize the data-cleaning process. In the third stage, the CNN-BiLSTM neural network is applied as WPP model, in which the input feature includes horizontal and vertical components of wind speed, 4-hour historical power and the Outlier Factor feature set in the second stage. The results show that the RMSE of short-term WPP is reduced by 0.93% relatively when the proposed method is adopted, which indicates effective improvement in prediction accuracy of short-term WPP.

articleTitle: Energy Management and Simulation Verification of Hybrid Power Ship Based on Double-Layer ECMS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Alternative energy and efficiency improvement are the main ways for green shipping industry. Efficient utilisation and coordinated control of multiple energy sources are the key technologies. In this study, the energy management strategy (EMS) of a parallel hybrid power ship is studied. First, the structure and operating mode of the target hybrid power system is analysed, in addition, the hybrid power system model consisting of diesel engine, LNG generator and battery is built by AMESim software. Second, a variable equivalent factor (EF) is designed based on the penalty function, and an EMS is proposed based on double-layer equivalent consumption minimisation strategy (ECMS), moreover, the strategy model is built using Simulink. Finally, the co-simulation verification is performed based on AMESim-Simulink. The results show that compared with the fuzzy logic control strategy, under the same designed condition, the proposed strategy can optimise the fuel economy of diesel engines and LNG generators, resulting in a reduction of 1.25% in fuel consumption and 5.36% in CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>emissions; in the meantime, it can improve the charge-sustainability of the battery.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy for Improving Frequency Stability of UHVDC System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of new energy sources in the power grid at the delivery end of ultra-high voltage direct current transmission system (UHVDC), the system inertia level is significantly reduced, and the frequency stability problem is increasingly more prominent. This paper integrates the frequency response characteristics of the UHVDC system and traditional synchronous power sources. It proposes a multi-timescale coordinated control strategy to actively support the frequency of the sending-end system to achieve reasonable utilization of frequency modulation resources while improving the frequency stability of the system. After combining the maximum frequency modulation reserve capacity of the sending-end system and the unbalanced power after disturbance, the system frequency demand under different scenarios is analyzed, and a multi-timescale frequency modulation control strategy for the UHVDC system is proposed so that it has the capability of both inertial support and primary frequency modulation. On this basis, the dynamic response characteristics of the coordination control strategy under different scenarios are analyzed, further highlighting its superiority over existing control strategies. Finally, a simulation model of the new energy base via the UHVDC transmission system is built based on the RTLAB real-time digital simulation platform to verify the effectiveness of the proposed frequency-supported coordination control strategy.

articleTitle: Short-Term Power Prediction for Centralized Photovoltaic Plants Based on LSTNet-Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Short-term photovoltaic (PV) power forecast, as a fundamental foundation for the operation of new power systems, is critical for the safe and economical operation of power systems. In order to improve the short-term power prediction accuracy of PV power plants, this paper proposes a prediction model based on a long-term and short-term time series network-attention mechanism (LSTNet-Attn), which is formed by the fusion of multiple deep learning methods. The LSTNet-Attn model is established to forecast the short-term power generation of centralized PV power plants. This model first uses a convolutional neural network to extract local dependencies between power data, then captures the long-term trends of the power time series using a long-term and short-term memory (LSTM) network, fully learns the ultra-long-term repetitive patterns of the power series using a recurrent-skip structure, and then a fully connected layer and an autoregressive (AR) model are linked together for combined prediction. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified using actual measurement data from a central PV plant. In comparison with four PV power prediction methods, the experimental results show that the proposed prediction model outperforms other methods and has higher prediction accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Control Strategy and Parameter Design of Flexible Devices in DC-Interconnected Low-Voltage Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The integration of high-proportion PVs brings a series of challenges for the safe operation of low-voltage distribution networks (LVDNs). It has become a trend to improve the power quality of distribution networks by using flexible interconnection technology due to large transmission capacity and flexible power regulation capability. At present, there is a lack of research on converter parameter design for DC-interconnected distribution networks. A control strategy and parameter design of flexible devices in DC-interconnected LVDNs are proposed in this paper. A control method of VSCs in one distribution area is presented to improve the voltage violations, and a control method of VSCs between two distribution areas is presented to improve overloads. The control parameters of VSCs are optimized with the objective of minimizing the network losses, including voltage and power thresholds for initiating control. The advantages of the proposed method is proved by a practical distribution network.

articleTitle: A P2P Trading Mechanism Participated with Shared Energy Storage Operator Based on Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, distributed power is developing vigorously, so a peer-to-peer(p2p) transaction mechanism is proposed, which is considered as an effective mechanism to help absorb distributed power, but a large number of distributed power sources will have an impact on power grid operation. Therefore, a p2p trading mechanism participated with shared energy storage operator based on Stackelberg game is proposed. Firstly, a market framework including prosumers, shared energy storage operator and distribution networks is constructed. Then, a double-layer game model in which shared energy storage operator participate as independent market players is constructed. Finally, the operation strategy of each market player is obtained by solving the game model. The case study results show that the proposed mechanism can effectively reduce the impact of distributed generation on the power grid, improve energy storage benefits, and attract social capital to invest in shared energy storage.

articleTitle: Local Management Scheduling Strategy for Uncertainty of Distribution Station Area Based on Low Voltage Flexible DC Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In view of the errors between day-ahead prediction and real-time output of photovoltaic power generation and load in low-voltage station area of distribution network, a real-time management strategy of distribution station area considering flexible DC interconnection is proposed. The station areas are connected by voltage source converter and DC line, which contain flexible resources such as energy storage systems and demand response. The two-stage energy management scheme is then proposed to optimize the system operation. In the day-ahead phase, according to the predicted data of the PV output and the load, the optimization was carried out with the goal of minimizing the operation and maintenance cost in the station area, and the planned interaction power with the superior network was solved. In the real-time phase, the goal is to minimize the deviation of interactive power between the station areas and the superior network of two phases. Simulation results verify the validity of this paper.

articleTitle: Capacity Allocation of the Hybrid Wind-PV-Storage System Based on Improved Fish Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Hybrid Wind-PV-storage system is of great importance to increase solar and wind energy integration. In order to ensure its economic optimization based on continuous and reliable power supply, the artificial fish swarm algorithm based on improved parameters is applied to propose a model for optimizing energy storage unit capacity in the paper. The contribution of this paper is the life cycle cost (LCC) model, constructed to minimize the life cycle cost of Hybrid Wind-PV-Storage System based on the constraint, which is the loss of power supply probability (LPSP). The optimization model is applied to the Hybrid Wind-PV-Storage System in southern China. The optimization results are analyzed from the two aspects of both economy and reliability. The result shows that the life cycle cost optimized by the improved algorithm is reduced by 49.95% on average compared to the previous algorithm. In addition, the LPSP optimized results show better performance than that of the previous algorithm, which provides a reference to industrious solutions.

Author Keywords: the loss of power supply probability

articleTitle: A Photovoltaic-Energy Storage Joint System Assisted Scheme for Seamless Closed-Loop Load Transfer
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To meet the demand of energy transformation, a large number of photovoltaic system and energy storage are widely connected to the distribution network. This paper proposes a seamless closed-loop load transfer scheme assisted by photovoltaic-energy storage joint system. This scheme is implemented by using photovoltaic energy storage to jointly carry the load for a short time, and adjusting the inverter voltage and current synchronization with the standby power grid. The simulation including amplitude difference and phase angle difference is carried out on the MATLAB/Simulink simulation platform. The simulation show that this scheme can eliminate the phase angle difference and amplitude difference on both sides of the contact switch, improve the safety of the loop closing operation, and reduce the impact current and circulating current of the loop closing on the distribution network.

articleTitle: On Cyber-Resilient Microgrid: A Variable Trust Protocol Based Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of microgrids, the cyber layer and the physical layer are deeply coupled, and the risk of cyber-attack is becoming increasingly serious. Among the threating cyber-attack modes, false data injection attack (FDIA) has been one of the most concerns of research in recent years. Inspired by zero-trust security architecture, a variable trust protocol (VTP) control strategy is proposed in this work, which is deployed at the control center and adopts multidimensional identity authentication for objects and input data to realize precise verification on identity attribute according to each dimension. The information of different identity attributes is fused effectively by leveraging the Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory. The fine-grained quantization mechanism is utilized to obtain the trust score at every interval to represent the credibility of the objects and the correspond input data. A practical microgrid-based simulation is used to prove that the injected false data can be effectively discriminated by the score. With the proposed control strategy, the robustness and operation security of the microgrid is enhanced remarkably.

articleTitle: Research on Short-Term Power Load Forecasting Method Based on PCA-VMD-LSTM-MTL
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Based on the standard back-propagation neural network, the paper proposes a method combining principal component analysis, variational mode decomposition, improved error back-propagation neural network and multi-task learning to predict the medium and short term power load of the power grid. Firstly, the principal component analysis method is used to extract the characteristics of the influencing factors of the power load, effectively reducing the dimensions of the data samples, eliminating the redundancy and linear information of the data, and retaining the main components as the input data of the model. Then, a combined prediction model based on the combination of variational modal decomposition (VMD), short-term and short-term memory network (LSTM) and multi-task learning (MTL) is proposed. VMD is used to decompose the original load sample set into several different eigenmode functions (IMF) and a residual component to reduce the nonstationarity and complexity of the load data sample set. LSTM model is used to predict the decomposed multi-modal components separately, and MTL is used to establish a shared learning layer to speed up the operation efficiency, and the prediction results of different components are superimposed to obtain the final load prediction value. Finally, through simulation experiments, the prediction results of PCA-VMD-LSTM-MTL, BP model, ELM model and LSTM show that the prediction effect of PCA-VMD-LSTM-MTL model is better than the other three prediction models, and it shows good performance in short-term power load forecasting.

articleTitle: Dynamic Characteristics Simulation of Medium Voltage DC Off-Grid Hydrogen Production System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: On the premise of ensuring safety of large power grid, in order to maximize the utilization of wind power and photovoltaic for green hydrogen production, this paper proposes a system solution of off-grid wind-solar complementary hydrogen production. Firstly, the models of wind turbine, photovoltaic, electrolyzer cell and other equipment in the wind-solar complementary hydrogen production system are studied. The electromagnetic transient simulation model of the off-grid wind-solar complementary hydrogen production system is established. Then, energy storage system is controlled by introducing power outer loop to solve the voltage support problem in the main grid of the system. Secondly, in order to make full use of new energy for power generation, combined with the characteristics of hydrogen production equipment that can absorb fluctuating power, a coordinated control strategy of constant current output was proposed it to realizes the cooperative control of the interaction of sources and loads. Finally, aiming at the typical operating conditions of the system, the validity of the mathematical model and its control strategy system is verified by simulation. The method proposed in this paper can effectively improve the utilization rate of renewable energy and provide a complete set of solutions for green energy to participate in hydrogen production.

articleTitle: Review of Research on New Energy Ramp Events
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the massive access of new energy represented by wind power and photovoltaic to the power system, the new energy ramp events on the secure and stable operation of the power grid have brought huge challenges. The ramp events are reviewed from four aspects: the causes, definitions, prediction methods and evaluation indicators of ramp events. Firstly, the causes of wind power ramp events(WPRE) and solar power ramp events(SPRE) are analyzed, and the common definitions, advantages and disadvantages of ramp events are compared. Then, according to the form of prediction results, the methods of deterministic ramping prediction and uncertain ramp prediction are summarized. On this basis, the commonly used ramp evaluation indexes are summarized. Finally, the prediction of new energy ramp events is prospected.

articleTitle: Evaluating of Distributed Photovoltaic Hosting Capability in Distribution Stations Considering Chance Constrained
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The continuous increase in distributed photovoltaic access capacity in distribution stations will pose a great threat to the safe and reliable operation of distribution stations and even higher-level distribution networks. The distributed photovoltaic output power and load in distribution stations have temporal and time-varying characteristics. Therefore, this paper is based on the time series data of photovoltaic output power and load in a certain region of Shandong Province, China at 35040 time intervals (every 15 minutes) in one year to evaluate the distributed photovoltaic hosting capacity of a distribution station considering chance constraints. Using the method of generating scene based on Euclidean distance and average value to solve. The obtained results indicate that considering chance constraints can improve the distributed photovoltaic hosting capacity of distribution stations and verify the effectiveness of the proposed method in this paper.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Islanded Voltage Stabilization in Wind Power, Photovoltaic, and Energy Storage Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the growing problem of depletion of non-renewable resources such as natural gas and coal in the traditional power generation model, new energy sources such as wind and solar are being used more and more in the grid. However, the emergence of distributed power sources also brings many instability factors to the grid: temperature, humidity, light intensity and other external environmental conditions can cause disturbance to the grid. Therefore, new energy microgrids with energy storage elements that can regulate the internal energy flow of the system have emerged. This paper establishes a simulation model for the islanding operation of the scenery storage microgrid. A hybrid energy storage method is proposed to stabilize the voltage at the DC bus of the system by separating the voltage signal through a low-pass filter to control the power generated by the scenic power system to ensure a stable supply of energy to the load side during islanding operation. Through the simulation, it is verified that the model can meet the needs of the load side and supply energy stably in islanding mode.

articleTitle: Active Vibration Suppression of Floating Wind Turbine Based on Fuzzy PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The offshore surroundings are changeable and complex, and the combined load of wind and wave will cause large vibration on the floating wind turbine platform and tower top, which poses a serious threat to the structural safety of the wind turbine system. We place a tuned mass damper (TMD) in the cabin of a Barge floating wind turbine, and an active driving force is applied to form a hybrid mass damper (HMD). The driving force is controlled by fuzzy PID algorithm. The effects of passive control, PID control, LQR control and Fuzzy PID control are compared through simulation, and the results display that Fuzzy PID active control can availably reduce the longitudinal angle of the platform and the longitudinal displacement of the top of the tower, and has an obvious vibration suppression effect.

articleTitle: Analysis of Harmonic Amplification at Grid Connecting Point of an Offshore Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The harmonic resonance caused by the capacitive characteristics of submarine cables in large wind farms along the coast of China is analyzed and studied. Firstly, the harmonic resonance generated by the power supply system of offshore wind farm is modeled, and its causes and mechanism are analyzed. The field test data and theoretical analysis show that the main reason for the excessive harmonic at the grid connecting point is the amplification of the system background harmonics due to the capacitive long-distance submarine cable, and the inductive system impedance of the grid where the offshore wind farm is connected. Finally, simulations are carried out and the results are compared with the field measured data, and the comparisons further validate the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Capacity Degradation Estimation Error Correction Method for Lithium-Ion Battery Considering the Effect of Sequential Depth of Discharge
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The depth of discharge (DOD) is one of the key factors affecting the capacity degradation of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs). According to the results of battery aging tests under different DODs, a LIB capacity degradation model considering the impact of DOD can be established. However, in practical engineering, the LIB does not discharge under the discharge scenario with full DOD at one time, but discharge under the discharge scenarios with multiple sequential DODs, which leads to the sum of capacity degradation under the multiple sequential DOD discharge scenarios is higher than that under the full DOD discharge scenario. This shows that the commonly established LIB capacity degradation model considering the impact of DOD is not suitable for calculating the capacity degradation under the sequential DOD condition. Therefore, by fitting the fourth-order polynomial to the capacity degradation error generated by this process, a capacity degradation correction model of LIB considering the impact of sequential DOD is established to improve the adaptability of the LIB capacity degradation model for the sequential DOD condition, which makes the battery capacity degradation estimation more suitable for practical engineering. The results show that based on the correction model proposed in this paper, the capacity estimation degradation error can be reduced by more than 98% under the under multiple sequential DODs condition.

articleTitle: Coordinated Charging of Electric Vehicle Group Using Smart Meters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of the energy crisis and global warming, electric vehicles (EVs) development has emerged as a significant initiative for energy conservation and emission reduction worldwide. However, uncoordinated charging of large numbers of EVs in residential areas will lead to transformer overloading. Consequently, practical difficulties in EV charging have been witnessed in recent years. To address this issue, a coordinated charging strategy for EVs based on smart meters is proposed. Firstly, a smart meter enabled bidirectional interactive communication scheme is designed to facilitate EV charging information gathering. Then, a centralized control strategy is developed to determine the optimal charging schedule of each EV, considering EV charging demand and transformer loading conditions in a residential area. To validate the effectiveness, Extensive simulations of the proposed coordinated charging strategy are provided.

articleTitle: Cross-Entropy-Based Approach to Multi-Objective Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Planning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Pure electric vehicles (PEVs) are increasingly adopted to decarbonize the transport sector and mitigate global warming. However, the inadequate PEV charging infrastructure may hinder the further adoption of PEVs in the large-scale traffic network, which calls for effective planning solutions for the charging station (CS) placement. The deployment of charging infrastructure inevitably increases the load on the associated power distribution network. Therefore, we are motivated to develop a comprehensive multi-objective framework for optimal CS placement in a traffic network overlaid by a distribution network, considering multiple stakeholders' interested factors, such as traffic flow, PEV charging time cost, PEV travel distance, and the reliability of the distribution network. We leverage a cross-entropy-based method to solve the optimal CS placement and evaluate our method in a real-world 183-node traffic network in Chengdu, China, overlaid by a 26-region distribution network. It is demonstrated that our work provides various viable planning options favoring different objectives for the stakeholders' decision-making in practice.

articleTitle: Short-Term Power Forecasting for Wind Power Generation Under Extreme Weather Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Extreme weather poses a great challenge to the safe operation of wind power and new power systems dominated by wind power. Providing accurate wind power prediction will be an effective response. For this reason, this paper proposed a short-term power forecasting for wind power generation under extreme weather conditions. Firstly, the relationship between wind speed and wind turbine output power is analyzed and a wind power generation model is established. Then, the Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network (LSTM) is applied to construct a short-term power prediction model for wind turbines, and establishes three models for wind turbine decommissioning under extreme weather. Moreover, the climbing control strategy of wind turbine is also investigated to guarantee the system safety, stability and operation economy. Finally, the numerical analysis is carried out on the wind farm consists of 28 wind turbines, the results verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method.

Author Keywords: Climbing control strategy for wind turbines

articleTitle: Planning for Network Expansion Based on Prim Algorithm and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Existing methods for expanding distribution network grids lack flexibility in handling multiple scenarios, particularly in the expansion planning of photovoltaic(PV)-enabled distribution networks where the problem of adding load points is mainly addressed based on empirical knowledge without considering the economic and reliability aspects throughout the entire planning process. To address this issue, this paper proposes a planning method that combines Prim algorithm and reinforcement learning (RL). Firstly, historical data of PV and load characteristics are extracted, and multiple typical PV and corresponding load scenarios are generated using clustering algorithms as planning scenarios. Secondly, the Prim algorithm is introduced to improve the action rules and environment of RL, and the mathematical model of planning is transformed into a corresponding reward function. By using RL, the optimal planning path can be found, which enhances the overall operational efficiency of the network and ensures the power supply of the new load points, providing a reference for future operation planning scenarios. Finally, calculations and data analysis based on IEEE standard cases verify the scientific and efficient nature of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Robust Learning-Assisted Data-Driven Congestion Management via Sparse Sensitivity Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Congestion management based on locational marginal pricing (LMP) and financial transmission right (FTR) mechanisms is vital to power system secure operation. This paper proposes a novel robust learning-assisted data-driven congestion management strategy against cyber-physical uncertainties. This is achieved by embedding a novel sparse estimation method of distribution factors (DFs), which allows for learning the inherent sparsity information of DFs. This method consists of a robust sparse estimator and an efficient online algorithm, integrating robust, adaptive, and sparse estimation techniques in a fast recursive parallel computing framework. The sparsified DFs promote constraint reduction to build tractable, timely, and robust surrogates of high-dimensional optimization problems against uncertainties. Comparative results on a large-scale system validate that the proposed strategy accurately and fast computes LMPs, congestion patterns, and FTR revenues without relying on exact system models and massive historical data. Without loss of generality, this work yields a new implication for optimization-based power system operation applications: model-less, robust, and efficient operations can be achieved via embedding sparse sensitivity estimation into optimization problems.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation for Microgrids with Distributed Energy Resources of Low-Carbon Parks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Developing low-carbon parks is one of the promising ways to promote the green and low-carbon transformation of energy consumption. Microgrids (MGs), as one of the important components of low-carbon parks, have received increasing attention due to their capability to integrate the high penetration of distributed energy resources (DERs) and deal with their intermittent characteristics. With the increasing proportion of renewable energy and power electronic equipment, the modeling, dynamic feature analysis, and control strategy design of MGs is essential for their stable operation. Modeling is the foundation for stability analysis and controller design. However, the existing power system software, with some disadvantages such as difficulty in modeling and lack of flexibility, is unsuitable for the MGs characterized by a high proportion of renewable energy and power electronic equipment. This paper proposes a method to model the low-carbon park MGs with a structure retention model using MATLAB/Simulink. This method uses the custom module Matlab Fcn to build the low-carbon park MG power network model. Besides, dynamic elements, such as DERs, are modeled using the basic components based on differential-algebraic equations. Therefore, the proposed method can conveniently simulate the low-carbon park MGs with DERs and easily add modules and design controllers for the MGs. Finally, numerical simulations on an IEEE 34-bus distributed system in secondary frequency regulation demonstrate the validity and accuracy of the proposed method in the modeling and simulation for the low-carbon park MGs.

articleTitle: An Improved Scatter Search Algorithm for a Generator Maintenance Scheduling Model Based on Probabilistic Production Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The traditional equal-reserve principle for generator maintenance model is no longer relevant with the wind power integrated power system. In contrast to earlier reliability frameworks based on reserve capacity developed in GMS, this paper takes the EENS indicators and generation costs that can be calculated from probabilistic production simulation as the objective functions of GMS, which can more accurately measure the operational risks and economies faced by the power system. For the proposed GMS model, an improved scatter search algorithm is suggested. More dispersed solutions in the solution space may be found during the population's initiation stage, and the suggested heuristic neighborhood search algorithm is utilized to enhance the new solution. The proposed generator maintenance model and improved scatter search algorithm are verified to be effective on IEEE-RTS79 system.

articleTitle: Outdoor Performance Analysis of Mono-Si and Poly-Si Solar PV Panels in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Outdoor performance of PV modules is considered site-specific and dependent on environmental factors. This study aims to evaluate the performance of mono-Si and poly-Si PV modules in the Philippines. Two experiments were conducted simultaneously at the Electrical and Electronics Engineering Institute (EEEI) rooftop at the University of the Philippines Diliman. Experiments were conducted to compare the relative energy performance of the modules in outdoor conditions, and to investigate the effect of irradiance, module temperature, and dust accumulation on the module surface to its energy production, respectively. In terms of energy performance, mono-Si has a 20.45% to 25.70% higher energy yield compared to poly-Si, which was explained by the difference in average efficiency. Hourly average efficiency for mono-Si ranges from 18.53% -18.64%, while poly-Si ranges from 15.01% - 15.64%. As for performance ratio, mono-Si outperforms poly-Si by 19.85%to 22.78%. Results showed that as irradiance increases up to 600W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the temperature for mono-Si decreases while the temperature of the poly-Si increases which translates to overall higher PV power production for mono-Si compared to poly-Si. Lastly, An increase of +4.09% on weekly average energy yield and 5.28% weekly energy efficiency were estimated for mono-Si. Meanwhile, a decrease of -6.31<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>weekly average energy yield and -4.78% weekly energy efficiency were estimated for poly-Si.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Study of Power Electronic Transformer Insulation System Based on Space Charge Characteristics Under Combined Electrothermal Stress
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Numerical simulation of space charge dynamics under DC has been commonly used in the area of high voltage insulation, and with access to power electronic equipment in renewable power systems, the complex stress environment faced by multi-energy conversion equipment has led to traditional numerical simulation models of space charge no longer being applicable. In this research, a high-frequency heating model is constructed on the base of dielectric loss mechanism, and a bipolar charge transport model with coupled temperature factors is further proposed to form a space charge numerical simulation model adapted to complex combined thermal and electrical stresses. From the developed model, the effects of the coupled temperature-frequency dual factor on space charge are investigated and the space charge evolution mechanism under combined electrothermal stresses is analyzed. The results indicate that the accumulation of space charge inside the insulation is more significant under combined electrothermal stress than under DC, and massive hetero charges accumulate near the electrodes, resulting in more severe distortion of electric field close to electrodes. This study is helpful to understand the mechanism of space charge production of complex stresses and provides assistance in the design of high voltage insulation in renewable power systems.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Method of Energy Storage Capacity Configuration Based on Retired Battery Capacity Degradation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The development of the new energy vehicle industry leads to the continuous growth of power battery retirement. Secondary utilization of these retired power batteries in battery energy storage systems (BESS) is critical. This paper proposes a comprehensive evaluation method for the user-side retired battery energy storage capacity configuration. Firstly, the retired battery capacity decline model is studied. Based on the monthly operation optimization results of the BESS, a smaller-resolution battery capacity degradation model is proposed. Subsequently, a multi-objective bi-level optimization model for such comprehensive evaluation of retired battery storage capacity configuration is established, considering multiple indices, such as investment cost, lifetime, net present value (NPV), payback period, and return on investment (ROI). The optimization model is solved by means of the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and mixed integer linear programming (MILP). Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed model and method are verified by the corresponding tests. The test results indicate that the comprehensive evaluation method of energy storage capacity configuration, based on the smaller-resolution retired battery capacity degradation model, can achieve more realistic, technical and economic indices of the BESS, and determine the most suitable scale of energy storage for investment by considering the economy, environmental protection, and technology of the BESS comprehensively.

articleTitle: Architecture Design of Reconfigurable Sensing Terminal Platform Considering Distributed Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Smart city construction requires the design of corresponding software and hardware modules according to different application scenarios and functional requirements, but at present most sensing terminals have fragmentation problems in application due to single function, etc. In this paper, the design is carried out according to the user's demand from the function, and the software is designed according to the function first, and then the corresponding hardware is selected. This process involves dynamic reconfigurable technology, and the software and hardware modules need to be matched functionally, and distributed energy is considered in the application scenario and power supply scheme. The technology reduces the operation cost and improves the resource utilization at the same time, and the overall intelligent sensing terminal meets the requirements of low power consumption, reasonable utilization of resources and end-processing capability.

articleTitle: A Global and Locally Enhanced Water Cycle Algorithm for Dynamic Economic Dispatch of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The dynamic economic dispatch problem of the power system has the characteristics of high dimensionality, strong non-linearities, and multiple constraints. In this study, a global and locally enhanced water cycle algorithm is proposed to solve the problem. Firstly, distance control parameters and adaptive t-distribution non-linear adjustment strategies are used to balance the global exploration and local exploitation capabilities of the algorithm. Secondly, a quadratic interpolation operator is introduced in the later stages of the algorithm's search to further improve the speed and accuracy of the algorithm's search. Finally, a constraint repair technique is used to deal with the constraints of dynamic economic dispatch. To verify the effectiveness of the improved water cycle algorithm, a 10-generator power system including a wind farm is used as a test case for simulation experiments and compared with current advanced optimization algorithms. The results show that the improved water cycle algorithm is effective and superior in solving the dynamic economic dispatch problem of power systems.

articleTitle: A Grid-forming Control Method of Modular Multilevel Converter with Integrated Distributed Photovoltaic and Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the construction of large-scale photovoltaic (PV) stations, the capacity and voltage level of photovoltaic converters need to be improved. This paper presents a novel configuration of grid-connected PV system based on modular multilevel converter, which is capable of integrating multiple PV submodules (PVSM) and battery submodules (BSM). The dc side of PVSM and BSM is coupled, and all PVSMs operate at the maximum power point. A grid forming control is proposed for the converter, which can suppress the PV power fluctuation and provide frequency support for the grid using the energy in the BSMs. The circulating current suppression strategy is adopted to realize the energy balance of the converter and ensure the power quality of output voltage and current. The effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed control method are verified by the simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration of Long-Duration Hydrogen Energy Storage for High Proportion New Energy Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Hydrogen energy storage has the advantages of both the fast response capability of electrochemical energy storage and the ability of large-scale physical energy storage to store across seasons, making it an important way to cope with the cross-season power balance problem between new energy and load in new power system. In this paper, an electric-hydrogen energy system is established. To address the capacity configuration optimization problem of hydrogen energy storage system, based on the dual-granularity time grid structure of intra-period and inter-period, the operation model of hydrogen storage and electrolyzer is established, and the corresponding capacity configuration optimization model is established using scenario analysis method. The results of case study demonstrate the effectiveness of this proposed optimization configuration model.

articleTitle: Research on Profit Analysis of E-NG Vehicle Charging Station Improved from Split Type into Joint Type
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Motivated by the dual carbon goals, it is crucial to increase the impact of new energy vehicles to facilitate the transformation of the energy structure and to promote the advancement of energy cleanliness. New energy integrated charging stations serve as the energy integration hub for the automotive distribution infrastructure, and thus play a crucial role in promoting the proliferation of new energy vehicles. This study is focused on the multi-energy integration field and proposes a comprehensive energy station for new energy vehicles. This station takes into account the charging needs of mainstream new energy vehicles, integrates new energy power generation, and presents a station framework that employs two connection modes: joint and split. Based on this framework, the day-ahead economic scheduling optimization model is proposed, incorporating the time-of-use electricity price strategy and comprehensive consideration of new energy consumption. This model aims to reduce the operating cost of energy stations and promote the consumption of renewable energy. The case study demonstrates that the proposed optimal operation strategy can reduce the operating cost of the integrated energy station by 43.91%.

articleTitle: A Method for Energy Supply Unit Partitioning in Multi-Energy Distribution System Considering Flexible Adjustment Capability of Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to achieve the goal of “carbon neutrality and carbon peak”, the new distribution system with multi-energy complementary and integration has become an important development direction and construction path of future distribution network. In order to adapt to the actual situation of multi-type power equipment access and multi-energy integrated supply, it is necessary to carry out the research on the planning method of energy supply unit centered on electricity. Aiming at the new distribution system with flexible access of multi-type load and distributed generation, this paper considers the uncertainty of different types of load and distributed generation, and proposes an uncertainty handling method based on three-point estimation and Gram-Charlier expansion. Considering the differentiated demand response regulation capability of different types of loads, an energy supply unit optimization partitioning method satisfying the feeders N-1 criterion is proposed. By setting the actual regions to be planned as an example and considering the results of energy supply unit partitioning under different demand response adjustment capabilities, the economy, safety, and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified.

articleTitle: Coordinated Ride-hailing Order Scheduling and Charging for Autonomous Electric Vehicles Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Autonomous electric vehicles (AEVs) are increasingly recognized as a crucial component in the modern transportation networks. This creates a pressing need to develop efficient and economic management methods for AEV operators. In this paper, we propose a coordinated order scheduling and charging framework for AEVs that provide ride-hailing services based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) method that considers AEVs' spatial-temporal mobility and charging behaviors. In this framework, we first formulate an aggregated model for charging stations (CSs) that extracts features of each AEV by tracking the dynamic correspondence between AEVs and CSs. Then, we propose a novel DRL-based algorithm for the aggregated model that schedules the lower thresholds of charging requirements so that AEVs can get charged at the lowest charging prices and shortest trip distances, in the meantime satisfying ride-hailing order demand. Numerical experiments are conducted to verify the superiority of the proposed method through a New York City zone-based power-transportation coupled network. The results validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework in saving operation cost with high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: An Economic Scheduling Method for Coordinated Integrated Energy Systems and Transportation Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Integrated energy systems (IES) improve overall energy efficiency by synchronizing resources and networks across multiple regions, the high penetration level of electric vehicles (EVs) may pose a threat without coordinating with the IES. Thus, this paper proposes a coordinated IES and transportation network (TN) operation model toward economic scheduling, with the secure operation conditions are comprehensively considered. Specifically, the composition networks of IES and the TN are modeled separately, then a transactive relationship model is proposed to get the networks bridged. To reduce the computational intractability, several approximation and relaxation methods are utilized to transform the model into a mixed-integer-quadratic problem (MIQP). Results show that the coordinated scheduling of IES and TN can lower 4.3% (105.266k$) of consumption compared with the independent scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Support Technology of Offshore Wind Farm Based on Improved Grey Wolf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The power grid may experience a decrease in frequency response capabilities and encounter issues such as secondary frequency drops and wind turbines over-responding when large-scale offshore wind farms are integrated. This can have a serious impact on the stability of high-proportion renewable energy power systems. To address this problem, a coordinated control strategy that employs an improved droop control, power-based virtual inertia control, and the grey wolf algorithm is proposed in this paper. The strategy optimizes droop control tuning coefficients for various wind speed settings, improves control accuracy, enhances droop characteristics of wind turbines, reduces frequency overshoot during frequency regulation, and effectively tackles the issue of slow response that leads to frequency drop in the initial stages of frequency disturbance when traditional droop control is employed. This strategy serves as technical support for the development of a new power system that relies heavily on renewable energy.

articleTitle: Data-driven Stability Assessment for New Power Systems: Typical Characteristics, Research Framework and Future Prospects
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The widely integrated renewable energy sources bring the new power systems (NPS) far more nonlinearity, flexibility, randomness and openness than the conventional one. The stability mechanism of the NPS is profoundly changed with the stable operation facing serious challenges. Hence, accurate stability assessment (SA) of NPS is essential to ensure the stable and reliable operation. Data-driven SA method is gaining more and more attention because of its superior performance on massive data processing, nonlinear relationship characterization and accurate assessment. Accordingly, this paper first summarizes the characteristics of NPSs, then discusses the connotation, characteristics, trends and framework of SA suitable for NPSs. The recent data-driven SA researches are analyzed from two dimensions: conventional data-driven and deep learning-driven, and further classified according to the data characteristics from three perspectives: discrete, time-series and spatial-temporal data. The applicability of key technologies and their advantages in the NPS is reviewed and evaluated. Finally, the research gaps and future trends are summarized and outlooked from the characteristics of the NPS.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing-Based Estimation of Potential Solar PV Power Output Considering the Effects of High Temperature, Dust and Precipitation: Case of the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Satellite-derived solar radiation data provide measurements of surface solar energy available for solar PV power production. However, as solar radiation enters the atmosphere, its interaction with atmospheric constituents causes the attenuation of a significant amount of energy. The advantages of solar PV systems as an alternative for electricity generation are in terms of their scalability and solar cell conversion efficiency. However, environmental factors such as dust accumulation can significantly affect these systems. Precipitation may act as a natural cleaning agent while high temperature reduces cell efficiency and power output. The objective of this study is to estimate the potential of solar PV power (PPV) output in the Philippines using remotely-sensed shortwave radiation (SWR) data from Advanced Himawari Imager (AHI)-8/9 considering the effects of high temperature, dust and precipitation. Results show that a minimum of 195.88 MW and a maximum of 1,147.48 MW effective PPV output on a monthly average basis can be produced, and 440.08 to 899.61 MW on an annual average basis. A decrease in PPV output of up to 38.90% annually and up to 58.85% monthly were observed due to the combined effects of high temperature and dust accumulation in the Philippines. A comparison of the SWR data considering the effects of meteorological factors and actual PV power production data suggests a high correlation in the cities of Baguio <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.8$</tex>, in Cebu <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.8$</tex>, and in Tagum <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{R}^{2}=0.7$</tex> located in the three major Philippine island groups of Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, respectively. This localized study incorporating the meteorological effects suggests that satellite-derived solar radiation measurements can be a good substitute for in-situ data in estimating the solar PV power output.

articleTitle: Toward the Imputation and Prediction of Condition Monitoring Data with Missing Values
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Increasingly situation awareness based on online condition monitoring in the smart grid could enable accurate and time-sensitive cognizance of the power equipment threats, vulnerabilities and impending failures. In this paper, an integrated imputation and prediction for incomplete monitored dissolved gas data of power transformers are presented to extract the multivariate characteristics using a bi-directional generative adversarial network. The generator and discriminator work internally through bi-directional recurrent dynamics to capture the temporal distribution characteristics regarding the rate of gas production, and distribution characteristics regarding coupling relationships among multiple gases. The adversarial mechanism of the generator and discriminator is achieved by custom loss functions, which complete the imputation and prediction tasks by distinguishing between observed and imputed gas concentration values. Moreover, the imputation and prediction are jointly achieved instead of sequentially, where two different test strategies with various missing rates and prediction window sizes are designed, respectively. The experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in the imputation and prediction accuracy for gas concentration with missing values.

articleTitle: Research on Electric Power Spot Market Settlement Mechanism Based on Mid-and-Long Term Contract Physical Delivery
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Based on the construction of electric power spot market in China, this paper firstly studies the main problems of electric power spot market settlement from the perspective of physical delivery of mid-and-long term contracts. Secondly, the paper analyses the function of the physical contract to stabilize the market price risk, and puts forward a settlement mechanism considering the characteristics of power users on the basis of ensuring fairness and realizing the risk avoidance of physical contract. Finally, taking renewable energy as the background of the power system with a high proportion of renewable energy, considering the demand of renewable energy utilization, combined with the mid-and-long term physical contract settlement mechanism, this paper demonstrates the economy and practicability of the proposed settlement mechanism through a case study.

articleTitle: Improved Temporal Convolutional Network Based Ultra-Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate ultra-short-term power predictions are important for eliminating fluctuations in new energy power generation systems. To improve the accuracy of ultra-short-term photovoltaic (PV) power prediction, this paper proposes an ultra-short-term PV power prediction method based on improved temporal convolutional neural (TCN) network and feature modeling. First, the Spearman coefficient is applied to filter existing meteorological features while simultaneously combining solar illumination and the three-dimensional modeling of PV panels to identify the key factors affecting PV power generation and to mine astronomical features that affect PV power prediction. Second, the high correlation between astronomical features and PV power prediction is analyzed based on the correlation coefficient, which theoretically proves the feasibility and necessity of astronomical features. Third, an improved TCN network model is proposed for the algorithm. Multiple experiments indicate that compared with the existing prediction models, the proposed forecasting method is superior, the accuracy of PV power prediction over the next 4 h in the absence of meteorological conditions improves by 20.5%.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Photovoltaic Power Prediction Error Based on TOPSIS Considering the Influence of Cloud Motion
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The comprehensive evaluation of photovoltaic power prediction errors is the basis of improving the prediction model, enhancing the prediction accuracy and providing guidance for the rational application of prediction results, which is of great significance for the safe and economic operation of the new power system containing large-scale renewable energy. Currently, the photovoltaic power prediction mainly adopts mean value evaluation indexes of the 15-minute level, which cannot reflect the influence of the sudden fluctuations on low-inertia power systems and the adaptability of prediction systems at the minute level prediction situation. Therefore, considering the influence of cloud motion on photovoltaic power generation and the corresponding characteristics, this paper proposes a comprehensive evaluation index system including random indexes and volatility indexes. Then, a comprehensive evaluation method of photovoltaic power prediction errors based on technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS) is proposed. Finally, the prediction performance of different prediction models is evaluated comprehensively, which verifies the feasibility of the proposed evaluation method. This evaluation method could provide some theoretical support for the selection of prediction model and performance evaluation of prediction system in a photovoltaic station.

articleTitle: Resilient Transmission Network Hardening Planning Coordinated with Distribution Network Defensive Strategies Against Typhoons
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of active distribution networks, transmission system (TS) and distribution system (DS) can be coordinated to operate in an efficient and secure manner. However, the high-impact and low-probability natural disasters like typhoons can inflict severe damage on the critical infrastructures of power sector such as transmission lines and distribution lines, putting the whole transmission and distribution network under the threat of paralysis. In order to enhance the prevention ability of the integrated transmission and distribution network (ITDN) for typhoons, a resilient transmission network hardening planning (TNHP) model and a distribution network defensive planning (DNDP) model against typhoons are established in this paper, which consider unit commitment in TNHP and the strategies of reconfiguration, islanding, distributed generators (DGs) dispatch in DNDP. To realize the coordination of ITDN's planning, a distributed optimization framework based on alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) algorithm is formulated to implement the resilient integrated planning of TNHP and DNDP by updating their boundary variables. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by numerical results of the modified IEEE-14 test system integrated with modified IEEE-33 test system.

articleTitle: Multi-stage Planning of Park-Level Integrated Energy System Considering Ladder-Type Carbon Emission Trading and Green Certificate Trading
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Based on the interactive mechanism of ladder-type carbon emission trading and green certificate trading, this paper proposes a low-carbon multi-stage planning approach of park-level integrated energy system. Firstly, the operation principles of carbon emission trading and green certificate trading are studied. Then, by analyzing the carbon emission reduction by green certificates, the interactive mechanism between carbon emission trading and green certificate trading is proposed. Finally, the low-carbon multi-stage planning model is established, which considers ladder-type carbon emission trading and green certificate trading with the goal of minimizing the system's full life cycle cost. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach can effectively improve the system's economic efficiency and reduce its carbon emissions.

articleTitle: A DC Interconnection Transformation Method of Low-Voltage Distribution Network Considering Power Outage Risk Assessment in Station Area
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the continuous development of Chinese social economy, users have higher and higher requirements for the power supply reliability of the distribution network. However, under the background of new infrastructure, the large proportion of new energy charging piles in low-voltage distribution network will lead to problems such as unbalanced transformer load rate and voltage violation. In addition, the medium-voltage distribution line affected by trees will lead to the power loss in the low-voltage distribution area, which brings new challenges to the safe operation of the low-voltage distribution network. Flexible DC interconnection based on Voltage Source Converter (VSC) has the ability of flexible power regulation, so a DC interconnection transformation method of low-voltage distribution network considering the risk assessment of outage is proposed. Firstly, the power outage risk assessment method based on analytic hierarchy process is used to select the distribution area with high power outage risk. Secondly, the VSC is used to connect the distribution area with high power outage risk to realize the flexible control of the power range of the two distribution areas. Finally, the CloudPSS-IESLab2 software is used to analyze the power quality before and after the DC interconnection transformation. The rationality of the proposed DC interconnection modification method is verified by simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Identification and Analysis for Price Multiplicity in Multi-Interval Real-Time Market
