publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of “Double Carbon” targets and building a new power system, the intertemporal coupling of the power system is increasingly important. Many independent system operators (ISOs) have already implemented or are planning to implement multi-interval real-time market (MIRTM). As a typical issue in LMP-based electricity markets, price multiplicity has been widely studied, but its characteristics and identification method in MIRTM remain to be explored. This paper explores the new characteristics and identification method of price multiplicity in MIRTM. Firstly, a mathematical model for the multi-interval economic dispatch is established, and several common multi-interval pricing mechanisms are introduced. Next, a mathematical model for price multiplicity in MIRTM is established, and an efficient and accurate identification method is developed based on this model. Finally, case studies are conducted to verify the effectiveness and high computational efficiency of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A V2G Schedulable Capacity Evaluation Method for Residential Quarters with a High Proportion of EVs
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Evaluation of the schedulable capacity of EVs (EVSC) is a crucial stage in the development of V2G technology to take advantage of the benefits of EVs as distributed energy storage. If the EVSC can be accurately assessed and used to serve the frequency response of residential electricity consumption and the power grid, it will play a role in peak shaving and valley filling, achieving a win-win situation for the power grid and users. This is especially true in residential quarters with a high proportion of EVs. In this paper, based on the formation principle of schedulable capacity and the V2G electricity model, an EVSC evaluation method is suggested for residential quarters. Also, the significant role that V2G schedulable capacity plays in reducing peak demand is examined from the standpoint of the potential of electric power autonomy in residential quarters. The suggested EVSC evaluation model and associated theories are examined and validated using an actual residential quarter as an example. The robustness of the model is examined by the solution of the EVSC using various scheduling time scales.

articleTitle: Learning-Based Micro Energy Storage System Control for Voltage Governance in Rural Areas
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The low voltage problem in rural grids is becoming increasingly serious due to the rapid growth of customer load demand. In order to reduce the reconstruction cost and avoid affecting the experience of users in nearby stations, micro energy storage system (mESS) is adopted to manage the voltage issue by power compensation. Due to the limited energy storage capacity, the charge/discharge regulation is challenging in supporting long-term and high quality voltage. To this end, we propose a learning-based mESS control (LmEC) strategy in this paper, through which the voltage regulation supporting time for rural grids can be extended significantly. In specific, the long-term voltage governance problem is formulated, and modeled as a Markov game for stepwise working mode and target output selection of the mESS. Considering that the action range is continuous, we devise a learning-based solution based on deep deterministic parametric policy. To verify the efficacy of LmEC, numerical experiments are conducted based on a real dataset from rural grid station in Hubei, China. Results show that the proposed strategy can not only mitigate the low voltage problem, but also enable the mESS to maintain long-term supporting capability.

articleTitle: Analysis of Multiple Source Load Characteristics and Its Impact on the Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The high proportion of multiple source load connections has become a prominent feature of the current distribution network development. An accurate quantitative analysis of the impact of multiple source loads on the distribution network, so as to ensure the safe and stable operation of the distribution network, is a problem that needs to be solved urgently. In this paper, a method is proposed to analyse the characteristics of multiple source loads and their impact on the distribution network. Firstly, the characteristics of multiple source loads in the distribution network are analysed; secondly, a method is proposed to analyse the spatio-temporal characteristics and correlation of multiple source loads, based on the Copula theory to analyse the correlation of multiple source loads; secondly, a method is proposed to analyse the impact of multiple source loads on the technical indexes of the distribution network to quantify the impact caused by the grid connection of multiple source loads; finally, an example analysis is used to verify Finally, the validity of the proposed method is verified by using case studies.

articleTitle: Research on Orderly Charging of Electric Vehicles Considering Renewable Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Optimizing and scheduling electric vehicles is crucial for achieving system-wide multi-energy complementarity and economic operation. However, renewable energy's intermittency and the uncertainty of user energy demand result in random fluctuations in the system's supply and demand sides, making it challenging for traditional scheduling methods to adapt to the actual environment's dynamic changes. To address this issue, this paper proposes a real-time dynamic scheduling strategy that takes into account electric vehicles and renewable energy. The strategy minimizes operating costs by considering user charging demand, renewable energy output, and dynamic time-of-use electricity prices in a joint operation model. We use the proximal policy optimization algorithm (PPO) to select appropriate state and action spaces for the real-time scheduling problem and design a reward function to train the agent offline. Finally, we test the strategy using the offline-trained model and observe significant reduction in the operating cost of the distribution network and improved absorption of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Rapid Assessment of Distribution Systems Resilience Based on Analytical Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, extreme natural disasters have highlighted the inadequacy of traditional reliability requirements for distribution systems in facing low-probability, high-impact, large-scale failures. To address this issue, this paper presents a rapid resilience assessment method based on analytical approach for distribution systems. Commencing with the distribution system topology, this paper introduces the cell model to reduce the analysis complexity. Three kinds of indicators are utilized to describe the distribution system resilience. Using power supply paths to analyze cell response to extreme disasters at different stages, this paper obtains the analytical expressions of the assessment indicators that can be computerized. Numerical tests demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed assessment method and provide suggestions for enhancing distribution system resilience.

articleTitle: Anomalous Update Identification Based on Cosine Similarity for Collaborative Wind Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Wind power forecasting based on spatial correlation works in a collaborative way to exploit the information of neighboring wind farms to improve the overall forecasting accuracy, but the collaborative forecasting approach needs to centralize the original data of each site, which leads to the problem of data privacy preservation. The Federated Learning framework is applied to collaborative wind power forecasting, allowing the original data of each site to be stored locally for data privacy preservation. A method of identifying sites with anomalous update based on cosine similarity is proposed, based on which anomalous sites are eliminated in the subsequent collaborative forecasting process based on federated learning. A case study from 30 wind farms demonstrates that the proposed approach is effective to identify sites with anomalous update and achieves a forecasting accuracy consistent with the normal situation after eliminating the anomalous sites.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection of Wind Turbine Generator Based on LSTM and Kshape Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Anomaly detection of wind turbine generators helps to detect faults of related components in advance, thus improving the economy and reliability of wind farm operation. This paper presents a generator anomaly detection method using long short-term memory neural network (LSTM) and Kshape clustering algorithm. This work first considers the characteristics of wind turbine supervisory control and data acquisition(SCADA) data, proposes a feature analysis method combining correlation coefficients and feature ranking, then the Kshape clustering algorithm is used to select wind turbines with similar operating states to expand the training dataset. Anomaly detection state estimation model is constructed by combining well-performanced LSTM models trained by selected units' dataset. Finally, the feasibility and accuracy of the proposed method are verified based on the SCADA data of actual wind farms.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Operation Model of Customer-Side Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Customer-side integrated energy system energy efficiency improvement is an effective path to achieve China's dual carbon goal. The current research on energy efficiency optimization of customer-side integrated energy systems is relatively single, and only model optimization is carried out unilaterally for high efficiency or combining high efficiency with economy. Based on this, this paper constructs a customer-side integrated energy system energy efficiency optimization operation model with three objective functions economy, environmental protection, and high efficiency. A typical industrial scenario containing electricity-heat-gas-cooling load is selected for example analysis, and the objective is solved by particle swarm algorithm and NSGA-II algorithm and compared for analysis, and the optimal total cost under the typical industrial scenario is calculated to be about 46 million RMB. It provides a reference for related parties to explore the optimization and enhancement of customer-side integrated energy system operation from multiple perspectives and also enriches the research results in the field of energy efficiency of customer-side integrated energy systems in China.

articleTitle: A Non-Destructive Flaw Detection Diagnosis Model for Transmission Lines Based on UAV Charged X-Ray Intelligent Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Multi-bundle conductors of transmission lines are vulnerable to damage in complex natural environment and operation mode. Traditional flaw detection methods need to consume a lot of labor costs, and the accuracy and efficiency of flaw detection diagnosis are low. UAV technology can complete the task of low-cost transmission line patrol, and cooperate with X-ray intelligent detection technology to carry out live operation, which provides a new way for non-destructive flaw detection diagnosis of transmission lines. It also provides a new scheme for the development of power cyber physical system. This paper proposes a non-destructive flaw detection diagnosis model for transmission lines based on UAV live X-ray intelligent detection. Firstly, the visual image is collected by UAV live X-ray intelligent detection equipment, and the image analysis model of non-destructive testing of transmission lines was established. Then, based on the damage characteristics of transmission lines, a non-destructive testing diagnosis model of transmission lines based on UAV live X-ray intelligent detection is established. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by analyzing the simulation case of acquiring images.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Short-Term Wind Power Forecasting Method Based on Data-Physical Hybrid-Driven Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The ultra-short-term wind power forecasting provides key technical support for unit control and economic dispatch of power systems. To fully exploit the advantages of the data-driven model and the physically driven model in wind power prediction, a data-physical hybrid-driven ultra-short-term wind power forecasting model is proposed. For the time point when wind speed fluctuates violently, the wind-power conversion model is constructed according to the inertial operation characteristics of the unit, which is a physically driven prediction model. Aiming at the smooth power output stage, an ultra-short-term wind power forecasting framework based on a temporal attention network is proposed, which is a data-driven model. Based on the wind speed fluctuation characteristics, a switching mechanism between the physical-driven model and the data-driven model is established. Experimental validation was conducted at a wind farm in Inner Mongolia, China, and the root-mean-square error of the proposed method was less than 13% for prediction in the fourth hour of the future. The results of the study show that the proposed method can effectively improve ultra-short-term wind power prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Configuration Optimization Methods for the Energy Storage Capacity of Wind, Photovoltaic, Hydrogen and Energy Storage Off-Grid Systems with Stability and Economy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the capacity planning problem of wind and photovoltaic power hydrogen energy storage off-grid systems, this paper proposes a method for optimizing the configuration of energy storage capacity that takes into account stability and economy. In this paper, an impedance network model for the off-grid system was established, through which the open loop transfer function and close loop transfer function were derived. Besides, the constraints on the stability margin of the off-grid system were realized by constraining the pole distribution of the system. Based on the key constraints of off-grid system operation, this paper took the minimum system construction costs as the target function, and established an electrochemical energy storage and hydrogen energy storage capacity configuration optimization model. For specific examples, the particle swarm optimization algorithm was utilized to optimize and solve the configuration optimization model, and the solution results proved the effectiveness and rationality of the strategy proposed in this paper.

Author Keywords: wind and photovoltaic hydrogen energy storage

articleTitle: Joint Planning of Multi-Type Energy Storages and Flexible Resources for High-Penetration Renewable Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of renewable energy, how to balance the power supply and demand economically and effectively has become an important issue for power systems. Under this circumstance, it is necessary to consider the utilization of flexible resources (FRs) in power system planning. In this paper, a joint planning method of multi-type energy storage systems (ESSs) and flexible resources is proposed, considering the seasonal energy balance of power systems, different balance periods of ESSs as well as the differences of flexibility of FRs among multiple days. Firstly, several typical demand-side flexible resources are modeled, and an aggregate boundary model is adopted to unify the various flexible resources into aggregate feasible region. Then, a planning model for multi-type ESSs and FRs is proposed, which embeds an annual operation simulation of the power system. Energy of ESSs is separated into inter-day energy and intra-day energy to describe the seasonal energy balance of the power system. Thirdly, an acceleration strategy based on hierarchical clustering is proposed. Finally, the proposed method is tested using HRP-38 system. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Forecasting with Adversarial Domain Adaptation Based LSTM Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Electric load forecasting technologies determine the constraints of power supply to balance the demand in optimizing power system operation. The load demand becomes uncertain as the statistical characteristics/distributions of power consumption frequently change due to higher turnovers of consumers, such as temporary tenants flowing into or out of apartments. Hence, this study focuses on the dynamic load whose historical consumption readings are limited following a unique characteristic and whose power demand is thus hard to predict. Motivated by the implicit continuity each time the characteristic changes (i.e., distribution shifts), we introduce an adversarial domain adaptation based on the deep recurrent neural architecture for the dynamic load in a specific period. The domain adaptation learns the statistical shift from labeled records of prolonged historical loads and the target load in a data-driven manner so that the architecture can finally only utilize limited records to accurately predict the demand for the target load. Finally, we generated synthetic profiles with the developed model and other leading methods, e.g., support vector regression (SVR), gradient boosting decision tree (GBDT), random forest (RF), fully-connected feedforward neural network (FFNN), long short-term memory (LSTM) recurrent neural network (RNN), gated recurrent unit (GRU) RNN, sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) RNN, and Transformer neural network, and compared them with true values. Experimental results confirmed the effectiveness of using domain adaptation and transfer learning.

articleTitle: State-of-Charge Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries Based on Data-Model Fusion Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Li-ion batteries (LIBs) State of Charge (SOC) estimation is essential to guarantee the secure and dependable use of the battery as well as to achieve rational battery energy management. In this paper, data-driven with battery equivalent circuit models are integrated to achieve battery SOC estimation. More convincing criteria are chosen to demonstrate the reliability of the estimation. First, preliminary SOC prediction is achieved using current with voltage from the cell dynamic stress test (DST) dataset, combined with a nonlinear autoregressive structure with exogenous inputs (NARX) and an extreme learning machine (ELM) stochastic learning algorithm. Then, on the basis of the constructed 2RC equivalent circuit model (ECM), SOC prediction and the polarization voltage of the equivalent circuit are used as state variables to achieve battery SOC estimation using extended Kalman filtering (EKF). Finally, using the dynamic US06 highway driving program as well as federal urban driving schedule (FUDS) test datasets, in various temperatures (range of -10°C to 50°C with 10°C bins), the precision and robustness of the presented SOC estimation approach are verified. The outcomes demonstrate that the presented approach is more realistic and reliable at each temperature compared to the SOC estimates obtained using data-driven only.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control and Operation Stability Analysis of Multi-port DC Substation Applied in Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: DC distribution system has been accepted as a promising solution for future power system construction. The multiport DC substation severing as dc hub in intricate meshed grid takes role of energy routing and voltage dispatching. In this article, an overall control strategy is proposed for a multiport dc substation applied in city power distribution system and enables to achieve transmitted power coordinate control with four terminals connected with dc grids. Operation stability research on DC substation under different working conditions are conducted based on generation Nyquist criterion (GNC) and D-Q small-signal impedance model derived in a uniform rotating coordinate. Besides, accuracy of theoretical impedance model is validated by measurements in Matlab/Simulink. Finally, simulation results are carried out in PLECS to test the working performance of the multiport DC substation under coordinated control and verify correctness of analysis on operation stability.

articleTitle: Decentralized Coordinated Robust Dispatch of Multi-Area Interconnected Integrated Electricity and Heating System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of wind power generation, wind power curtailment is becoming increasingly serious. In order to improve wind power accommodation capacity, more flexibility resources that can be utilized by electrical power system (EPS) need to be identified. This paper proposed a decentralized coordinated robust dispatch model of multi-area integrated electricity and heating system (IEHS), considering the dynamic characteristics of district heating network (DHN) and flexibility from interconnected IEHS transferred though tie-line. Meanwhile, the risk of wind power accommodation is also considered to balance the operational costs and risk costs. The alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM) is applied to solve the coordinated robust dispatch of multi-area IEHS. The results of the case studies show that the proposed model can optimize the allocation of power generation and flexibility resources in multi-area interconnected system, realize multi-area interconnected system flexibility sharing and effectively reducing operating costs.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Scheduling Considering Multiple Park-Level Integrated Energy Systems Cooperation in Uncertain Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the carbon-constrained background, the energy exchange of multiple park-level integrated energy systems (PIESs) in same regions can contribute to carbon reduction and economy improvement. However, it is challenging to design the reasonable carbon trading mechanism to manage total carbon emissions, and PIESs face the problems of interest conflicts and the uncertainties of renewable energy sources (RES) in the energy exchange process. To this end, a cooperative scheduling model for PIESs based on the ladder carbon trading mechanism in uncertain environment is proposed in this paper to promote the low-carbon scheduling and achieve benefits coordination among PIESs. Firstly, the dispatch framework of PIESs with the situation awareness technology is constructed to address uncertainties of RES, thus helping system mitigate uncertain risks. Then, the low-carbon scheduling model based on ladder carbon trading mechanism is established to better manage total carbon emissions of system. Furthermore, the energy exchange processes of multiple PIESs are modelled by introducing cooperative game theory, and Shapley value is utilized to avoid the interest conflict. Finally, case studies certify the effectiveness of the proposed model in promoting the realization of low-carbon target and improving the economic performance.

articleTitle: Electricity Trading Strategy for Home Users Based on Coalition Cooperation Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Only by optimizing the energy storage and electric vehicle charging and discharging behavior of a single home user, its operation pattern has low consumption rate of renewable energy and low utilization rate of energy storage, which cannot solve the problem of power supply and demand imbalance of multiple home users in the user group. Therefore, this paper proposes a power trading strategy of home users based on coalition cooperative game. The load model of prosumer including wind power, photovoltaic, energy storage and electric vehicles are constructed, and on this basis, the cooperative game model of home-home user trading price coalition is proposed, and the characteristic function of cooperative game is calculated as the basis of the benefit distribution of home users. The simulation results show that the trading strategy can effectively motivate home users to participate in power trading in the power sharing user group composed of small-scale home users, and bring considerable benefits to consumers and prosumers.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecast Based on Similar Daily Retrieval and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Load forecasting of power system is of great significance for the safety and stability of power grid and the improvement of economic benefits. In view of the continuity and similarity of historical data of load changes, a short-term load forecasting method based on similar daily retrieval and deep learning is proposed in this paper. This method firstly constructs daily feature vectors based on the Person correlation coefficient, grey correlation analysis and other methods, and then searches for similar days using comprehensive similarity as training samples for deep belief networks. By setting the number of hidden layer neurons and the number of iterations, it achieves the purpose of improving prediction accuracy and generalization. Finally, the prediction results were evaluated by MAPE and other indicators.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Integrated Electricity-Gas Systems Considering Hydrogen Injection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal operation method for integrated electricity-gas systems (IEGSs) considering hydrogen injection. First, the low-carbon operation mechanism (LCOM) is developed incorporating carbon capture, power-to-gas and hydrogen enriched compressed natural gas (HCNG) technologies. Second, a united HCNG energy flow model is proposed, including the modellings of pipeline flow, compressors, gas-fired units, and nodal gas flow balance, in which the strong coupling relationship between hydrogen volume fraction and HCNG energy flow model is captured. Then, a low-carbon dispatch model for IEGSs is developed based on the proposed LCOM and HCNG energy flow model, which minimizes the system operation cost while maintaining both gas pressure and HCNG flow rate within acceptable ranges. Furthermore, the model linearization methodology incorporating the piecewise linearization method and Taylor expansion are developed, which reformulates the dispatch model as a tractable mixed-integer linear programming problem. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model and method are verified in case studies.

articleTitle: Integration of Distributed Energy Resources into a Virtual Power Plant-A Pilot Project in Dubai
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The high penetration of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) brings new challenges in the operation of the power grid such as generation-demand imbalance, voltage violations, reverse power flow, etc. To address the aforementioned challenges, Virtual Power Plant (VPP) can be used, which would be best deployed as a cloud-based system due to its ease of implementation, scalability, and ease of service and support. VPP can effectively integrate, aggregate, optimize, control, and dispatch various Behind-The-Meter (BTM) DERs to support grid operations. Therefore, this work discusses the integration and control of DERs such as rooftop solar PV, electric vehicle charging stations, flexible loads, and battery energy storage systems (BESS) through a VPP platform that has been implemented on a pilot scale in Dubai. The connectivity of the VPP with DERs has been established using an Internet of Things (IoT) gateway as well as cloud-to-cloud communication via REST application programming interface (API). The test results are presented to show the response of various DERs based on the instructions through the VPP platform. The current work forms the basis for future work to scale up the VPP connectivity with DERs on a larger network and evaluate the best-suited VPP use cases for the Dubai power network.

articleTitle: Research on SoC Architecture Model and its Application in BMS Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: According to the different application requirements in different scenarios, the design of system-on-chip hardware architecture is anisotropic, lacking a unified description of system-on-chip architecture components, as well as unified guidance and standards for design of each part. In this paper, a pentagon architecture model of system-on-chip design centered on kernel computing power, memory, peripheral interface, internal bus and power consumption is proposed. Based on this model, three typical architecture designs of system-on-chip are given by taking safety fault warning, charge and discharge control and battery state monitoring as examples, which provides qualitative theoretical guidance for architecture design of system-on-chip. This work has certain guiding significance for the demand-based system-on-chip architecture design in battery manage system scenarios.

articleTitle: The Effect of Renewable Energy Development and Market-Oriented Reform on Low-carbon Transformation of Power Industry: An Agent-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy and deepening of market-oriented reforms, the low-carbon transformation of the power sector will be influenced by various factors such as market rules, individual investment preferences, and government planning. This will lead to the transformation process deviating from the optimal low-cost path, resulting in diverse development forms. To quantify the impact of these factors on the low-carbon transformation process, this paper constructs an agent-based model of electricity low-carbon transformation, which incorporates multi-entity market behavior of the power source-grid-load, power structure evolution, and government low-carbon development planning. Through scenario setting and numerical simulation, the changes in various parameters during the evolution process of regional power systems are explored. The case analysis shows that due to the difference in capacity cost and utilization rate, full-quantity price-guaranteed grid connection is more advantageous for photovoltaic power, while participating in the electricity market is more advantageous for wind power. The participation of renewable energy sources in the electricity market will gradually reduce the utilization hours of thermal power generators and help to lower the average electricity price, avoiding the transfer of the increased electricity generation cost due to thermal power carbon capture technology renovation to users, and bringing significant social benefits.

articleTitle: Coordinated Optimization Scheduling of Geo-Distributed Multiple Data Centers and Electricity Retailers Based on Cooperative Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the number of internet data centers (IDC) increases, the energy consumption of modern data centers is growing rapidly, which takes an increasing part of the global electricity consumption. In implementation, to cover the electricity consumption and reduce the electricity bill, data centers are often deployed with renewable energy, energy storage system (ESS) and conventional generators, which has brought the characteristics of both flexible electricity load and micro grid to the data centers. Therefore, the data center micro grids can adjust its operations according to the real time electricity price and cut down the operational cost. However, the rising of electricity will force the data center to start up the conventional generators, which leads to the increment of operational cost. In view of this, we propose a coordinated operation scheduling method of multiple distributed data centers and electricity retailers based on cooperative game theory. In this method, a cooperative game union comprised of the data centers and the electricity retailers is established to minimize the total cost. And the extra income of the alliance is distributed using the Shapley value method. A simulation is launched on Gurobi software, and the results have illustrated that the proposed method can reduce the data center operational cost by 8.9% to 13.5%.

articleTitle: Wind-storage Control Strategy Considering the Electro-Thermal Coupling Characteristics of Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: When large-scale wind power is connected to the grid through overhead transmission lines (OTLs), it will cause the problem of power fluctuation and line transmission capacity exceeding the limit, which seriously endangers the stable operation of power system. In this paper, reasonable wind abandonment is carried out to meet the transmission capacity constraint based on electro-thermal coupling theory. Meanwhile, the output power after wind abandonment is stabilized by hybrid energy storage to further meet the requirements of wind power grid-connected volatility. First, the wind-storage integration model is established. Then, based on the electro-thermal coupling theory, a wind abandonment strategy is established to meet the transmission capacity constraints of the OTLs, which uses real-time meteorological parameters to calculate the standard of wind abandonment. Then, taking the output power after wind abandonment as input, a wind-storage control strategy based on hybrid energy storage is established, which can adjust wind power output to meet the constraints of wind power grid-connected volatility. Finally, case analysis shows that the proposed strategy can not only realize the safe grid-connection of wind power, but also reasonably distribute the hybrid energy storage power instructions.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Microgrid Distributed Optimization Operation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of national economy leads to the severe expansion of power consumption and the scale of power grids, coupled with the continuous reduction of non-renewable energy such as fossil energy, etc., people have high expectations for the efficient use of clean energy. In order to cope with the shortcomings of large power grids that are likely to spread to the whole network once a failure occurs due to the strong integrity of the large power grid, and the efficient use of new energy, multi-micro grid distributed power generation has occurred to our mind. Currently, there are two mainstream control strategies for microgrids, one is centralized algorithm and the other is distributed algorithm. The two algorithms have their own advantages and disadvantages. However, with the continuous development and expansion of the power grid, the centralized algorithm is increasingly burdened by the system, and gradually becomes inefficient and slow in response and process. Aiming at the multi-microgrid distributed system in the grid-connected operation state, this paper proposes optimization goals by constructing mathematical models for each part of the microgrid and the main grid. Finally, a case analysis is carried out based on the IEEE33 node model, and the calculation of the application of the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is discussed. Analyzes the feasibility, advantages and disadvantages of the ADMM algorithm in the distributed optimization operation of multi-microgrid, the results show that the ADMM algorithm has a well feasibility in the distributed optimization operation of multi- microgrid.

articleTitle: Global Attention-Based Approach for Substation Devices Classification and Localization
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurately identifying various electrical devices is crucial for the safe and stable operation of substations. However, the size of devices in substations varies, and some devices have similar appearances, which often leads to inspection errors. To address these issues, we designed the path aggregation network with global attention mechanism (GAM-PAN). Considering the scale variation of electrical devices in images, the path aggregation module is introduced to fuse the multi-scale features. To address the problem of recognizing similar devices, global attention mechanism (GAM) is s embedded into the feature aggregation module. The GAM enhances the fusion features of similar devices and reconstructs the fused feature maps. In addition, a transfer learning strategy is adapted to train GAM-PAN, which speeds up the convergence rate of the network. GAM-PAN is tested on a substation multi-device dataset (SMDD) and achieves a detection accuracy of 84.32%, compared to four classical object detection methods. Furthermore, it was verified that global attention can effectively solve the problem of recognizing similar targets.

articleTitle: Source-Load Integrated Optimization for Distributed Energy System Considering Low-Carbon Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Carbon emissions from the distributed energy system account for more than 40% of the global total CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions. Carbon reduction in the power industry is one of the most effective measures to deal with global warming problems. To address this challenge, we consider the transformation of high carbon emission power plant into carbon capture power plants (CCPPs) on the source side, adopting the flexible operation mode to capture the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> generated by the system. Moreover, Low-carbon demand response (LCDR) is introduced to replace the traditional demand response on the load side, which changes the user's electricity consumption behavior by the dynamic carbon emission factor as a guide signal. We further propose a low-carbon economic scheduling method of source-load synergy and construct a low-carbon economic dispatch model considering the optimal comprehensive cost of distributed energy system. The positive impact of this method on reducing the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emission of the system is analyzed and the efficiency of wind power utilization is improved. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by simulation in the standard IEEE 39 bus test system.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Adversarial Deep Forecasting Model for Load Demand Using Hybrid Modified DA-GAN
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Extreme weather conditions can have a significant impact on the electricity load demand and energy management programs and thus can cause unexpected blackouts in the systems. To predict electricity load demand in extreme weather conditions, it is important to consider the different weather historical data in the analysis. This paper proposes an intelligent adversarial model for prediction of the consumers' electric load demand in the extreme weather condition. By analyzing past extreme weather events and the associated electricity load demand, a new predictive deep learning model developed that can be used to estimate electricity load demand in the future extreme weather conditions. The proposed model is constructed based on the generative adversarial network (GAN) and dragonfly algorithm (DA) to make a precise prediction. The generator network is trained to produce data that are similar to the extreme weather data, while the discriminator is trained to correctly classify real data from generated ones. A new modified DA is suggested to enhance the GAN training through an iterative process. The real dataset of weather and load in California over the years 2015–2020 are used to examine the accuracy of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Multi-Timescale Coordinated Scheduling Approach for Active Distribution Network Considering Wind Generation Correlation Analysis and Improved MPC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the enhanced permeability of renewable energy, the power current distribution of the distribution network changes, and the variability of renewable energy generation results in power fluctuations on the distribution network, which significantly impacts the operation of distribution network. Therefore, this paper proposes multi-timescale coordinated scheduling approach considering wind generation correlation analysis and improved model predictive control (MPC). Firstly, based on copula correlation analysis, correlation model of predictive error between multiple wind farms and different time periods is formed, aiming at capturing the stochastic character of wind generation output more accurately. According to the accuracy of prediction data at different time scales, this paper selects different optimization methods. Furtherly, a novel multi-timescale dispatching method is established. In the day-ahead and intraday scheduling stages, stochastic optimization method is adopted to minimize operation cost based on the scenario method. In the real-time stage, deterministic optimization method is adopted to minimize the power fluctuation between the distribution network and the transmission network. Therefore, it can ensure that the distribution network has the minimal power fluctuation between the transmission network under the premise of the lowest operating cost. Then, due to the characteristic of MPC scheme and system operation, an improved MPC method is proposed to further limit the fluctuation of exchange power between the transmission and distribution networks. Finally, the simulation verifies the results.

articleTitle: CVaR-Constrained Robust Unit Commitment for Power System with Concentrating Solar Power
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) constrained robust unit commitment model with concentrating solar power (CSP) is proposed to address the uncertainties arising from large-scale renewable energy integration. Firstly, the principle of CSP is analyzed, and the mathematical model of CSP in steady-state is established. Secondly, CVaR is introduced to measure the risk of loss caused by wind power uncertainty. Then, a CVaR-constrained robust unit commitment model for power system with CSP is formulated, and a multidimensional uncertainty set is used to tradeoff between the robustness and the conservatism of the model. The model is transformed into a mixed integer linear programming model by linearization and solved using the column and constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified on the IEEE 6-bus system and IEEE 118-bus system.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Robust Scheduling Optimization of an Energy Hub with Multiple Chance Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Global environmental degradation and energy crisis have become more serious in recent years. The development and utilization of renewable energy (RE) have become a research hotspot. The multi-energy system, as an efficient and flexible energy supply method, is an effective way to improve the utilization of RE energy and achieve emission reduction. Due to the increased coupling between various energy sources, the dispatch of multi-energy systems becomes very complex. Energy hubs (EH) are introduced to describe the coupling relationship between different energy sources in the multi-energy system. The existing researches on EH mainly focus on the modeling and the capacity optimization of internal components, lacking the study of energy scheduling problems that consider the uncertainty of RE generation. Thus, a two-stage stochastic program for energy dispatch is developed in this paper for EH systems with RE penetration. Combining Bonferroni's inequality with the conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) allows an easily tractable conservative approximation. In the simulation part, the optimization results of the energy dispatch at the input side and individual components are obtained. The results can provide important basic information for future operation optimization of EH systems under a high percentage of renewable energy penetration.

articleTitle: Commutation Fault Identification of UHVDC Transmission System Based on Dissipated Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Commutation failure is a common fault in UHVDC transmission systems that use grid commutation converters. If commutation failure occurs, it will cause DC power fluctuations and perhaps a DC lockout, endangering the grid's ability to function safely and steadily. Therefore, it is critical to correctly and promptly diagnose the failure and implement the necessary controls to prevent commutation failure from happening in the later stage. This paper first uses MATLAB/SIMULINK to build the simulation model of UHVDC transmission system, and then the different types of faults on the inverter side commutation bus are simulated. To determine the faulty type of commutation failure, this paper proposes a commutation failure identification method of UHVDC transmission system based on dissipated energy, the outcomes demonstrate that this method is cable of correctly determine the commutation failure type brought on by a commutation bus fault.

articleTitle: Forms of the Energy Internet Under Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The Energy Internet (EI) has the potential to drive the energy revolution forward. The EI efficiently transmits energy and information through the integration of information technology and energy technology. Digitalization efforts can reduce costs, improve energy utilization, and enable real-time matching of energy supply and demand. Furthermore, digital technology can enhance the adaptability of the EI to decentralized, large-scale, and intelligent application scenarios. This paper reviews EI technologies and discusses its future functional and physical forms in the context of digital transformation.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy System Multi-Horizon Investment Optimization Considering Grid and Renewable Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-horizon investment optimization model for an integrated energy system (IES). The model aims to optimize the investment decisions of an energy system, including thermal plant, wind farm, solar farm, energy storage system, energy converter, given static load and controllable load profiles, considering grid limitations and renewable energy penetration and penetration utilization ratio. The model calculates the annualized investment costs of different energy components, using mixed integer linear programming (MILP) to model component-level and global constraints. The optimized investments prioritize energy sources and grid energy to meet the increasing demand while maintaining stability. The proposed model is applied to a case study in different scenarios and demonstrated significant improvement in the utilization rate of renewable energy and satisfied grid constraints compared to the traditional investment approach.

articleTitle: Green Low-Carbon Evaluation Method Based on Optimal Combination Weighting of Moment Estimation Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the deepening understanding of the concept and connotation of low-carbon economy, the evaluation index system of low-carbon economy, which measures the level of economic development from a low-carbon perspective, has received extensive attention. However, there is a lack of a systematic and comprehensive green low-carbon evaluation index system that combines the actual situation of enterprises. Therefore, this paper first establishes a two-layer comprehensive evaluation index system for green low-carbon enterprises, and then proposes an optimal combination weighting based on moment estimation theory to realize the integration of subjective and objective weighting of each index. Finally, taking a power enterprise as a case, an example analysis is carried out. Through the proposed comprehensive weight correction method combining subjective weight and objective weight, the comprehensive score of the evaluation object is increased from 63.5 points to 82.51 points, which is 30% higher than the green low-carbon evaluation benchmark score. It fully reflects the subjective attention and implementation intensity of the participating enterprises to the green low-carbon development, and can play a better role in encouraging and guiding. The validity of the established model and calculation method is also verified.

articleTitle: Centralization-distributed Control Strategy for Medium and Low Voltage AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the continuous development of DC power distribution technology, AC-DC hybrid distribution network based on Voltage Source Converter (VSC) becomes the future development trend. In this paper, the centralization-distributed control strategy of medium and low voltage AC/DC hybrid distribution network for new source-charge access is studied. Medium voltage distribution network and low voltage distribution network are optimized to maximize economy and minimize power fluctuation respectively. Considering the differences of network structure, control equipment and control time scale of medium and low voltage distribution network, corresponding optimization control models are built respectively to realize the cooperative control of medium and low voltage AC-DC hybrid distribution network. The effectiveness of the proposed strategy in suppressing voltage fluctuation on low-voltage side and improving the absorption capacity of Photovoltaic (PV) is verified by the medium voltage 27-node medium voltage AC-DC hybrid power distribution system.

Author Keywords: Medium and low voltage distribution network

articleTitle: Joint Generation and Voyage Scheduling for All-Electric Ships Considering the Impact of Wind and Wave
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: An all-electric ship (AES) can act as an island microgrid while sailing at sea. During AES sailing, wind and waves can have an impact on speed, which in turn can affect the on-time rate of the ship's arrival at the port. Aiming at the economic and environmental scheduling problem of ship microgrid, this paper considers the influence of wind and waves on ship speed during navigation, to establish a ship generation and voyage joint optimization scheduling model. The economic and environmental objectives are minimized while meeting the ship navigation, generator constraints. Furthermore, the role of energy storage system is evaluated. The multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO) algorithm is used to optimize the generator output power and the charging and discharging power of the energy storage system as well as the ship's speed by considering the effects of wind and waves. The comparative experiments prove that the access of energy storage system can improve the economy and environmental protection of ships. According to the principle of Pareto dominance, a set of complete Pareto compromise solutions are found.

articleTitle: Short-Term Wind Power Prediction Based on Variational Mode Decomposition and Hybrid Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Due to the widespread use of wind energy worldwide, driven by its cleanliness and renewability. And the instability of wind power can have a major impact on the grid. In this study, the combination prediction model based on improved LSTM and improved BPNN was proposed. Firstly, the raw data were decomposed into components using variational modal decomposition, which can This effectively reduces complexity and facilitates feature extraction. Then, in order to reduce the error accumulation when predicting each component separately, the Sample Entropy (SE) and Fuzzy Entropy (FE) were respectively used to calculate the complexity of the components and reconstruct them. Finally, based on the complexity of the new sequence, both improved LSTM and improved BP were used for prediction. The results showed that the reconstructed mean square error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) were reduced by 0.3989 and 0.1981 compared to a single prediction, and the computation time was reduced by two-thirds. To verify the effectiveness of the hybrid prediction model, its prediction results were compared with six different prediction results. The results showed that the model had the best predictive performance and obtained the smallest performance evaluation metrics: MSE=0.1159, RMSE=0.3404, MAE=0.2447, and MAPE=0.0629. In addition, the model had the highest Spearman correlation coefficient of 99.79<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> between the predicted and true values.

articleTitle: Identification of Vulnerable Components Link in Electric-Gas Coupling Integrated Energy System Based on Maximum Flow Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of technology, integrated energy systems have emerged as a promising approach for constructing sustainable and low-carbon energy systems. However, due to the intricate coupling among multiple energy subsystems, the operation of these systems is subject to higher requirements regarding stability and safety. In this paper, we propose a method for identifying vulnerable components in integrated energy systems with electric-gas coupling under intentional attacks, using the maximum flow theory. Specifically, we derive the distribution factor of gas network flow transmission, incorporate the upper limit of line capacity, and establish line transmission contribution indices based on maximum flow theory and node transmission contribution indices based on entropy theory. These indices are utilized to identify the vulnerable components of the integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Feature Extraction of PV Output for Optimal Design of a PV-ES Combined System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Photovoltaic power output has apparent periodicity according to the solar power by nature, and this feature always shows different fluctuation features depending on various weather conditions, which bring much challenge when it is integrated to grid. Combine Energy Storage System (ESS) to power station so as to establish a PV-ES Combined System is one of the appropriate solutions. As ESS is costly according to current technology, the capacity and power flow should be sized considering the economic and efficient issues. In this paper, after weather type clustering, the fluctuation features of real-time solar power output data are studied according to Combined Empirical Mode Decomposition (CEMD) to optimized design a Hybrid Energy Storage System (HESS). In addition, Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA II) is applied to optimize the PV-ESS generation scheduling process by means of minimizing deviation between generation plan and real-time integrated power output. Case studies show that the proposed HESS system along with the optimization performs better using RBFNN than the one using BPNN power forecasting models. Besides, the case also illustrates the advantage of the proposed method keeping energy storage units' health and safety well.

articleTitle: Transient Frequency Coordinated Control Strategy for Wind Farm Augmented with Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to improve the frequency characteristics of the system with wind energy storage after short circuit fault, a coordinated control strategy of wind energy storage is proposed. Firstly, the influence of the wind storage power on the frequency change rate in the frequency rising stage and the frequency extreme value in the frequency recovery stage is analyzed. On this basis, the variable weight coefficient related to the frequency disturbance severity is introduced to establish the optimization model to solve the reference power of the wind storage. Then, the frequency regulation capability of the wind turbine during fault ride through and steady-state operation is evaluated, and the reference power of wind power generation is obtained by considering the rotor energy balance, which is compared with the reference power of wind energy storage to obtain the reference power of energy storage. Finally, the simulation is carried out in the four machine two zone system. The results show that the control strategy can reduce the frequency fluctuation range and accelerate the frequency recovery speed of the wind energy storage network. At the same time, it can make full use of the frequency modulation ability of wind power generation and reduce the impact of speed recovery link.

articleTitle: A Novel Coordination Bidding Mechanism of Virtual Power Plant Based on Stackelberg Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of renewable energy generations and the construction of electricity market, the power system requires more flexibility than any period before. Through efficient aggregation and low-delay communication, the virtual power plant (VPP) can manage many sorts of distributed resources on multi-time scale and provide power and auxiliary service to the power grid to gain benefits. Based on the game theory, this paper proposes a VPP strategy with coordination Bidding in order to improve the revenue of virtual power plant in the electricity market. Compared with the centralized direct dispatch, the coordination bidding of load and gas turbine can increase the benefits of both VPP and resources. In order to solve the problem that the bi-layer model is difficult to obtain the optimal solution, this paper proposes a bi-layer model optimization algorithm based on Stackelberg game, and introduces Monte Carlo randomization to ensure the accuracy of the results. Finally, a numerical case is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed optimization strategy and solving method.

articleTitle: Strategic Bidding of Load Aggregator in Demand Response Market Considering Shared Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To leverage the fragmented regulation capacity of consumers, load aggregators (LA) can participate in the demand response (DR) market, providing economic peak regulation services to the independent system operator (ISO) by aggregating these consumers in an orderly manner. However, affected by uncertain behaviors of consumers, the trading risks of LA cannot be ignored, which unavoidable decreases the efficiency of bidding strategies. To address this issue, a novel bidding strategy of LA is proposed, which enhances its own regulation capacity by leasing capacity sharing services from local shared energy storage (SES), thus reducing the trading risk caused by uncertainty. Firstly, the basic framework of LA joining in DR market is outlined, which consists of four market entities and involves four estimated transactive phases. Second, the uncertainty of the DR behavior of LA is built based on the coupling mechanism of the stochastic distribution function and incentive reactivity. Thirdly, the coordinated chance-constrained strategic bidding model and its solving algorithm of LA are formulated, where the bidding strategy, the incentive price and the rental capacity of energy storage are posed simultaneously. Case study validates the effectiveness of the proposed method in controlling trading risks and improving trading revenue of LA.

articleTitle: A Revised Model for Carbon Emission Quotas in Electric Power Sector to Promote Clean Energy Development
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to reduce the national carbon emission, China introduced the free carbon emission quota system for thermal power units in the electric power industry. However, because the system does not consider the development conditions of clean energy in different regions, there are still some improvements in the quota formulation method adopted. This paper proposes a carbon emission quota revision model for thermal power units to promote the development of clean energy. The model first considers the deep peak-regulating demand of thermal power units to ensure that the carbon index of thermal power units to promote clean energy consumption of deep peak regulation emission demand. Secondly, the model establishes four kinds of indicators affecting carbon emission, and introduces entropy weight method to determine the weight of each indicator. On above basis, a carbon emission credit correction method based on clean energy correction factor was established, and the existing regional carbon emission credits are revised to keep the total emission index unchanged. Finally, an example is given to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed carbon emission correction model.

articleTitle: Robust Dispatch of IEHS Considering Interaction Mechanism Between Multiple DHNs and EPS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: District heating network (DHN) can provide flexibility for electrical power system (EPS) by utilizing heat storage capacity. First, the long-term balance between heat supply and demand must be considered. Thus, this paper defines two operating periods of DHN, including flexibility providing period (FPP) and flexibility recovery period (FRP). A DHN flexibility-providing model is designed. On the basis of proposed flexibility-providing model, a flexibility interaction mechanism between multiple DHNs and EPS is proposed. Considered the interaction mechanism, an integrated electricity and heating system (IEHS) robust dispatch model is proposed, which takes into account the flexibility supply capacity and operating costs of the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by case studies.

articleTitle: Methods and Application of New Energy Power Plant Equivalent Modelling for Massive New Energy Electro-magnetic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper presents equivalent modelling methods of new energy power plant, which is necessary for massive new energy electro-magnetic transient simulation in largescale hybrid power grid which includes large amount of new energy power plant s, High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) and AC transmission system. The equivalent power plant models based on different new energy generation unit models and equivalent collector system were introduced and built on electro-magnetic transient simulation platform Hypersim. Errors of these equivalent models were then analyzed and compared to illustrate the models' accuracy. Finally, overvoltage simulation study result of massive new energy plants in a certain regional power grid was present as an example of application of the equivalent models.

articleTitle: A Constrained Robust Optimization for Day-Ahead Scheduling of Microgrids with Source-Demand Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper develops a day-ahead scheduling model for microgrids to reduce their operation cost. In view of the intermittent and uncertain photovoltaic power and power demand, i.e. the source-demand uncertainty, a novel constrained robust optimization is incorporated into the model, which minimizes the expected operation cost for the historical distribution of the uncertain conditions and restricts the cost in the worst-case scenarios. To obtain the empirical scenario set with the temporal correlation which represents the historical distribution, a Nataf transformation-based Latin hypercube sampling is developed for the scenario generation and the K-means method is adopted for the scenario reduction. To effectively solve the scheduling problem with uncertainty, the column and constraint generation method and dual theory are adopted, such that the problem is derived as an alternate optimization between the master problem and sub problem. Numerical simulations in a testing microgrid validate the superiority of the proposed scheduling model, and the equilibrium ability of the constrained robust optimization between economical efficiency and robustness.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Micro Energy Control Unit (MECU) for Utility-Scale Renewable Energy Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the advancement of renewable energy and power electronics technology, there has been an increasing demand for various forms of electrical energy. However, presently, there is a scarcity of distribution equipment specifically designed for household usage. To address this issue, this paper first proposes the concept of micro energy control unit (MECU), which is tailored to meet the specific requirements of household users. Furthermore, the multi-port topology structure, control strategy, and circuit parameters of MECU are optimized to enhance its functionality. The proposed MECU not only satisfies users' demands for both AC and DC power, but also helps mitigate the impact of distributed photovoltaics on the power grid, thereby making it versatile in its application. Additionally, to reduce the production cost of MECU, this paper eliminates the transformer and minimizes the value of the DC bus capacitor. The correctness of the proposed MECU topology structure, circuit parameters, and control strategy is established through simulation and experimentation, based on typical household applications.

articleTitle: A Method for Analyzing Boundary Conditions of Typical Power Supply Structure in AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network with Large-Scale Photovoltaic Access
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the situation of high proportion of distributed energy access, AC/DC hybrid distribution network has lower network loss and more flexible regulation ability than traditional AC distribution network. In order to provide relatively accurate guidance for AC/DC construction of distribution area, it is necessary to analyze its characteristic index boundary conditions. In this study, under the background of high percentage of photovoltaic access, the operation economy, photovoltaic consumption, power supply quality and other evaluation indexes of AC/DC hybrid distribution network were comprehensively considered, and the intelligent optimization algorithm was used to regulate the flexible equipment, and the boundary conditions of three characteristic indexes of photovoltaic permeability, power supply radius and load capacity were analyzed.

articleTitle: Satellite Internet-Based High-Precision Space-Ground Coordinated Ultra-Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The high-precision ultra-short-term photovoltaic power prediction is the key guarantee for efficient solar energy utilization. However, various factors significantly challenge the accurate photovoltaic (PV) ultra-short-term power prediction, including the remote location of PV power plant, high communication cost and significant delay. In this work, a satellite internet-based ultra-short-term power prediction (SUPP) framework is proposed that data from space and ground. The core algorithm of SUPP is established with multilayer heterogeneous neural network consisting of convolutional neural network (CNN), gated recurrent unit (GRU) and attention mechanism to utilize the technical advantages of high bandwidth, wide coverage and low latency of satellite internet. The proposed SUPP framework can realize real-time transmission and fusion of local cloud map information collected by ground-to-air cameras and wide-area meteorological data collected by remote sensing satellites. Simulation results show that the proposed SUPP framework can provide a reliable decision basis for system-level scheduling and control by accurately predicting the trend and value of PV power generation with the efficient fusion of multivariate data.

articleTitle: Hybrid Dynamic Simulation Method of Current-Controlled Voltage Sources for Dynamic Error Tracing
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the goal of “carbon peaking and carbon neutral”, the power system will be connected to a large number of renewable energy sources with random and volatile characteristics, which will bring great challenges to the safe and stable operation of the power system. The current power system control schemes are often based on conventional simulation models, and the generation of control strategies based on inaccurate simulation data and models will lead to differences between the control effects of control strategies and the real state of the actual power system, among which component parameter errors are considered to be the main factor leading to inconsistencies between dynamic simulation results and measured data. Therefore, it is necessary to continuously calibrate the power system model parameters so that the simulation trajectory gradually approximates the measured trajectory and improves the credibility of the simulation system. In this paper, we first study the hybrid dynamic simulation method, which locks the errors into the system to be studied by incorporating the measured data into the simulation system without introducing the errors caused by external system modeling. Then a current-controlled three-phase voltage source inverter is proposed to equate the external system, and the hybrid dynamic simulation is performed by outputting a given amount of active and reactive power to the power system, thus narrowing the error traceability region. Finally, the accuracy and reliability of the proposed current-controlled three-phase voltage source inverter injection method are verified in the Guangzhou Conghua system.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Reconfiguration of Wind-Integrated Distribution Network Considering Network Resiliency
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Network resiliency refers to the connectivity performance and ability to withstand damage. This paper introduces network vulnerability as a new objective to describe the network resiliency in distribution network reconfiguration (DNR), which effectively quantifies topological reliability. The method utilizes weighted edge values and modified node importance to calculate network vulnerability. Additionally, the approach accounts for the randomness and intermittency of distributed generation (DG) and adjusts the index values for the access position of DGs. A multi-objective model is established for DNR with DGs that considers network vulnerability. Through Pareto optimal concept and improved harmony search algorithm, a set of valuable and practical solutions is provided. The efficacy of the model and algorithm is demonstrated through case studies.

articleTitle: Spot Market Risk Pre-Control and Emergency Response Strategies for Carbon-Neutral Target
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Under the background of the Carbon-neutral Target, it has become an irresistible trend for renewable energy to participate in the electricity market on a large scale. However, the randomness and uncertainty of renewable energy will bring a series of risks and challenges to the operation of the power grid. Therefore, from the perspective of ensuring the safe and stable operation of the new power system, this paper firstly, identifies and defines the risks of the power grid according to the characteristics of the new power system, secondly, proposes corresponding risk pre-control measures and emergency response strategies for the risks under the spot market.Finally, an example is given to verify that the proposed risk emergency treatment strategy can guarantee the safe and stable operation of power grid and promote the orderly development of spot market.

articleTitle: A Novel Cooperative Strategy of Virtual Power Plant for Energy and Peak Regulating Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As renewable energy penetration increases, the power system needs more flexibility and real-time adjustment capabilities in order to maintain stable. Relying on traditional regulation methods from generation side has been unable to meet the risks brought by a high proportion of new energy, and the interaction between generation and consumption has become the mainstream trend of future power grid. Virtual power plant (VPP) can efficiently aggregate and dispatch flexible resources and become a carrier of power-load interaction to achieve power balance. At present, one of the main problems restricting the development of virtual power plant is how to gain benefits and develop in the long term. VPP can not only participate in the electricity energy market as a producer and consumer, but also obtain incentives in the peak regulating market by adjusting output. At this scenario, this paper considers the incentive demand response model, studies the influence of flexible load participating in the peak regulating market, and designs the optimal bidding strategy for virtual power plants to participate in the energy and peak regulating market. The example simulation can verify the rationality and effectiveness of the proposed bidding strategy.

articleTitle: Payment and Incentive Allocation Method in Demand Response Programs Based on Causer Pays Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Demand response (DR) plays a significant role for facilitating the integration of large-scale renewable energy sources (RES) by effectively unlocking the potential flexible capacities of the demand-side resources. However, the fund flows in existing DR mechanisms do not follow the “causer pays” principle (CPP), and hence fail to offer long-term and substantial DR incentive funds, hindering the widespread deployment of DR programs. To address these issues, this paper proposes a payment and incentive allocation method for the customer directrix load (CDL)-based DR mechanism. First, the concept of effective energy shift is proposed to quantify the marginal impact of each entity on the power systems unbalance, which clearly assess who are causers of the DR program and the pertinent payment. Furthermore, the DR incentive allocation method is proposed, where DR customers receive the incentive in proportion to the similarity index based on CDL. Meanwhile, the optimal decision model for incentive coefficient that maximizes the total social welfare is formulated. Finally, a case study is conducted and the results numerically verify the effectiveness of the proposed payment and incentive allocation method.

articleTitle: Convex Relaxation of Non-Isothermal Optimal Power and Gas Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Conventional convex relaxation of the OPGF model relies heavily on the isothermal assumption, which greatly sacrifices the solution accuracy. This paper develops a novel convex non-isothermal optimal power-gas flow (NI-OPGF) model which avoids the assumption of constant gas temperature to effectively improve the model optimality and computational efficiency. A simplified pipeline thermal (SPT) model with only bilinear constraints is established to describe the heat transfer of gas, which significantly decreases the mathematical complexity of the problem. The implicit difference method is adopted to transform the original gas flow constraints in the form of partial differential into algebraic equations. To address the nonconvexity of the original NI-OPGF problem, cubic and bilinear constraints appearing in the non-isothermal gas flow model are relaxed into a group of linear constraints by convex envelopes. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by systematical numerical experiments on a test system.

articleTitle: Decentralized Robust Emergency Voltage Control of Power System with Large-Scale Wind Power Integrated Via VSC-MTDC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Continuous displacement of conventional power plants by wind turbines significantly weakens the dynamic reactive power support ability of power grid. To correct nonviable or unstable voltages and avoid an imminent long-term voltage instability, this paper proposes a decentralized robust emergency voltage control strategy of power system with large-scale wind power integrated via voltage source converter based multi-terminal direct current system (VSC-MTDC). Firstly, a partition approach combining electrical distance and network structure is proposed.
