The electrical distance expectation considering wind power volatility is calculated in the partition, combined with the edge betweenness, the decoupling of reactive power/voltage control in each zone is realized by community detection. Secondly, a decentralized robust emergency voltage control strategy based on tube-based model predictive control (MPC) approach is innovatively proposed. In the proposed local emergency voltage control model, by treating the action of controllers in other zones as disturbances and compensating them using tightened constraints and ancillary controller, it achieves a robust voltage control in the absence of communication among local controllers. Finally, simulation results are shown with a modified IEEE Nordic Test System, which validates the effectiveness and superiority of the newly proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Capacity Compensation Price Evaluation Considering Economic Benefit of Energy Market in a Power Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the power spot market, capacity mechanism for compensating “missing money” from energy market is a necessary market product in the power market system. Currently, capacity compensation instead of capacity market is appropriate at the stage when power spot market is starting up in China. Therefore, determination of regulated capacity price is the key for capacity compensation mechanism. In the paper, a method for evaluating capacity price with consideration of target capacity adequacy is proposed. A production cost simulation is applied for quantifying economic benefit of energy market for all GENCOs. An economic model using internal rate of return based on revenue of energy market and capacity compensation is designed for determining new entrant and retirement generators. Capacity price is adjusted based on the difference between target total system capacity and expected one after generator availability decision until the target total system capacity is satisfied. Case study for verifying the proposed method is performed to quantify the capacity price based on different scenarios including high penetration of renewable generation and high coal price.

articleTitle: Study on the Value Assessment of Demand-Side Resources Based on Grey Correlation Ideal Point Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Demand-side market is an important part of the electric power market system. The establishment of trading varieties and operation mechanisms for demand-side resource participation can help realize the connection and interaction between demand-side response and the electricity market. In this paper, the demand-side resource value assessment and utilization strategy are given. On the basis of determining the evaluation index weights, the gray correlation ideal point method is used to assess the demand-side resource value, the variable weight method is used to revise its value level, and finally, the ladder utilization strategy of demand-side resources is given.

articleTitle: Voltage Support Control Strategy for Distributed Synchronous Condenser Based on an Excitation System with Full-Controlled Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of large-scale renewable energy connections to the grid and ultra-high voltage direct current transmission, the lack of dynamic reactive power compensation and voltage support capacity has become an important problem for power systems. Equipping with small-capacity distributed synchronous condensers in new energy sites can provide sufficient reactive power backup capacity, which will help to recover fault currents quickly. This paper applies the excitation system with full-controlled devices to the distributed synchronous condenser to improve the dynamic reactive power compensation capacity and achieve strong voltage support. Firstly, a mathematical model of the single machine-infinite bus system with the proposed condenser is established. Secondly, its voltage support control strategy is studied; then, the mathematical modeling and parameter design are carried out for the automatic voltage regulator and reactive power injection controller, respectively. After multi-case simulation, it is verified that the proposed condenser has better dynamic reactive power performance and voltage support capability than the distributed synchronous condenser with a conventional excitation system.

articleTitle: Resilience Enhancement of Power Distribution System Under Extreme Weather Events: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Extreme weather events (EWEs) bring great challenges to the safe operation of power distribution system (PDS). Pre-disaster preparation and post-disaster restoration can effectively reduce the outage loss and improve PDS resilience. In addition, with the continuous development of integrated energy system, the tight coupling of PDS, natural gas system (NGS), and heating system (HS) has provided a new way for improving PDS resilience. This paper first introduces pre-disaster preparation, post-disaster restoration, and pre- and post-disaster coordinated optimization strategies for resilient PDS. Then, the research status of integrated energy system resilience enhancement strategies is summarized. Finally, the prospect of resilient PDS is proposed.

articleTitle: Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Prediction Based on Similar-Day Clustering and Multi-Layer Perception
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Artificial intelligence plays an important role in improving the accuracy and reliability of photovoltaic power prediction. In order to better improve the accuracy of photovoltaic power prediction, present mainstream research focuses on using the optimizing algorithm to select the hyper-parameters of the prediction model to improve the prediction level of the model. This type of model uses an optimizing algorithm to achieve the improvement of prediction accuracy. However, it doesn’ t do too much work in the original data, which partly ignores the inner value of the original data. To solve that problem, an intelligent photovoltaic power prediction model based on similar-day clustering and multi-layer perceptron is established. The ability from convolutional neural network and multi-layer perception are combined. Firstly, select the satellite cloud picture and use the convolutional neural network to work at data feature clustering, which is proposed as similar-day clustering. Sequentially the original data is divided into subsets. Secondly, the pretrained multi-layer perceptron models according to different weather types are selected. The historical metrological data are used as the model input to train the multi-layer perceptron. Thus, multi-layer perceptron can learn the nonlinear mapping relationship and coupling connection between meteorological factors and photovoltaic power. Finally, a data set of a photovoltaic power plant in northern China is used for the case study. The case study shows that compared with LSTM and multi-layer perceptron, the MAPE of the proposed prediction model is improved by 19.6% and 50.7% respectively, which fully demonstrates the superiority and accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: TCN-LSTNet with Sliding Time Window Featured Short-Term Load Forecasting for Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The escalating imperative for diminished energy consumption has elevated the task of energy consumption forecasting into a progressively significant challenge. Nonetheless, within the context of an integrated energy system, if the precision of energy consumption prediction falls short, ensuing indicator evaluations, economic analyses, and the execution of scheduling operations is not effective. This paper introduces a Long- and Short-Term Time-series Network designed explicitly for electricity load forecasting. The model integrates the inputs to the forecasting model with a Temporal Convolutional Network, thereby enhancing the model's perceptual field. The resulting predictions proved to apply to longer series and the proposed algorithm was able to achieve some advantages in terms of convergence speed and prediction accuracy compared to other algorithms.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Error Detection Model of Metering Device
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to reduce the large cost waste caused by the problems of heavy workload, low efficiency, complex operation site and limited experience level of operators in the daily measurement error verification and operation maintenance management of electric energy meters. Based on the data collected by electricity information, this paper establishes a big data analysis model, and proposes a data-driven calculation method for the operation error of electric energy meter. Based on the collected file data of a station area, the power supply data of the assessment table and the power consumption data of all user tables, the equation is established according to the energy conservation, and the linear equations are established by using multi-metering cycle data. Combined with deep learning, the short-term abnormal data of the electric energy meter are located and eliminated, and the algorithm of base tracking and Moore-Penrose generalized inverse is used to solve the operation error of the intelligent electric energy meter. As an important reference for the evaluation of the operation state of the electric energy meter, it provides effective support for line loss management, operation and maintenance of the electric energy meter and accurate replacement, which can effectively reduce the number of on-site operation and maintenance personnel and improve the accuracy of fault analysis and location. The accuracy of the method is verified by the actual station data, and the trial operation results are good.

articleTitle: Time Series Data Augmentation Algorithm Combining Deep Metric Learning and Variational Encoder
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the challenges of current time series data generation and the slow speed of the generation framework based on generative adversarial networks, we propose a novel architecture for comprehensively generating time series data using variational autoencoders. Specifically: study how to eliminate the heteroskedasticity and non-stationarity of the data, so that when the data is applied to the encoder, it can better conform to the normal distribution assumption; then introduce deep metric learning, based on metric learning to build a more suitable data enhancement discriminative VAE latent space; based on the above two studies, they are integrated to obtain a novel variational autoencoder framework. We verified the necessity of each module through ablation studies; the quality of data generation was evaluated by the similarity and predictability of the three multivariate datasets. Our similarity test results show that the VAE method can accurately represent the temporal properties of the original data. In the prediction task using the generated data, the proposed VAE system can obtain the best results compared with other SOTA algorithms, and the average speed is increased by about 20.2%.

articleTitle: Improved Gated Recurrent Unit Network with Sparrow Search Algorithm for Lithium-Ion Battery State of Health Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The condition of lithium-ion batteries (LIBs), commonly referred to as the state of health (SOH), holds a critical role in ensuring the safety of the entire system. A precise estimation of SOH is crucial.This paper introduces the SSAGRU network, a battery SOH estimation method that utilizes the sparrow search algorithm and an improved gated recurrent unit. The current curve is used to extract three different features related to battery aging during the constant voltage stage, and their correlation with SOH is analyzed through grey correlation analysis. The proposed SSA-improved GRU model proves to be effective in achieving accurate and stable SOH estimation, outperforming two other algorithms tested.

articleTitle: Analysis on Response Characteristics of Control and Protection Systems in Event of Measurement Anomalies for UHVDC Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The measurement system in UHVDC systems mainly includes DC voltage measurement and DC current measurement, and the accuracy of its results is the key to ensure the reliable operation of the DC control and protection systems. In this paper, based on the analysis of the principle of the UHVDC transmission system, the ±800kV UHVDC transmission system model is constructed using PSCAD/EMTDC simulation software. The effects of rectifier-side DC current and DC voltage measurement faults on the response characteristics of the DC control and protection systems are investigated under different scenarios by superimposing different abnormal measurement values, and the simulation results are analyzed in conjunction with the control strategy and protection principles. The simulation results show that the DC system exhibits different response characteristics under different measurement anomalies. The deviation of rectifier-side DC current measurement affects the DC voltage, DC current and power transmission of the two stations and causes the protections to operate. And the abnormal DC voltage measurement causes the protections to operate falsely.

articleTitle: Research of Electromechanical-Electromagnetic Transient Hybrid Simulation System Based on Kubernetes
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The construction of new power system and the Guidelines for power system security and stability in China put forward higher requirements for the efficiency of electromechanical electromagnetic transient hybrid simulation of large power grids. In order to meet the ever-increasing demand for simulation in the future, this paper combines the current development direction of cloud services in the computer field, builds a high-performance computing platform suitable for the characteristics of hybrid simulation computing based on the Internet leading cluster management platform Kubernetes and container virtualization technology, and tests it in Power Dispatch and Control Center of China Southern Power Grid. Through the actual data test, the accuracy of the platform simulation is verified, and the efficiency improvement is basically close to the ideal value provided by the hardware computing power. The simulation time of 60 cases can be reduced to less than 1 hour, which provides a practical computing platform for the simulation analysis of new power system.

articleTitle: Uncertainty Quantification of Power Flow in Distributed System Considering the Random and Fuzzy Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurately quantifying the uncertainty brought by distributed generation (DG) is very important for the safe and stable operation of power grid. Uncertainty is mainly divided into randomness and fuzziness. Traditional model of DG only considers its randomness, neglecting the influence of fuzzy parameters and fuzzy correlation, which sometimes leads to analysis results deviating from objective facts. To deal with this problem, an uncertainty quantification method considering both random and fuzzy characteristics of DG is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a DG model that considers the random and fuzzy parameters, as well as fuzzy correlation is established. Then, based on Nataf transform and point estimation method, probabilistic load flow is carried out in different membership degrees. And global sensitivity analysis based on membership function is applied for discussing the contribution to the output response of each fuzzy parameter. Finally, modified IEEE 33-bus and IEEE 118-bus systems are used for simulation. The results show that DG model considering both randomness and fuzziness can more scientifically depict the impact of uncertainty.

articleTitle: Analysis and Quantitative Models of Regulation Potential of Load-Side Flexible Resources Under Multiple Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” and the construction of new power systems, the proportion of new energy in China's power generation side is increasing, leading to a lack of regulation capacity in China's power grid, and load-side resources have the potential to solve this problem. Firstly, this paper proposes four scenarios of load-side flexible resource regulation and analyses the load regulation potential under each scenario. On this basis, two different potential quantification models are established, and their respective characteristics and applicability are given. Finally, the validity of the two models is verified by the example analysis.

Author Keywords: carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals

articleTitle: Two-Stage Optimal Operation Strategy of Distribution Network Considering Orderly Charging and Discharging of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In view of the voltage violation problem caused by the electric vehicle accessing to the distribution network, this paper proposes a two-stage optimal operation strategy of the distribution network considering the orderly charging and discharging of electric vehicles. According to the change of the load curve of a distribution network, the membership function is used to divide the electricity price, and an orderly charging strategy for electric vehicles based on time-of-use electricity price is proposed; A two-stage optimization model of distribution network based on rolling optimization scheduling is established. In the first stage, the charging plan of electric vehicles is determined with the minimum charging cost of users as the optimization objective; Based on the results of the first stage optimization, the second stage optimization goal of minimizing the network loss of the distribution network is achieved by controlling the power of the intelligent soft switch. Aiming at the original nonlinear optimization problem, the optimization model is linearized by the piecewise linearization principle of circular and quadratic terms. The validity and feasibility of the model are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Line Selection Strategy for Single-Phase Grounding Fault in Distribution Network Considering Bidirectional Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Single-phase grounding fault is the most common fault in the low current grounding system, and its fault characteristics are not significant and easy to be interfered. On the other hand, distributed power is developing rapidly and widely used, but the research of single-phase grounding fault line selection in distribution network with bidirectional power flow is still needed to be developed. Therefore, how to select the fault line in the distribution network with bidirectional power flow quickly and accurately is very important. So, this paper presents a comprehensive line selection scheme which combines the fifth harmonic method, the group amplitude and phase method, and the polarity comparison method. In this method, the fifth harmonics of fault components are extracted by fast Fourier transform and the lines are selected by comparison. A small current grounding system with bidirectional power flow is established in the simulation environment of PSCAD, and the sensitivity and accuracy of this scheme are verified when single-phase grounding faults occur at different positions in the system.

articleTitle: A Low-carbon Dispatching Framework of Electrified Mobility-on-Demand Fleets
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Electrified mobility-on-demand (E-MOD) fleets will play an important role in the future urban transportation system, which transfers carbon emissions from the traffic sector to the power sector. In this paper, a low-carbon dispatching framework for the E-MOD fleet is proposed to coordinate the fleet operator and power system operator, which comprehensively considers the different dispatching spatiotemporal scales and privacy issues between them. For the E-MOD operator, the precise order-serving and rebalancing at the individual vehicle level are calculated based on a vehicle-shareability network model and then aggregated as boundary conditions in vehicle flow form and uploaded to the power system operator. For the power system operator, a low-carbon multicommodity network flow model is built to optimize the fleet's charging management schedule. Numerical simulations on New York City are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: A Multi-Dimensional Indicator Synergistic Approach to the Evaluation of Equal-Offer Collusion in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: After the new round of power reform, there are some cases of market players in the regional power markets that disrupt the normal operation of the market by tacit collusion to destroy the order of fair competition. To this end, in response to the phenomenon of equal-offer collusion existing in the power market, this paper proposes a multi-dimensional index synergistic evaluation index system to establish equal-offer collusion indexes from five dimensions: the unit itself, between units, unit-market, market-unit, and market itself according to the market situation, and to make a comprehensive assessment of the possibility of equal-offer collusion of units. In this paper, the index values are obtained by selecting appropriate methods according to the characteristics of each dimension, and the dynamic weighting method is used to add up the data of each index to obtain the likelihood of collusion of units and other offers under the evaluation system. Finally, this paper verifies the feasibility and applicability of the method using examples.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Equivalence Modelling Method for Wind Farms Considering Optimal Yaw Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A simple and accurate equivalent model is important to analyze the impact of grid-connected wind farms on the power system. This paper proposes a dynamic equivalence modeling method for wind farms considering the optimal yaw control strategy. Firstly, a wake superposition model based on the Gaussian wake model is established to calculate the wind velocity for each wind turbine. The wind turbine yaw control strategy is optimized by Genetic Algorithm (GA) to deal with the effects of wind direction changes and increase the overall output of the wind farm. Then, the wind turbines are clustered by U-Shapelets (unsupervised shapelets) Clustering Algorithm (USCA) based on wind velocity and active power in yaw conditions. And the parameters of the equivalent model are calculated using the capacity weighting method and parameter identification algorithm. Finally, a simulation model constructed on Matlab / Simulink is applied to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on Energy Power Supply and Demand Early Warning System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to comprehensively improve the ability of power supply security and better serve the work of power supply assurance, in view of the current imperfect comprehensive early warning system of energy and power, supply and demand early warning is focused on the energy production chain and supply chain. Starting from the coal production chain and supply chain, the paper designs the second-level warning indicators of “thermal coal inventory warning”, “thermal coal price warning”, “coal supply and demand warning” and “new energy supply and demand warning”, and combines the four second-level warning indicators to form a comprehensive warning system of “weekly, monthly and quarterly” respectively. Make supply and demand forecast in time to provide reference for power supply and demand balance of energy industry chain and supply chain, annual energy and power operation plan and enterprise safety production management; Finally, taking Henan Province as an example, the provincial energy supply and demand early warning is carried out. The results show that it can accurately assess the coal and other energy shortage risks and give early warning, so as to better operation and management of energy and power.

articleTitle: A Power Grid Capacity Margin Model and Calculation Method Considering the Interaction of Source-Load-Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to address the balance between new energy consumption capacities, guaranteed power supply and operational economy in the process of capacity margin planning for power grid equipment, this paper proposes an optimized decision-making model and calculation method for power grid equipment capacity margin considering the interaction of source-load-storage. This paper first established a calculation method for the flexibility margin capacity of up and down regulation on the power supply side. Subsequently, the grid side capacity margin index CBM was redefined to reflect the comprehensive impact of the economic indicators of large-scale new energy access and the reliability indexes of power supply. Finally, the defined capacity margin model was quantitatively expressed and analyzed through examples. The CBM retention values configured by the method proposed in this paper have been verified to reduce the probability of power system load loss and wind abandonment, while also taking into account economic benefits and improving the reliability and economy of system operation.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of Multi-Regional Microgrids Based on Network Topology Considering Economy and Low Active Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The large-scale access of distributed generation (DG) makes microgrids gradually become a key part of smart grids. Geographically adjacent microgrids in the region are connected to each other to form a regional multi-microgrid (MMG) system. However, how to achieve the communication between the sub-microgrids and the energy management within the system becomes very important. Therefore, this paper focuses on the optimal dispatch problem in the operation of regional multi-microgrid. Firstly, the typical structure and internal composition of regional multi-microgrid system are introduced. Secondly, combined with the relevant theory of topology identification, a dynamic networking strategy of regional multi-microgrid based on graph theory is designed. Finally, based on the dynamic networking strategy of regional multi-microgrid, a dynamic networking strategy of regional multi-microgrid considering economy and active loss is proposed. In the operation process of regional multi-microgrid, the price-based demand response (PBDR) strategy is introduced to optimize the operation process of regional multi-microgrid with the goal of optimal economic operation and lowest total active power loss, and the results after solution are analyzed by TOPSIS method. The simulation results show that through dynamic networking, the system operating cost of the regional multi-microgrid is reduced by about 39.4% and the active power loss is reduced by about 10.6% under normal operation, which reduces the active power loss of the system while ensuring economic operation, which verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of the model.

articleTitle: Study of Frequency Response Control Strategy for Wind-Storage System Considering Lithium Battery Life Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Energy storage has a flexible regulation performance. The combination of wind power and energy storage can improve the ability of wind power to support the system frequency. Because different types of energy storage have different characteristics, the use of lithium battery-supercapacitor hybrid energy storage system can further improve the frequency stability. At the same time, the cycle life of lithium batteries is much lower than that of supercapacitors, and the cost of lithium batteries is still high. There is a need to take the cost of lithium battery life loss in the joint frequency regulation process of wind-storage systems. However, most of the current lithium battery life models include multiple variables such as depth of discharge, charge and discharge rate, which is difficult to apply in frequency regulation control. However, in many studies, the lithium battery life model is simplified as a quadratic function of power, which is quite different from the actual nonlinear characteristics of lithium batteries. In this paper, the lithium battery life model is transformed into a function that only contains charge and discharge power, A lithium battery life loss model suitable for frequency regulation control scenarios has been constructed. On this basis, a model predictive control-based control strategy for wind-storage combined frequency regulation considering lithium battery life loss is proposed. Firstly, we establish a prediction model based on the system state equation; Then, the objective function is developed to minimize the frequency regulation cost of the wind-storage system in the predicted time domain, and the constraints of each wind storage module and the balance of primary frequency regulation power are used as constraints to control the variation of wind power and storage power; Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified on the MATLAB/Simulink platform, and the results shows that the strategy proposed in this paper not only has good frequency regulation effect, but also achieves optimal power allocation for the wind-storage system and reduces the lifespan loss of lithium batteries.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization of Transmission and Distribution Networks Based on Feasible Domain Projections
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In view of the problems such as boundary power imbalance and inadequate resource utilization that may arise from traditional transmission and distribution separate scheduling, a cooperative scheduling strategy for transmission and distribution two-level grids is proposed to optimize the system from a global perspective. Firstly, the Frank-Copula function is used to deal with the uncertainty and correlation of the scenery, and then a distribution network model based on the feasible domain projection is established. Finally, with the lowest overall power supply cost of the transmission and distribution system as the objective function, a transmission and distribution two-level network collaborative optimal dispatch model is established. The model equates each distribution network as a transmission network node, with the transmission network and each distribution network completing the optimization design at the same level, effectively avoiding frequent information interaction between the transmission and distribution networks during the optimization process. Finally, simulation examples are used to verify the feasibility of the proposed scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: Collaborative Line-Transformer Relationship Identification Based on Shapelet Transformation in IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The correct identification of the line-transformer relationship in distribution networks is the basis for the management of line loss, operations, fault location, and maintenance. Previous methods are difficult to track topology changes in real time based on historical voltage data, and the recognition accuracy needs to be further improved. With the construction of the power Internet of Things (IoT), efficient and accurate identification is possible. Combined Power IoT terminal collaboration technology, a classification method based on shapelet transform is proposed to accurately identify the line-transformer relationship in real time. First, since there will always be some missing voltage data from the transformer terminal, we propose Gaussian fitting imputation. Then, due to the large amplitude difference in the voltage data collected on site, the transformer terminals with known relationships are used to collaborate, and the voltage characteristic matrix is calculated in parallel based on the shapelet transform algorithm. Furthermore, the matrix is transmitted to the unknown relationship transformer terminal using support vector machine(SVM) for relationship identification. With the proposed method, simulation and on-site experiments results show that the shapelet transform is effective for line-transformer identification on the basis of terminal collaboration.

articleTitle: Time Series Prediction of Transformer Oil Chromatography Based on Attention-PSO-GRU Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The content of dissolved gas in transformer oil is an important characteristic to reflect the operating condition of transformers. To overcome the problems that the traditional transformer oil chromatography gas prediction model cannot effectively use the older transformer oil chromatography data and it is difficult to track the transformer oil chromatography data under abnormal conditions and it can only rely on experience to adjust the model parameters, we introduce Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), Attention Mechanism (APM) and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to construct the Attention-PSO-GRU prediction model. Firstly, the transformer oil chromatography monitoring data are pre-processed, and the attention mechanism is introduced into the time channel to realize the redistribution of the input data weights. Then, the hyperparameters in the GRU model are optimality-seeking iterated by PSO to realize the adaptive tuning of the model. Finally, the optimized GRU neural network is used to extract spatiotemporal features from transformer oil chromatography monitoring data and construct the Attention-PSO-GRU transformer oil chromatography gas prediction model. The experimental results show that the Attention-PSO-GRU model can reach 97.9% accuracy in predicting the normal transformer oil chromatography data and has a better tracking ability for the abnormal transformer oil chromatography data. Therefore, the Attention-PSO-GRU model proposed in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of transformer oil chromatography gas prediction, which has practical significance for preventing transformer faults and ensuring the safe and stable operation of power systems.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Fault Recovery Strategy for Distribution Networks with Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To solve the randomness of distributed generation and time-varying load requirements, a multi-objective fault recovery strategy for distribution networks using a hybrid crow algorithm is presented. Firstly, the combined output model and load characteristic model of wind and energy storage system are built, and the important loads in distribution network are restored first by islands division method. Then, taking the minimum active power loss, minimum system voltage stability index and minimum number of switching operations as the objective functions, the recovery and reconfiguration model of the main network and the remaining power loss areas is established, and the hybrid crow algorithm is applied to deal with the restoration of remaining power loss load in the distribution network. Finally, simulation using the IEEE33-node distribution network model is used to verify the efficiency and supremacy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Adjustable Potential Evaluation of Massive Flexible Load Resources from the Perspective of CPS
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the demand-side flexible resources attracting widespread attention, the potential evaluation of these resources becomes the primary issue in their use. However, the efficient use of massive resources is not only determined by its physical adjustment capabilities but also affected by information systems. Therefore, it is necessary to comprehensively consider the potential evaluation of these resources from the perspective of cyber-physical systems. An adjustable potential evaluation method of massive flexible load resources is proposed here under the framework of the cloud-edge collaboration cyber system (CECS). Firstly, the CECS framework of regulating massive demand-side resources is constructed, followed by the modeling of communication latency and reliability. Then, the maximum adjustable potential evaluation model is established based on a fixed time-delay search. Finally, a deep reinforcement learning method combined with the k shortest path algorithm is proposed to solve the optimization model based on proximal policy optimization. The numerical result shows the feasibility and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of Distributed Adjustable Jet Pump in District Heating System Considering Renewable Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: High energy consumption of the pipe network and low user comfort are long-standing problems in district heating systems. In order to address these challenges, this paper proposes a dynamic operation control method for district heating systems based on distributed adjustable jet pumps. While taking advantage of traditional jet pumps to balance hydraulic power, the area ratio of the adjustable jet pump can be dynamically adjusted by the controller to adapt its operating characteristics to current heating needs. In this paper, the mechanism modeling of the adjustable jet pump is firstly carried out. Then jet pump models are distributed and combined with the farthest, middle, and nearest heat user models to form the entire control system. Subsequently, a multiple-input and multiple-output model predictive control method is designed, which considers both the physical constraints of adjustable jet pumps and the disturbance of renewable energy output. Finally, taking a district heating system in Beijing as an example, the room temperature comfort and energy-saving benefits under MPC, PID, and non-control conditions were compared and analyzed. The calculation results show that the room temperature comfort under MPC controller has the greatest improvement. Moreover, compared to PID control, it can save 5.8% of the circulating pump power consumption, and 10.0% compared to non-control condition.

articleTitle: Ancillary Service Market Equilibrium Analysis for Multi-Agent Load Aggregators in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The fluctuation of distributed energy and uncontrollable load increase the ancillary services demand for distribution system. With the development of smart grid, more and more load aggregators(LA) can participate in auxiliary service market by aggregating the controllable loads and achieve local balance, resulting in the break of the market equilibrium dominated by the power producers in the past. Therefore, this paper proposes a bi-level game model for multi-agent load aggregators to participate in auxiliary service market. The upper-level problem of the model maximizes the profit of each load aggregator in multi-variety auxiliary service market, while the lower-level problem represents the market clearing process by distribution system operator(DSO). And the proposed bi-level model is transformed into a single-level model by KKT condition and strong duality theory. Considering the non-cooperative game relationship between different load aggregators, the Nash equilibrium of market is calculated by particle swarm optimization algorithm. The validity and feasibility of the model is verified under three typical scenarios.

articleTitle: Multi-Time Scale Optimal Power Flow Strategy for DC Distribution Network Based on Model-Driven
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to realize the optimal power flow under multiple time scales and multiple operation modes, the prediction results and power grid status are included in the optimization model simultaneously, and a power flow optimization strategy combining day-ahead and day-ahead optimization is proposed. According to the actual operation expectations, the objective function variable weight is adopted to adjust; The intra-day optimization combines the model predictive control system with super-short-term forecast, and plays the buffering role of energy storage to realize the tracking of scheduled distributed power output. In addition, give full play to the advantages of simplicity and high feasibility of knee search, and realize the global optimization of multi-objective optimization solution. The results show the practicability of this strategy.

articleTitle: Expansion Planning of the Target Connection Mode in Medium Voltage Distribution Network with Complex Connection
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The previous studies have not identified an effective solution to the complex connection of the distribution network and how to transition the distribution network to the target connection mode in the case of complex contact. In order to solve the above problem, this paper presents a multi-period distribution network expansion planning (MDNEP) with complex connection. Firstly, distribution network connections are divided into five categories based on its characteristics: invalid, bottleneck, critical, multiple, and standard connection, and proposes corresponding planning strategies for elimination, transformation, construction, simplification and solidification. Secondly, the target connection constraint of the proposed MDNEP is represented by the number of interconnected line groups, and the benefits of grid refinement are integrated in the objective. Then, the dynamic programming algorithm based on parallel state reduction is proposed to solve the model, which improves the solving efficiency. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method are verified by the improved Portugal54 bus system.

articleTitle: Frequency-Constrained Dispatching Method for an Integrated Electricity-Heat Microgrid with Synergic Primary Frequency Regulation Resources
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a frequency-constrained dispatching method for integrated electricity-heat microgrids (IEHMs). It employs synergic primary frequency regulation (PFR) resources to arrest the frequency drops. First, the frequency security problem in IEHMs is described. Combined heat and power (CHP) unit and battery storage coordinate to PFR provision. The frequency nadir in the dynamic frequency evolution is modeled as second-order cone constraints. The total PFR provision is restricted considering quasi-steady-state frequency. Second, a frequency-constrained dispatching model for IEHMs is presented based on the frequency security constraints. PFR reserve capacities of CHP unit and battery storage are determined to secure frequency security and reduce the PFR reserve costs. Wind power uncertainty is described by a distributionally robust chance constraint. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method on the frequency security and economy is validated in case studies. The impact of heat load on PFR in IEHMs is also revealed by numerical tests.

articleTitle: A Spatiotemporal Interpolation Approach for Distributed PV Power Based on WPT and DTW
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The loss of electricity during transmission cannot be ignored, and a large number of power consumers are seeking flexible and affordable distributed generation methods to reduce electricity costs. However, a large number of distributed photovoltaic (PV) connections pose challenges to electric power dispatch and the security of power system. Accurate PV power forecast can solve these problems, which requires a large amount of accurate historical data to build forecast model. This article proposes a spatiotemporal interpolation method to complement historical data of PV sites. Wavelet packet transform (WPT) is applied to decompose original time sequence to stable sequence and fluctuant sequence. To eliminate the fluctuations caused by cloud movement, dynamic time warping (DTW) is used to regularize fluctuant sequences of adjacent PV sites. Finally, through spatial interpolation, a precise historical data can be obtained. The case study shows that under cloudy conditions, proposed interpolation method reduces the NRMSE by 0.51% compared to the direct interpolation algorithm.

articleTitle: Resilience Enhancement of Urban Integrated Energy Systems in Ice Storms
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In recent years, ice storms and other high-impact low-probability events have caused spatiotemporal infrastructure failures on the urban integrated energy systems. This paper firstly proposes an improved line fragile curve considering line aging to assess distribution lines condition against ice storms. Then an urban functional division based resilience quantification index is developed to assess impacts of ice storms on the distribution network. On this basis, an urban integrated energy system resilience enhancement strategy through coordinated dispatches of distributed power generation, heat network flexibility resource and multi-energy storage system is proposed, which significantly mitigates system critical load shedding during restoration processes. The system resilience enhancement strategy against ice storms is modeled as a mixed integer linear programming problem and rapidly solved to support the emergency response and restoration process. Methods proposed in this paper are tested in an integrated 33-node and 14-node electricity-heat network. The result demonstrates that the proposed method can effectively enhance the resilience of urban integrated energy system.

articleTitle: A Priority Scheduling Strategy of a Microgrid Using a Deep Reinforcement Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The fluctuation of renewable energy leads to a severe power fluctuation on the tie-line between microgrid (MG) and the power grid. A novel scheduling strategy is proposed in this paper to reduce power fluctuation based on a data-driven approach. The scheduling strategy is divided into two steps based on the scheduling priority of gas turbines, battery storage systems, and power-to-hydrogen devices. The aim is to minimize the penalties caused by the tie-line power fluctuation and operation costs of MG. And the scheduling optimization models are expressed as a Markov decision process. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: An Optimal Dispatching Method of Power Systems Considering Virtual Inertia Provided by Fuel Cells
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The increasing penetration of renewable energy sources (RES) is gradually replacing conventional synchronous machines, leading to a significant reduction in system inertia and an increase in frequency instability crises caused by power imbalances. The Proton Exchange Membrane fuel cell (FC) is capable of providing virtual inertia with fast response characteristics. However, there is a lack of a virtual inertia model for FC. This paper investigates the use of virtual inertia in supporting the optimal dispatch of power systems while considering frequency security constraints. The dispatching model features the rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) and nadir as frequency security indices. A synthetic virtual inertia evaluation model of the FC stack is proposed considering the “charge double layer” phenomenon. An optimal day-ahead dispatching model and solution method are presented for the power systems containing FCs considering frequency security constraints. Case studies based on a modified IEEE-118 test system show that the frequency support provided by FCs can effectively decrease RoCoF and maximum frequency deviation, thereby guaranteeing power systems' safety.

articleTitle: Distributed Photovoltaic Power Forecast Methods: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Climate change and global warming threaten both nature and humanity. Renewable energy is an effective way to solve this problem. Distributed photovoltaics (DPV) have attracted much attention due to their low environmental impact. But the uncertainty of DPV output is putting pressure on the distribution network. Therefore, DPV power prediction is very important. In this paper, the factors affecting DPV yield are reviewed and the forecasting methods are summarized. The results show that geographical location, weather parameters, photovoltaic panel characteristics, and data noise will affect the prediction results. The main forecasting methods are statistical forecasting and principle forecasting. Statistical forecasting methods perform better in forecasting. In the future, prediction algorithms will need to be improved to adapt to different conditions, such as weather and time scales. Data preprocessing algorithms also help to improve the accuracy and stability of predictions.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Emission Monitoring Indicator System of Power Users
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the proposal of the “carbon neutrality” goal in various countries, carbon emission as a global hot issue has been studied more and more. In this paper, a carbon emission monitoring indicator system for power users is built to solve the current lack of comprehensive assessment of carbon emission of power users. First, this paper summarizes the existing calculation methods of carbon emission flow of electric power. Based on the power flow tracing method, the calculation method of carbon emission flow of electric power users in this paper is determined from the source side, transmission side to distribution side of the power system. Secondly, based on the factor analysis method and the characteristics of the power system itself, the composition and influence of the indicator system are considered from the three major aspects of energy, economy and power grid. Then, based on the above three criteria levels, six definitions and calculation methods of carbon emission evaluation indicators are given respectively, thus forming a more comprehensive carbon emission monitoring indicator system for power users, and a comprehensive evaluation model based on analytic hierarchy process is established. Finally, the calculation and analysis are carried out based on the IEEE 33 standard distribution network node and user data, and the results show the effectiveness of the model and method in this paper.

articleTitle: Resilience Enhancement Strategies for High Speed Train Traction Motor Power System with Coupled Faults
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper analyzes the incipient fault detection and isolation issues of high speed train (HST) traction motor power system. The fault features in such a motor are obscure and tight coupling with few fault samples, and the fault separation vary in nonlinear pattern. Up until now, most existing fault diagnosis techniques have been presented under the condition that these faults are exclusive, which means there is only one fault once. However, in HST applications, coupled faults are more common to take place due to the interconnected nature of different components. To enhance the system resilience or the diagnostic accuracy is of great significance to HST safe operation. A novel fault severity model is proposed suitable for the normal and fault conditions. Then electromagnetic torque energy entropy coding is utilized to extract fault feature and construct different feature matrixes. Resilience enhancement strategies with support vector machine model is generated from a novel grey wolf optimizer algorithm. The perform of the proposed work is validated through simulation and experimentation on a fault testing verification platform for HST traction system.

Author Keywords: High-speed train traction motor power system
Accurate recognition rate of coupled faults

articleTitle: Generative Data-Driven Modeling of Aggregated Demand Curve in Day-Ahead Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper proposes a Generative-Data-Attention-Unet based method to conduct short-term modeling of aggregate demand curves (ADCs) in the day-ahead market (DAM). We first formulate the ADC modeling from a machine vision perspective. To overcome the lack of historical data, we generate the bidding data based on the ADC functions with prior knowledge. These synthesized data and functions are visualized as images and paired as training samples. After training, the developed attention U-net is able to extract a figure of ADC from the processed input data. Last, the pixel mapping and polynomial fitting process are developed to derive a mathematical form of the output ADC figure. Numerical results show the superiority of the proposed method via benchmarks.

articleTitle: A Robust Model Predictive Control Based Frequency Regulation Approach for Wind-Storage Joint System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Compared to wind power participating in grid frequency regulation independently, a wind-storage joint system has a better frequency regulation performance. Considering the high uncertainty of wind power generation due to environmental factors, this article proposes an optimization strategy for the wind-storage joint system to participate in frequency regulation based on robust model predictive control. First, based on the principle of frequency regulation, the response models of element in wind-storage joint systems are established. Secondly, aiming at minimizing the deviation cost of the system's frequency regulation power in the worst wind power output scenario, a two-layer objective function shaped like min-max is constructed, and the strong duality theory is used to transform it into a single-layer robust optimization model. Then, combined with the model predictive control idea, a robust model predictive control (RMPC) based frequency regulation model is formed. Finally, by comparing the effect difference between the model prediction control method in the deterministic scenario and the proposed method, the superiority of the proposed method in coping with the frequency regulation ability of wind power uncertainty fluctuation is proved.

articleTitle: An Online Fault Feeder Detection Method Based on Incremental and Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Data-driven machine learning (ML) methods have been verified to be effective in fault feeder detection (FFD) for small current grounded systems. Standard ML solution assumes that the training data is sufficient and static, which becomes infeasible in practice due to insufficient fault data for a single substation and dynamic changes in the statistical characteristics of fault data. Therefore, a novel data-driven method based on incremental and federated learning (FL) is proposed to address FFD under small samples. In this paper, a stochastic configuration network (SCN), a flat and noniterative training framework, is applied as a fault feeder classifier. Due to the concise structure and pseudo-inverse-based parameter training scheme, the SCN-based classifier can be trained and updated quickly. To get rid of the drawback of insufficient fault samples for a single substation, a FL-based solution is proposed to aggregate the fault feeder knowledge learned from other substations while maintaining local data privacy. Moreover, to adapt to the dynamic nature of the data, this paper proposes an incremental SCN (ISCN) to learn new fault features online and without forgetting. To verify the efficiency and advantages of the proposed scheme, experiments on actual county-level grid company data were performed. Results imply that in addition to improving FFD accuracy under small samples, the proposed method can also perform incremental learning to maintain accuracy in dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Design of Generation Capacity Cost Recovery Mechanism for the Early Stage Development of New Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The development of a new power system and electricity spot market has brought about significant changes in China's power system, affecting its planning, dispatching, and operation. However, the current single-electricity energy price system cannot adapt to the changing function and role positioning of the power system, causing difficulties in the normal production and operation of traditional generation sources. To address this challenge and ensure the long-term abundance of power generation capacity, a compatible electricity price system that includes a cost recovery mechanism for power generation capacity is urgently needed. This study proposes a power generation capacity payment mechanism that is adapted to the early stage of the development of the new power system, and analyzes the models, methods, and key elements of the mechanism. The analysis shows that the proposed mechanism can fully reflect the value of different capacity resources, provide reliable capacity for the system, facilitate the recovery of fixed costs, and play a positive role in ensuring the long-term abundance of power generation capacity. This contribution is crucial for the successful reform and development of China's power system.

articleTitle: An Extended SFR Model of Offshore Wind Farm Integrated by VSC-HVDC for Frequency Support
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the gradual growth of wind power penetration, the frequency stability problem under high-power disturbance is increasingly challenging. The frequency nadir is used as a key indicator for frequency monitoring and a decision basis for frequency control, this paper establishes an extended system frequency response(SFR) model considering the participation of offshore wind farm(OWF) and gives the analytical expression for the system frequency nadir. In addition, the interaction between rotor speed and system frequency is analyzed and a prediction model of rotor speed is established by using small signal analysis, then a method for adjusting the control coefficient of wind turbine(WT) taking into account the minimum rotor speed limit is proposed. Finally, using the allowed lowest frequency as a constraint, the critical value of power disturbance that triggers the action of under-frequency load shedding(UFLS) device is calculated. The simulation results verify the accuracy of the proposed method under different control parameters of WT.

articleTitle: Agent-Based Modeling of Small-Scale Clean Energy System Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper explores a self-adaptive energy management strategy for a clean energy system containing solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC), wind turbines, proton exchange membrane electrolysis cell (PEMEC), and high-pressured hydrogen storage tanks. A deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework is proposed to maximize the operating profit of this kind of clean energy system that consists of many heterogeneous energy facilities. The intelligent method can also help improve the operation efficiency and reduce the overall maintenance cost. Technically, the proposed solution methods use two independent neural networks to deal with possible value estimation and choice of the clean energy system operation actions, which makes it easier to replicate the best performance actions with highest economic benefit.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Strategy of Echelon Battery Energy Storage System Based on Battery Health State
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The life cycle of the battery can be extended and the waste of resources can be reduced by using the retired battery in echelon. In order to avoid the deep charge and discharge of the battery with lower health state, and make full use of the potential of the battery in good condition, a targeted control strategy is proposed, which takes into account the health state of the echelon battery as a key factor. Under the background that the echelon energy storage aims at coordinating the output plan of new energy power stations, firstly, each energy storage unit of the retired battery energy storage system is grouped based on the difference of the health state of the retired battery, and the power distribution of different energy storage units is carried out according to the energy storage charge and discharge demand, and a differentiated control strategy is proposed. Then, based on the rain-flow counting method and the equivalent cycle life method, the life of the cascade energy storage is evaluated. Finally, the results of an example show that the proposed control strategy has significant advantages over the existing control strategies in prolonging the working life of the echelon battery energy storage system.

articleTitle: A Sliding Model Control Strategy of Buck Converter in Photovoltaic Hydrogen Production System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The photovoltaic hydrogen production system has the potential for broad applications by directly converting light energy into hydrogen energy. However, the stability and efficiency of the system are negatively impacted by photovoltaic panels output fluctuations and proton exchange membrane electrolysis cell (PEMEC) load variations. To address these issues, this paper first proposes a sliding model control strategy for the buck converter in the photovoltaic hydrogen production system. Then, the basic principle and composition structure of the photovoltaic hydrogen production system are introduced. Finally, the precise control of the output voltage and current of the circuit is realized by establishing the mathematical model of the system and the design of the slide-mode controller. Simulation verification demonstrates that the control strategy effectively improves the system's stability and efficiency, thereby providing practical significance and reference value.

articleTitle: Equilibrium Analysis for Electricity Market Considering Carbon Emission Trading Based on Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the proposal of China's carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals, carbon emission trading (CET) is gradually participating in the electricity market to accelerate carbon emission reduction and the improvement of power supply structure. In this study, we analyze the impacts of CET on the electricity market based on the electricity market equilibrium model and multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (MADL) method. We firstly establish the electricity market clearing process involved CET and develop the bi-level problem to model the electricity market equilibrium with strategic generation company (GENCO) bidders. Then, a multi-agent Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MATD3) algorithm is applied to solve the market equilibrium described above. Finally, we simulate multiple cases based on a modified IEEE 30-bus system. The result shows that an excessive carbon price can raise the nodal electricity price and have a negative influence on reducing carbon emission, and an appropriately low carbon emission quota setting can help for carbon emission reduction.

articleTitle: An IGBT Device Health Status Assessment Method Considering the Influence of Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) is a critical component of power electronic equipment, and its health is of utmost importance to ensure the reliability and stability of the entire system. This paper proposes a method for assessing the health status of IGBT device under various operating conditions. Firstly, a finite element model of the IGBT device is established to analyze the influence of solder layer void and bond line detachment on the saturation voltage of the device. Secondly, the device parameters are simulated under different working conditions, and an adaptive neural network algorithm is used to establish the IGBT equipment health state evaluation model. Finally, the results of the model are analyzed, and the prediction results under random conditions are compared with the simulation results. The results show that this method effectively evaluates the health status of IGBT devices.

articleTitle: Transient Fault Current Calculation Method of Photovoltaic Grid-Connected System Considering the Dynamic Response of Phase-Locked Loop
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The transient fault characteristics of photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected system depend on the dynamic response of each control link. Phase-locked loop (PLL) plays an important role in PV grid-connected system. The dynamic output response of PLL affects the PV transient fault characteristics through coordinate transformation. Existing calculation method for PLL dynamic response is based on the premise that the voltage phase change at the point of common coupling (PCC) is small and the steady-state phase after the fault can be measured, and the calculation error of transient current is large. To accurately describe the PV transient fault characteristics, this work proposes a calculation method of PV transient fault current by considering the dynamic response of PLL. First, the dynamic characteristics of the current inner loop are analyzed in detail, and the transient fault current of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{d}-\boldsymbol{q}$</tex> axis is calculated. Second, the accurate calculation model of the dynamic response of PLL is established, and the dynamic output of PLL is obtained. The transient fault current calculation model considering the dynamic response of PLL is finally established. Compared with existing calculation method for transient fault current, the proposed method accurately describes the dynamic response characteristics of PLL and the PV transient current change characteristics. Finally, simulation analysis based on PSCAD/EMTDC verifies the accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Capacity Estimation of Lithium-Ion Batteries Using Electrochemical Impedance Spectroscopy and Optimized Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The fast and accurate estimation of lithium-ion battery capacity is crucial for ensuring their safe and reliable operation and for studying the optimal utilization of retired batteries. In this paper, we propose a new method for estimating the available capacity of lithium-ion batteries based on their electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS). Firstly, features are extracted from the EIS and its distribution of relaxation time during battery aging, and a health feature set is constructed using an improved mutual information technique for feature selection. Then, the capacity of the lithium-ion battery is estimated using the improved whale optimization algorithm-extreme learning machine (IWOA-ELM). It is demonstrated through experimental results that the capacity can be accurately estimated using the IWOA-ELM method, with the root mean square error controlled within <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm$</tex>1%.

articleTitle: Investigation and Analysis of Power Load Density for Commercial Buildings
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Load density of commercial buildings affects the planning and design of power system. Aiming at the problem that the existing reference data do not conform to the principle of economy and rationality, the research method and process of load density of commercial buildings are proposed. The load density of sixteen commercial buildings across the country is investigated, and the upper limit of power load density of general commercial buildings is summarized to provide reference for commercial power load planning based on this method.

articleTitle: Classification Method of Customer Based on Load Curve Image Information
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The classification of customer is an essential basis for demand-side-oriented power system operation and control research. In order to accurately identify the customer behavior, this paper proposes a classification method of customer based on load curve image information. Inspired by the application of deep learning theory in image processing, the one-dimensional load series is transformed into a two-dimensional recurrence plot as the input sample, then convolutional neural network (CNN) and support vector machine (SVM) algorithms are combined to construct a load feature extraction and customer classification model, so that the machine vision technique can work to extract curve feature without temporal information loss of the load data. SVM is introduced as the classifier in the CNN model, and the optimal classification hyperplane is built in the high-dimensional feature space by adjusting the classification threshold and hyperplane normal vector which enables the customer classification to accurately reflect the daily load curve feature. Simulations are performed using practical load data of a city in China, and the results show that the load curve image information based method has satisfactory performance in terms of the effectiveness of customer classification and the accuracy of feature extraction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors and Risk Assessment of Grid Closing Based on EMD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Limited by complex construction conditions and high transformation cost, some regions present the problems of insufficient power supply and lower power system reliability. To reduce power outages on grid loads and improve the power supply capacity of regional power grid, short-term power grid closing can be used for grid load transfer. Based on this, this paper analyzes influencing factors of power grid closing and the problem it could couse. Frist of all, considering the change of electrical variables near the closing point in the closing process, the Empirical Mode Decomposition method is used to decompose the corresponding electrical variables curve, and it can display the components of the turbulence visually during closing process, and the theoretical analysis of the closing process was verified through this method. And then, paper shows the study of the impact on power angle stability, current and voltage stability and steady-state power flow transfer. Secondly, the article summarizes the subjective factors and objective factors that could affect grid security during closing, and proposes four risk indexes for power grid closing. In the meantime, the article takes the local power grid closing operation in a certain region as an example to verify the rationality of the closing risk indicator.

articleTitle: Decision-Making Support Method for Control Strategies of Hybrid Cascaded MTDC System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For large scale renewable energy integration, the appliance of hybrid cascaded HVDC transmission technology has become a development trend in the future DC power grid, which combines the advantages of LCC-HVDC such as high capacity and low cost, as well as the advantages of VSC-HVDC such as flexible power control and passive power supply. At present, hybrid cascaded HVDC transmission technology has been adopted in the Baihetan and Wudongde DC transmission projects, with advantages verified. However, for the simultaneous application of different converter station technologies in the system, the control mechanism of the system becomes complex, and there will be an exponential growth trend in the number of control strategy combinations for multiple converter stations. In the actual power system operation control, it is difficult for dispatchers to analyze the operation mechanism and select the feasible ones from many control strategy combinations according to the demand, which brings decision difficulties to dispatchers. Therefore, this paper presents a decision-making support method for control strategies of hybrid cascaded MTDC system, which analyses the system operation status based on scheduling requirements and provides reasonable control modes and corresponding command values for different converter stations. Simulation results based on PSCAD/EMTDC verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Price Linkage Formulas for Medium and Long-Term Interprovincial Power Contracts
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper aims to improve the market price formation mechanism for electricity, guide the market to trade electricity prices that fully reflect changes in costs, and encourage the purchase and sale of electricity in medium and long-term contracts. The aim is to establish a market-determined price mechanism for electricity, avoid market risks caused by fluctuations in primary energy prices, better protect the interests of both buyers and sellers in the electricity market, and ensure a stable energy supply.

articleTitle: Planning of Energy Hub in PIES Considering the Energy Consumption Regulation of Logistics System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the deepening of port electrification, the further coupling of energy flow system and logistics system will be a key feature of the port integrated energy system (PIES) in the future. In order to fully exploit the flexible resources of the logistics system and promote the optimal allocation of resources, this paper proposes a novel energy hub (EH) planning model for the PIES considering the energy consumption regulation of the logistics system. First, the energy consumption of each link of the logistics system is modeled, and the basic framework of the PIES is built to analyze the energy consumption regulation of the logistics system. Then, with the objective function of minimizing the total cost, the planning model of PIES considering the energy consumption regulation of the logistics system is constructed. Finally, according to whether or not to consider adjustable characteristics, two cases are carried out, based on an actual example in Tianjin Port, China. On the basis of comparative analysis, the positive effect on reducing equipment capacity and investment costs is verified effectively.

articleTitle: Discussion on Performance of Several Typical Capacitive Equalization Topologies under Different SOC Distributions
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Inconsistency of battery has an impact on service life and safety of the system. Many switched capacitive equalization topologies have been proposed to cope with this issue. Most switched capacitive equalization topologies are improved based on traditional capacitive equalization topologies and do not pay attention to the impact of different state of charge (SOC) distributions on the equalization performance. In order to solve this problem, this paper designs three evaluation criteria (the degree of voltage equalization, the degree of SOC equalization, and energy loss) and compares them with the equalization performance of Conventional Switched-capacitor Cell Equalizer, Series-parallel SC Cell Equalizer and Optimized SC Cell Equalizer under four cases of different SOC distribution. The experimental results show that the impact of different SOC distributions on the SPSCE is minimal in three topologies. This provides experimental basis for the capacitive switching topologies to solve the SOC distribution inconsistency in the future.

articleTitle: Sampling Aliasing Analysis for Parallel Grid-Tie Inverters Based on Frequency-Domain Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A microgrid usually contains a large amount of power electronic inverters, the interaction of these inverters can introduce a series of system instability and power quality issues. Inverter is a common power electronic inverters in the microgrid, investigations on the influence between sampling frequency and switching frequency are also not expanded. In fact, when the outputs of multiple inverters are connected in parallel, due to the differences of their switching frequencies and sampling frequencies, the interaction of them can introduce beat frequency oscillation in low frequency regions, even the differences are small.
