In this paper, a parallel grid-tied inverters model based on sampling aliasing in frequency-domain is developed to predict the beat frequency oscillation in low frequency region.

articleTitle: A Theoretical Line Loss Calculation Model Based on Analytic Hierarchy Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Wind power and photovoltaic output are characterized by random volatility and large uncertainty. As a result, the theoretical line loss of the distribution network will produce new unknown line loss and there is a large error in the calculation. In order to calculate and predict the theoretical line loss more accurately, a lean calculation method of line loss is proposed, which takes into account many factors, such as temperature rise compensation, corona loss, load rate and wind-wind complementarity. The influence weight of each factor on the calculation of theoretical line loss is compared by analytic hierarchy process (AHP), and the variation of theoretical line loss under different influencing factors is calculated respectively, and the weighted sum of them is summed. The comprehensive line loss obtained by this method is taken as a new basis, which is more consistent with the actual situation of line loss. Compared with the traditional average daily load curve method or daily maximum load method, the proposed method is more comprehensive in consideration of the situation and more accurate in the calculation of theoretical line loss.

articleTitle: Robust Optimal Economic Dispatch of Microgrid with Stepwise Demand Response Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to solve the influence of uncertainty on scheduling in the microgrid and reduce the conservativeness of the robust optimization algorithm, a robust optimized economic scheduling strategy for microgrid with stepwise demand response mechanism is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a stepwise demand response mechanism is constructed to enhance the motivation of customer response and optimize the load curve on demand side. Then, considering the uncertainty of PV output, a two-stage robust optimal dispatching model of the microgrid is established. Based on the optimized load curve, the optimization model could be solved by column and constraint generation method. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is verified by simulation cases. The results show that the proposed model can effectively enhance the enthusiasm of customers to participate in demand response and reduce the conservativeness of the robust optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Active Support Control Strategy for Wind-Storage Power Generation Based on Virtual Oscillation Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the wide application of wind power generation technology, wind power is connected to the grid through the converter, which increases the pressure on the grid for voltage and frequency regulation. The virtual oscillator control strategy enables the inverter to simulate nonlinear oscillation circuit operation, which still has good stability even in low-inertia grids, compensates for the reduction of system strength due to insufficient synchronizer ratio, and reduces voltage fluctuation and frequency deterioration. In this paper, an active support control strategy of wind turbine converter based on a virtual oscillator is proposed. The strategy keeps the DC bus voltage stable, gives the given value of active power on the grid side, gets the given value of inverter output voltage through virtual oscillator control. Then output PWM through voltage outer loop and current inner loop to control the inverter output current to realize the frequency support of wind turbine converter. The simulation results show that the virtual oscillator-based wind-storage power generation control has good frequency response characteristics.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Industrial Integrated Energy System Based on Grey Correlation Analysis and Entropy Weight Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The integrated energy system that couples conventional energy systems with emerging renewable energy systems has gradually become an important technical means to cope with global energy and environmental crises. Its essence of “on-demand energy supply and cascade utilization” can perfectly adapt to the energy consumption needs of industrial enterprises with “high energy consumption, high cost, and diverse types”. In this study, an evaluation index system that covers economic, environmental, and technical aspects has been developed for the industrial integrated energy systems. Moreover, a comprehensive evaluation method based on grey correlation analysis and entropy weight method is proposed. According to the simulation results of a numerical study, the deep cascade utilization of waste heat and the introduction of renewable energy can both improve the comprehensive performance of the industrial integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Method of Eliminating Transmission Line Overload in Electricity Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: China is promoting inter-provincial electricity spot market construction to optimally allocate power resources in a broader scope. At present, China's electricity spot market first executes inter-provincial transactions to determine tie-line power and then executes intra-provincial transactions. However, in AC interconnected power grid, when merely taking the tie-line power as power injection of border nodes, the results of intra-provincial market clearing may engender transmission line overload. This paper first established electricity spot market clearing models, then analyzed the causation for transmission line overload and proposed the concept of critical border nodes. Ultimately the method based on phase angle monitor is proposed to eliminate transmission line overload. A modified IEEE-39 system is tested to prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control Based Power Scheduling of Offshore Wind Farm for Primary Frequency Support Considering Turbulent Wind Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Offshore wind power is expected to continue to grow strongly in the near future. And it is necessary for the offshore wind power to participate in power system primary frequency regulation. In this paper, we propose a MPC based power scheduling approach for offshore wind farm to provide primary frequency support. The uncertainty of turbulent wind is first modeled using a trajectory envelope. Next, the mathematical models for wind turbine and offshore wind farm for primary frequency regulation are presented. Then, the MPC based scheme for power scheduling of offshore wind farm to participated in primary frequency regulation is developed. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed power scheduling strategy with numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation Method of Aggregation Flexibility for Multi-Node Distributed Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper discusses the evaluation of flexibility in multi-point distributed energy storage systems. It deeply analyzes the definition and connotation of flexibility in the power system, proposes an evaluation index and method for flexibility in multi-point distributed energy storage systems considering the aggregation effect, and verifies the applicability and effectiveness of the method through a case analysis of the Shandong power grid-side energy storage demonstration project. The study shows that the evaluation index and method considering the aggregation effect can effectively quantify the flexible regulation ability of multi-point distributed energy storage systems in response to uncertain changes in the system. The study in this paper can help improve the quantitative decision-making level of energy storage station scheduling and operation, and has certain practical engineering value.

articleTitle: Coordinated Design of Controller Parameters and Locating Optimization of Controller of Wind-Thermal-Bundled System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The wind-thermal-bundled(WTB) transmission has become an important way of wind power generation delivery. This paper proposes a coordinated design method for power system stabilizer(PSS) and unified power flow controller with power oscillation damping(UPFC-POD) controller to enhance the damping of low-frequency oscillation(LFO) in WTB system. The installation location of UPFC affects the power flow distribution of the system and the active network losses of the system. If installed in an inappropriate location, it will result in large active network losses and high system operating costs. This paper adopts the multi-objective salp swarm algorithm(MSSA) to transform controller coordination optimization and UPFC location optimization into multi-objective optimization problem, in order to enhance the stability and operational economy of the WTB system. The proposed method is evaluated on an IEEE 4-machine 2-area system. The analysis of the results shows that the optimized controller has good ability to damp LFO and reduce network losses in WTB system.

articleTitle: Submodule Capacitor Lifetime Increment Method for Modular Multilevel Converters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The lifetime of a modular multilevel converter (MMC) mainly depends on the lifetime of submodule capacitor, and the lifetime of submodule capacitor is closely related to its working voltage. Most papers, however, rarely directly identify the relationship between the two. Therefore, based on the control strategy of MMC, this paper proposes a technique to extend the service lifetime of the submodule capacitor by changing the capacitor working voltage. By reducing the working voltage of the capacitor, this method can extend its service lifetime, while keeping the DC side voltage and output power of MMC unchanged. Finally, simulation results validate the proposed capacitor lifetime extension method.

articleTitle: Design of a Standard Energy Block Trading Mechanism with High Percentage of New Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the large-scale access of new energy, due to its different power generation characteristics of different types of subjects, and the existence of randomness, volatility characteristics. On this basis, this paper introduces energy block technology, designs different energy block varieties according to the power output characteristics of different new energy subjects, and establishes a medium- and long-term trading organization process based on standard energy blocks, which greatly improves the standardization and flexibility of the electricity market and provides an important theoretical support for the large-scale access of new energy subjects. It provides important theoretical support for the large-scale access of new energy entities.

articleTitle: Research on Load Capacity Improvement of Electric Vehicles Based on Orderly Charging
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the environmental pollution caused by fossil energy consumption becomes more and more serious, the development of electric vehicles has received attention, so it is important to study the carrying capacity of the power system for electric vehicle charging load for practical guidance. The electric vehicle charging load is simulated by Monte Carlo. The maximum load capacity and node voltage deviation are selected as the operating constraints. The total electric load of the industrial park under different electric vehicle scales is simulated with the actual lines in Jiangsu Province as an example. The key reasons for limiting EV access are analyzed according to the parameters of the operating limiting conditions at the maximum EV scale. The impact of distributed PV access scale on the EV carrying capacity is simulated. The results show that the access to an appropriate amount of distributed PV can help alleviate the voltage dips at the nodes of the industrial park caused by the access of electric vehicles, and make the system operate safely and stably.

articleTitle: A New Generation Cost Analysis Method of High Renewable Penetration Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy, the power grid needs to pay more and more cost to ensure the security and stability operation. Meanwhile the total generation costs are reduced with the falling cost of renewable generation. Distinguishing the use of the total power system costs can give the system operator a direct way to understand these changes. This paper proposes a practical usage division method of the life cycle cost of the power system, which aims to classify the total cost into four types-the environmental cost, the energy supply cost, the adequacy cost and the safety cost. The example analyses a real power system, and shows that the proposed method can provide a reliable and comprehensible reference for the qualitative analysis of power grid operation and development.

articleTitle: Protection Analysis of Electron Cyclotron Resonance Heating System for Magnetic Confinement Fusion Experimental Facility
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Electron cyclotron resonance heating is an important magnetic confinement fusion heating method. This paper analyzes the relevant signals in detail when protection occurs, which plays an important role in studying the operation law of the gyrotron and ensuring the normal operation of the ECRH system.

articleTitle: A Multi-Market Collaborative Trading Model for Load Aggregator
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Under the development mode of the new-type power system, a high proportion of renewable energy is connected to the grid, which makes it difficult to effectively support the safe and reliable supply of power and the safe and stable operation of the system by solely relying on flexible resources on the power supply side and power grid. It is urgent to guide flexible resources on the load side to actively participate in the system operation. As an emerging market entity, load aggregators can more effectively leverage the utility of the load side in system operation and market transactions by aggregating flexible load resources. Therefore, in this paper, load aggregator is used to aggregate load side resources to participate in electricity energy market and auxiliary service market. Firstly, it analyzes the framework for load aggregator to participate in diversified market transactions. Then, a combination model of load aggregator's multiple market collaborative transaction is proposed, which includes the transaction bidding model of load aggregator and the joint clearing model of energy and auxiliary service market. Finally, the verification analysis is carried out with a calculation example. The results show that the participation of load aggregator in multiple market transactions of energy and auxiliary service can increase its economic benefit, reduce system operating cost, and bring better economy and scheduling flexibility to system operation.

articleTitle: Implement of Local Trip Detection and Intelligent Repower Method of Smart Meters
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As China continues to strengthen its focus on its “double carbon” development goals, the power industry urgently needs to promote industrial restructuring to improve customer service quality. Among them, trip detection and quick repower work have been essential to customer experience. However, the traditional repower method has high requirements for communication quality and operation and maintenance personnel. Although many existing improvement solutions are feasible, they suffer from high cost and difficult deployment. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a local trip detection and intelligent repower method of smart meters, aiming to achieve a rapid transition to the existing repower architecture. First, the problems of the current trip detection and repower work are introduced. Then, the improvement process and the related service system are designed. Finally, functional testing and analysis were conducted. The results show that the method can effectively improve the user experience of the power-out and repower process.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Dispatch of Dynamic Reorganization Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To further enhance the profitability of virtual power plants, this paper proposes a multi-market model for virtual power plants. By developing a dynamic reorganization bidding model for virtual power plants, it improves the situation where virtual power plants can only participate in one type of electricity market service. This paper also develops a simulation terminal for virtual power plants, which is connected to a dispatch cloud system and conducts experimental verification. The case study shows that participating in multiple markets can enhance the profitability of virtual power plants and improve the current situation of participating in a single electricity market.

articleTitle: IoT Intelligent Sensing Terminal Test Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the forefront of the entire Internet of Things information collection and processing, IoT terminals are widely used in industry, environmental protection, daily life and other fields, and play an increasingly important role. After the completion of terminal manufacturing, how to effectively test the functional integrity, external disturbance stability and dynamic response of the hardware system is an important problem that must be solved in the development of the intelligent sensing terminal platform of the Internet of Things. Aiming at the problems existing in the traditional test method RF method, a test scheme of intelligent terminal system based on Simulink and RTU-BOX is proposed. The integrated terminal-in-the-loop test platform for autonomous intelligent processing of the Internet of Things is designed. The characteristics of various sensors are analyzed, an intelligent terminal test environment driven by application scenarios is established, and the performance of the terminal is evaluated and tested.

articleTitle: Optimal Anomaly Threshold Selection for Monitoring Grid-Connected Lithium-Ion Battery Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Safety of grid-connected Lithium-ion battery systems is a challenging issue. With advancements in Lithium-ion battery monitoring, early signs of battery failure can be effectively detected. However, the determination of warning thresholds remains a great challenge for different systems in commercial operation. To fill this gap, this paper presents an optimal anomaly threshold selection method for Lithium-ion Battery storage monitoring from an insurance perspective. The proposed method incorporates Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD) measurement and false alarm rate evaluation in the threshold selection. As a result, a threshold can be selected through the proposed method without increasing extra burden.

articleTitle: Research on Quantitative Model of Metro Traction Energy Consumption Considering Temporal and Spatial Characteristics of Passenger Flow
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The increasing trend of long distance and high energy consumption is shown by the world's metro. An accurate calculation of energy consumption is the key premise for metro energy saving and consumption reduction, with traction energy consumption (TEC) occupies about 45%~60% of the total metro energy consumption. Therefore, this paper proposes a quantitative model of metro TEC based on dynamic passenger flow (PF) characteristics. Based on the analysis of the dynamic distribution characteristics of metro PF, a mathematical relationship between dynamic PF and TEC was established to characterize and quantify its impact on TEC. Secondly, a calculation model of TEC considering regenerative braking energy (RBE) feedback utilization is proposed. By introducing dynamic PF, the energy consumption of section traction is calculated quantitatively. Finally, an actual metro line with test parameters is selected for the analysis of the calculation example. The simulation results show that the proposed model can improve the calculation accuracy compared with the traditional quantification method, and the net energy consumption calculation error is 3.73%. The model can be used to calculate the TEC of the metro under the current operating strategy.

articleTitle: Load Aggregation Method for Electric Vehicle Based on SOM Neural Network Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The large-scale development of electric vehicles will have a great impact on the power grid. However, individual electric vehicles cannot directly participate in the power grid operation, so it is really necessary to analyze the polymerization characteristics of EVs. The current polymerization method of EVs is to analyze the physical characteristics of a single EV, and then we aggregate. However, there are differences in the characteristics of different types of EV, so it is necessary to cluster electric vehicles first and then aggregate them. This paper presents a load aggregation method for EVs based on SOM neural network clustering. Firstly, SOM neural network is used to cluster different kinds of electric vehicles. Then, the clustering results are aggregated. In this way, the accuracy of aggregation model can be improved.

articleTitle: A Capacity Planning Scheme Based on Deep Temporal Clustering of 500kV Main Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to adapt to the new situation of power grid development, the power grid planning needs to modify to a more detailed planning mode and carry out the power grid transformation project accurately. This paper presents a capacity planning scheme based on deep temporal clustering of 500kV transformers, which can provide us with more elaborate information about dynamical partition of the main transformers. We utilize 500kV main transformers from the East China power grid to test our scheme. The results demonstrate that the capacity shortage for four provinces given by our method for 2022 is three percent less than planning for 2022 made by electricity planning department, and capacity shortage for 2025 is nearly one-third lower than that for 14th Five-Year Plan. By mastering the dynamic partition aggregation relationship of 500kV main transformer, considering the complementarity of power supply to 220kV region between multiple main transformers in the same division, we can locate the weak point of the power grid. We have applied the research results to form an intelligent capacity planning module for main transformer, we hope big data can assist enhancing the operation and administration level of the regional power grid, creating economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Operation Optimization of Active Distribution Network Considering Linearized Power Flow Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To deal with the nonlinear problem of the active distribution network (ADN) flow equation model, a linearized power flow constraints is proposed. Taking the minimum power purchase cost and the operation cost of distributed generation power as the objective, and considering the flexible characteristics of the load in the ADN, a mathematical model of the flexible load is structured. Then, to improve the computational efficiency, linear change of AC Load Flow (AC-LF)equation in the proposed model; Finally, the validity of the put forward model is demonstrated by the simulation of the IEEE 33 -bus ADN and the IEE E 69-bus ADN.

articleTitle: Robust Optimal Framework of Carbon Capture, Storage and Utilization in a Microgrid with Power to Gas Facilities
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper provides a scheduling strategy that is designed to ensure the robustness of a multi-energy microgrid that has power to gas facilities. The microgrid is composed of hydrogen, electricity, and gas as energy carriers, and demands are met by means of electrolysis as the central point. In order to mitigate CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions from gas-fired units and promote the methanation process, carbon capture utilization and storage (CCUS) is employed. The employed energy transformations comprise P2H (power to hydrogen), H2P (hydrogen to power), and H2G (hydrogen to gas). To enhance the energy system, a hydrogen storage system (HSS) is implemented and hydrogen vehicles (HV) are also considered as a demand. Information gap decision theory (IGDT) is used to create a solid plan of action to deal with the risks associated with renewable energy sources. The effectiveness of the suggested approach is assessed by a series of studies that are examined on a test system.

articleTitle: Assessing the Utilization of Clean Power in Megacities Through an AHP-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The Paris Agreement made in 2015 triggers the decarbonization trend around the globe. Many countries have joined the fight against climate change as the trend proliferates. Mega-cities are under the spotlight for being to blame for producing the major partials of the total emissions of urban areas. This study proposes an evaluation framework that assesses clean energy production and consumption, energy cost, and supply stability of megacities through an analytic hierarchy process (AHP) based approach. The purpose of the assessment system is to quantify the cleanness of a power system and tracks system performance toward carbon neutrality. We applied the structured assessment to the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area by the data from the latest three consecutive years.

articleTitle: Robust Coordinated Dispatch Strategy for the Power System with Large Offshore Wind Power Integration Under a Typhoon
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The installed capacity of offshore wind farms is growing rapidly, especially in recent years with the accelerated development of offshore wind power in China. The regions with more offshore wind power installations are also areas where typhoons are frequent, and the impact of typhoons on the safe and economic operation of offshore wind farms cannot be ignored. This paper proposes a robustly coordinated operation method of the power system with large offshore wind power integration during a typhoon. The method aims to cope with the uncertainty and disruption caused by a typhoon. The method consists of two parts: a model for orderly cut-off and recovery of offshore wind farms that considers typhoon uncertainties, and a two-stage robust optimization model for coordinated dispatch strategy that is solved by column-and-constraint generation (C&CG) algorithm and strong duality theory. The proposed method is applied to the modified IEEE 39-bus system and the simulation results demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Strategy for MMC with Maximum Line-to-Line Voltage Capacity
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, the constraint based on the arm output voltage is established to analyze the linear modulation region when the modular multilevel converter (MMC) submodule faults. According to it, the maximum line-to-line voltage is rigorously analyzed. To address the drawback of the low line-to-line voltage capability of the existing fault-tolerant strategy, this paper proposes a novel fault-tolerant strategy. MMC achieves maximum line-to-line voltage capability by injecting zero sequence voltage. The zero sequence voltage is carefully selected to avoid over-modulation, and PI controller is employed to regulate arm capacitor voltage. Finally, the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed strategy are verified by experiment results.

articleTitle: Research on Recovery Strategy of Wind Turbine Speed Considering Wind Speed Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: After a wind turbine completes frequency regulation action, it is necessary to restore its speed to a stable operation point. During the speedy recovery stage, two effects occur: a large time scale of speed recovery of about tens of seconds or even minutes, and wind speed fluctuations. This paper proposes a speedy recovery strategy considering wind speed fluctuations. The strategy considers the influence of wind speed fluctuation and the electromechanical power reference value, which is dynamically adjusted to safely and smoothly restore the speed. The proposed strategy is verified through simulation comparison of recovery strategies in different scenarios, and results show an improvement in speedy recovery after wind turbine participation in frequency regulation.

articleTitle: Day-Ahead Scheduling Strategy for Bulk Power System Based on Accurate Prediction of Wind Power Output
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Considering that more and more large-scale renewable energy is connected to the bulk power system, the fluctuation and uncertainty of its output make it difficult to make day-ahead dispatching plan. On the basis of historical data of wind power output, this paper proposed a day-ahead scheduling strategy for bulk power system based on accurate prediction of wind power output. Firstly, an improved Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM) neural network prediction model is proposed to predict the wind power output accurately, then a day-ahead scheduling model is established. Finally, the proposed mothed is tested on modified IEEE-30 system to verify the effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Medium Voltage Network Planning Method Considering the Probability of Distributed Generation and Flexible Load Rate Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: A novel method considering the probability of DG and load (distributed generation) characteristics and flexible load rate constraints is proposed to balance reliability and economy in distribution system network planning. Firstly, a method for calculating the number of outgoing lines in substations is proposed, taking into account the probability of DG and load and the constraints of flexible load rate. Secondly, a network planning model is established, which comprehensively considers reliability and economy. Then, the optimal solution is selected by comparing the network planning schemes corresponding to the number of lines in each group. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through a test system.

articleTitle: Review on Energy Storage Participation in Capacity Configuration and Scheduling Optimization in Modern Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: After large-scale integration of renewable energy, the power supply and load structure of the system have undergone tremendous changes. The fluctuation and intermittence of renewable energy power generation output bring about the problem of grid peak shaving. Energy storage is one of the effective solutions. This paper reviews various peak shaving methods of energy storage capacity configuration optimization method and dispatching operation optimization method. Firstly, the optimization methods of energy storage capacity configuration are reviewed from two aspects: energy storage consumption and energy storage economic cost. The economic cost refers to the maximum economic effect and the minimum system cost. The energy storage consumption refers to the maximum consumption, the optimal ratio, the minimum power and the minimum capacity. Secondly, the energy storage scheduling operation optimization method is classified and summarized from a single time scale and multiple time scales. The single time scale is to use the day-ahead and intra-day scheduling to adjust the peak respectively, and the multiple time scale is to combine the advantages of the two to adjust the peak. Finally, the prospect of energy storage participating in peak regulation of modern power system is prospected.

articleTitle: A Chinese Word Segmentation Model for SCD Text in Smart Grid Station: An Attention-BiLSTM-CRF Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a novel Chinese word segmentation (CWS) model, named as the optimized Attention-Bidirectional - Long Short-Term Memory-Conditional Random Field (Attention-BiLSTM-CRF), is specifically designed for substation configuration description (SCD) text data in smart grid station. In the proposed model, the Skip-Gram algorithm is utilized to convert word data into distributed vectors, then by integrating the attention mechanism, LSTM, and CRF, the new segmentation model named as Attention-BiLSTM-CRF is developed, which is more suitable for SCD text data in smart grid station. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed approach is demonstrated through a case study based on SCD text data. Simulation results show that the proposed model can achieve a higher accuracy rate of 98.2%, and it can be observed that the proposed CWS approach had higher accuracy and speed in the field of smart grid.

articleTitle: A Correlation-XGBoost Based Distributed Photovoltaic Output Prediction Method Considering Regional Meteorological Factor
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the development of distributed resources and new types of loads in the distribution network, distributed photovoltaics (PV) have been vigorously developed. Due to the strong correlation between the power output of photovoltaics and meteorological factors such as irradiance, wind speed, temperature, and humidity, it has volatility and newly built distributed photovoltaics lack accurate historical meteorological and power generation data, making it difficult to predict. Therefore, this paper proposes a distributed photovoltaic power output prediction method based on regional meteorological characteristic correlation-XGBoost. Firstly, the physical entity of the distributed photovoltaic system is combined with the digital driving model to achieve data synchronization and real-time updates, then, using the gray correlation analysis method to select the meteorological factors that have a greater impact on the power output of distributed photovoltaics, the selected meteorological correlation data set is trained using the XGBoost algorithm and combined with the weather forecast to predict the power output of distributed photovoltaics. Finally, the training model of the distributed photovoltaics with historical data is used to predict the newly built distributed photovoltaics without historical data. An example is used to analyze and predict the distributed photovoltaic data in a certain area, which verifies the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method and can obtain more accurate prediction results than traditional prediction methods.

articleTitle: Establishment of Short-Term Load Forecasting Model Based on Combinatorial Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Short-term power load forecasting has been closely linked with the modernization of power system management, which is an important guarantee for the safe and stable operation of power system and the improvement of economic benefits. Based on the combination algorithm of wavelet transform and particle swarm gray neural network, this paper presents a new short-term power load prediction model. The power load is decomposed into different frequency components from coarse to fine by multi-resolution analysis of wavelet transform. The unit root test method is used to select the most appropriate wavelet decomposition layers, the decomposed wavelet components according to their different characteristics to build their own grey neural network prediction models, and the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the weight threshold to solve the problem of local minimization. Finally, the expected prediction results are obtained through the wavelet reconstruction. Through a practical example, the results show that the short-term power load prediction model based on combinatorial optimization proposed in this paper has a high prediction accuracy, which verifies the rationality and feasibility of the prediction model. It has important guiding significance for the power department to maintain the safe and stable operation of the power grid and realize the economical and reasonable power dispatching.

articleTitle: Research on Combination Strategy of Distributed Energy Resources Based on Cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Since the Double-carbon goal was proposed, distributed energy resources (DERs) can be aggregated as a virtual power plant (VPP) to accommodate new energy resources and mitigate risk. This paper studies the income of a VPP and the profit distribution of each participant involved in the VPP based on the cooperative game theory. Moreover, the profit distribution model of a VPP is established, utilizing improved Shapley value method with correction coefficient. Finally, numerical examples are provided to validate the proposed model which can improve the income of the VPP, and reasonably distribute the profits to the participants, so as to ensure the stability of the VPP operation and the enthusiasm of the participants.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Demand Response Potential Assessment
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The high growth of electricity load brings increasing pressure on the supply side, and demand response is an effective measure to solve this problem. In order to fully exploit the demand response potential of customers, a demand response potential assessment method based on big data clustering is proposed to realize the quantitative analysis of response potential based on historical load data of customers. The analysis can provide intuitive and reliable data support for grid companies to select high quality customers with high demand response potential. The results verify the validity and rationality of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on Distributed Flexible Resource Planning Method for Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Integrated Energy System (IES), which can enhance energy utilization efficiency and make optimal allocation of energy, information, and value, is crucial for achieving clean, low-carbon, efficient and sustainable development. The IES covers different energy links such as production, transmission, consumption, storage and conversion, as well as various energy forms such as cold, heat, electricity and gas. Therefore, there are many technical routes, which bring great challenges to the planning work. This paper proposes a distributed flexible resource planning method for the IES based on discrete grid model, which converts continuous time and loads in the load curve to discrete time intervals and loads to obtain a series of grids; then configure the equipment capacity and operation scheme according to the grids. It can not only reduce the difficulty of the IES modeling and solving, but also avoid the influence of subjectivity of planners.

articleTitle: A Copula-Based Evaluation Method for the Available Inertia of Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of wind power, the accurate evaluation of available inertia in wind farm (WF) has been paid much attention. In this paper, a Copula-based evaluation method for the available inertia of WF is proposed, which considers the difference of wind speed and rotor speed of each wind turbine. The kernel density function is applied to model the wind speed and rotor speed. To obtain the conditional distribution function of the rotor speed, an optimal Copula model accurately describing the correlation between the wind speed and the rotor speed is developed. Based on the mathematical model between the rotor speed and the available inertia, the confidence interval of the WF available inertia is obtained. The effectiveness of the proposed available inertia evaluation method is verified by a WF located in southeast China.

articleTitle: Relative Health Status Assessment and Power Allocation of Wind Turbines Based on SSA Optimized VMD
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the background of a high proportion of renewable energy sources connected to the grid, the power system dispatch has put higher requirements on the responsiveness of the new energy field stations. Accurate assessment of the health status of the unit is conducive to achieving rapid response to higher-level dispatch and allowing sufficient time for the implementation of regulatory measures. This paper extracts features from the original signal using variational modal decomposition to form a feature matrix characterizing the unit state. In order to reduce the subjective dependence in the application of the Variational Modal Decomposition (VMD), the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) is used to achieve fast optimization of the VMD hyperparameters by setting the first modal envelope entropy fitness function. Then, the Pearson correlation coefficient matrix filters the practical features and reduces the interference of redundant information in the original feature matrix. Finally, the relative health of the unit is characterized according to the relative distance of the feature vectors, which provides a basis for selecting the subsequent system regulation. The effectiveness of the proposed method was verified by using actual operational data of a wind farm for analysis.

articleTitle: Current Transformer Saturation Detection and Compensation Correction Technology Based on Intelligent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the continuous development of DC power transmission project, the DC current generated by it will invade the AC system, and the DC magnetic bias effect on the power system is becoming more and more serious. As the electromagnetic current transformer is the main metering device in the current power system, when the fault current flows through the current transformer, the hysteresis characteristics will lead to the distortion of the secondary side current of the transformer, which will lead to serious deviation in metering. Therefore, it is necessary to improve the accuracy of current transformer under fault current. Based on discrete wavelet transform and random forest model, the influence of fault current on current transformer is studied and analyzed, and the correction of secondary side distortion current is realized, and the proposed method is simulated. The results show that the method is effective for the correction of secondary side distortion current of ferromagnetic transformer.

articleTitle: Cost Efficient Job Scheduling Scheme for Large Scale Data Center
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The world's shift to digital technology has made data centers (DCs) an essential part of the country's energy infrastructure. However, as data centers continue to expand at an accelerated pace, their energy consumption and operational expenses have increased significantly. To address this problem, based on the Decima model, this paper designs a cost efficient job scheduling scheme for large scale data center. By combining the graph neural network (GNN) used to characterize the complex characteristics of large-scale DAG jobs with the policy network for efficient decision-making, we propose a joint training end-to-end model in which the deadline feature is added to the job states as the user's quality of service feedback evaluation criteria, and train the model in the real-time market environment to achieve the purpose of perceiving the energy cost. Compared with the current prevalent industrial algorithms, we have demonstrated that the proposed algorithm effectively balances energy cost and quality of service under the real-time electricity price.

articleTitle: Value-at-Risk Measurement and Case Analysis of Electricity Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate and timely electricity consumption prediction results can not only provide calculation basis for power project investment, but also provide data support for optimal operation decision of power grid. Power demand shows different trends of change and development at different time stages, with complex changes, random occurrence and other characteristics. In order to predict the change of electricity consumption at different times, this paper uses VaR (Value-at-Risk) method to evaluate the electricity consumption at different times. VaR method is an important risk management method, which provides people with a comprehensive measurement of market risk and has been widely used. This paper first gives the relevant introduction of VaR; Then the Historical Simulation (HS) method and Extreme Value Theory (EVT) method are introduced; The VaR value of electricity consumption is calculated by these two methods, and the results are visualized and compared, and finally the effect of the two methods is evaluated.

articleTitle: Estimation of State-of-Health for Lithium-Ion Battery Based on Increment Capacity Analysis Method and Long Short-Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that it is difficult to accurately evaluate the health status of lithium-ion batteries, a capacity increment analysis method is proposed to extract the health characteristics of lithium batteries, and a lithium battery health estimation model is established based on LSTM. First, the capacity increment analysis method is used to calculate the battery charge and discharge data. Then, the battery health features are extracted from the calculation results, and the correlation between the health features and the battery health status is verified by correlation analysis. Then, based on the extracted health features, the LSTM model is introduced to estimate the health state of the battery. Finally, in the simulation analysis, by comparing with the estimation accuracy of the RNN method, it is verified that the proposed method has higher accuracy in the estimation of the state of health of lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Decentralized Model Predictive Voltage Control for Distributed Generation Clusters of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the extensive usage of distributed resources, the voltage fluctuations in the power system are frequent, and the distributed resources are scattered, which also increases the difficulty of unified management. A decentralized model predictive voltage control method for the power system based on the collaboration of clusters is proposed. The large-scale decentralized resources are aggregated into interrelated clusters, and the voltage control can be adjusted regionally. Firstly, because of the complex structure of the power system and the wide range of distributed power points, a power grid cluster division scheme based on the improved Louvain algorithm is designed. The modularity function is used and the voltage sensitivity of the cluster and the capacity of distributed power supply are taken into account. Secondly, because the power flow of the grid becomes more complex and variable after the access of distributed power supply, a decentralized model predictive control method is proposed based the division of clusters, which can cooperate with the regulation ability of each optical storage to suppress the voltage fluctuation of the power grid caused by the power fluctuation. Finally, a study case is given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Economic Optimization for Park Integrated Energy System Considering Multi-Network Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In the context of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality, improving energy efficiency and optimizing equipment operation are of great importance to reduce carbon emissions. Therefore, this paper proposes an integrated energy system model for industrial parks considering multi-network integration and introduces the stepped carbon trading mechanism into the model. This model combines electricity, heat, and gas networks to optimize economic dispatch and reduce carbon trading costs. To make the results more accurate, the model considers multi-network power flow constraints. Based on the framework, a low-carbon economic operation objective is constructed that minimizes the costs of energy procurement, equipment, and carbon emissions. The case simulations show that the model can reduce carbon emissions and optimize the dispatch of the carbon trading model.

articleTitle: An Aggregated Frequency Response Model for Power Systems with Renewables
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The continuous increase of renewable energy weakens the ability to maintain system frequency security, significantly changes system frequency response characteristics. This paper proposes an aggregated frequency response model considering renewable energy generation participation in the system frequency regulation. Firstly, virtual synchronous generators are assembled for renewable energy to simulate the inertia response and governor droop control of the synchronous generators. Then a multi-machine system frequency response model containing renewable energy is constructed and transformed into a single machine equivalent model for simplifying calculation using the equivalent aggregated method. Finally, the model proposed in this paper has been verified to be effective and accurate by using the IEEE 39-Bus system.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging Load Using Composite Quantile Regression LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the explosive development of electric vehicles (EVs), the impact on the operation and planning of low voltage distribution network has become more and more significant. Therefore, ordered charging control strategies of EVs are proposed, which require accurate EV charging load forecasting. Under this background, this paper carries out a probabilistic forecasting model combining composite quantile regression and LSTM neural network for EV charging load forecasting. Firstly, a composite long-short term memory (LSTM) neural network is built to obtain synchronously quantile forecasting. Secondly, kernel density estimation method is used to estimate probability density function. Finally, the performance of the proposed model is verified on real residential EV charging load data, with 97.92 % predicting interval coverage probability (PICP) at 90% confidence level, better than the comparison model.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for Doubly-Fed Induction Generator Considering Crowbar Activation Time
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: During a Low-Voltage Ride Through, it is typically beneficial to have a shorter activation time for the crowbar in order to provide reactive power to the grid sooner. In this study, we analyze the current when the crowbar is activated and deactivated. We then propose a method to determine the upper limit of resistance based on crowbar overcurrent. Simulation results are used to verify the relationship between crowbar resistance, turn-off delay, and the number of activations, supporting the feasibility of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Security and Stability Control Strategy Optimization for Power Grid Load Intensive Area Based on Real-Time Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the rapid growth of area industrial load and the lagging construction of main area power plants, a large amount of power has to be transmitted from the outside. After the fault trip of the double-line in the same corridor, security and stability control (SSC) measures have to be taken for stability of the load intensive area. In order to verify the correctness and reliability of the control strategy, this paper carried out the hardware-in-the-loop test of the SSC system based on the large power grid real-time simulation technology, and found that there was a serious voltage instability risk and the SSC system refusing to act in the area. Based on the mechanism analysis of voltage instability of induction motor, the voltage instability process of the load intensive area has been studied. Then, the SSC strategy has been optimized to eliminate the risk of the SSC system refusing to act. This case study shows that the real-time simulation technology based on large power grid has obvious advantages in the research of SSC strategy, especially in the research of power grid electromagnetic transient closed-loop response with the participation of SSC system.

Author Keywords: real time simulation of large power grid

articleTitle: Comparison of Structure and Control Strategy for Offshore Wind Power Integration Using HVDC
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Recently the development and utilization of large-scale offshore wind power is developing rapidly, and offshore wind power integration and transmission using HVDC have become technical hotspots. However, there are lacks in specific comparisons of the structures and control strategies for offshore wind power integration and transmission, which may lead to unreasonable design schemes and increasing engineering investment. Therefore, in this paper, three structures and control strategies for large-scale offshore wind power integration and transmission to load centers using LCC-HVDC and VSC-HVDC are proposed, and the comparison of the topological structures, control strategies and the behaviors under different conditions are analyzed as well. Dynamic simulation results based on PSCAD/EMTDC demonstrate the performance of three different schemes and the applicability conclusions based on different scenarios are given.

articleTitle: An Improved Maximum Power Point Tracking Method Under Partial Shading Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Since the photovoltaic characteristic curve of photovoltaic panels presents multi-peak characteristics under partial shading conditions (PSC), the maximum power point tracking (MPPT) method is used in the photovoltaic power generation system to track the photovoltaic maximum power point (MPP) under PSC. An improved method was proposed to track the global maximum power point (GMPP) of photovoltaic (PV) in this paper. According to the optimal voltage distribution discipline, the initial position of particle swarm particles is introduced to normal uniform distribution for enhancing the global optimization ability of the method. According to the number of particle swarm iterations, this method adjusts the particle swarm optimization (PSO) learning factor and inertia weight synchronously during the optimization process. Finally, the performance of proposed method under uniform irradiance condition (UIC) and PSC are verified in the simulation model. The results demonstrate that this method have a rapid tracking speed, low sampling rate and steady-state performance.

articleTitle: Multi-scenario Transmission Network Expansion Planning Considering Deep Peak Regulation Under Static Security Constrains
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the integration of renewable energy in new power system, it is necessary to consider multi-scenario to improve the robustness of the planning scheme, and to enable coal generators to have deep peak regulation capability with better flexibility. Thus, a multi-scenario model for wind and solar power is proposed. The Fuzzy C-means clustering algorithm is adopted to obtain typical scenarios. Based on that, a transmission network expansion planning model considering deep peak regulation is established in this paper. The cost model and operation model for deep peak regulation is built. The N-1 load shedding cost is considered in order to ensure static security. The model is solved by Benders decomposition algorithm. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated by HRP-38 system. It is shown that the model has better adaptability and is beneficial to improve the absorption capacity of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Analytical Model of the Impact of Carbon Market on Electricity Market Under Green and Low Carbon Goals
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: This paper addresses the relationship between the carbon market and the power market in terms of their mutual influence, and analyzes the impact of the carbon market on the generation cost of thermal power units by establishing an economic dispatch model of the power system considering the cost of carbon, which minimizes the total cost of the power system while satisfying the economic dispatch constraints, and then finds its influence on the outcome of the power market clearing. The results of the empirical application show that there is a significant increase in generation costs and a change in the structure of system generation with the participation of the carbon market.

articleTitle: Generalized Load Modeling of Compressed Air Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Compressed air energy storage (CAES) is a new type of energy storage technology, which can store electric energy on a large scale. In order to investigate the influence of CAES on the load characteristics of distribution network, a dynamic load model of CAES was established. Firstly, a CAES system suitable for power system analysis is established according to the operation principle. Secondly, the CAES mathematical model for load modeling is built. Thirdly, the operation characteristics of the unit under energy storage and power generation conditions and the transient characteristics under short circuit fault are analyzed. In addition, the ability of CAES to maintain the frequency stability of the grid is tested.

articleTitle: Online SoC Estimation for Lithium-Ion Batteries Based on the OCV Online Calculation and Coulomb Counting Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: State of charge (SoC) evaluation is one of the main responsibilities of battery management system. This article introduced a method for online calculation of battery open circuit voltage (OCV) through battery port voltage and current. The mathematical expression between OCV and port voltage and current was derived, and an online OCV solution method based on RLS was presented. Then, an online SoC estimation method combined the advantages of the coulomb counting (CC) method and the online OCV solution method is proposed. The implementation process of the proposed online SoC algorithm was introduced in detail, and its estimation accuracy and computational complexity were experimentally analyzed. The research results show that the accuracy of the proposed online SoC estimation algorithm is almost identical to that of the EKF method, and the computational complexity of the proposed algorithm is less than half that of the EKF method, indicating that the proposed method can be applied to online SoC estimation.

articleTitle: Multi-stage Pricing Strategy of Charging Station Based on EV Charging Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Electric vehicle charging station pricing plays a critical role in guiding user charging behavior. This paper proposes an optimal pricing strategy for charging stations based on load forecasting. Firstly, a method for load forecasting is presented to predict the charging station's future demand. Secondly, a machine learning-based evaluation method is proposed to assess the price sensitivity of electric vehicle charging demand. The proposed two-stage pricing strategy involves setting an invitation price for users based on the price sensitivity of electric vehicle charging demand model in the day-ahead stage and a guiding price for the intra-day stage. In the day-ahead stage, users are invited to charge their vehicles based on the predicted demand, taking into account the price sensitivity of electric vehicle charging demand. In the intra-day stage, the price is adjusted to guide user behavior and avoid charging station deviation costs. Simulation experiments demonstrate that the proposed two-stage pricing strategy effectively guides user charging behavior, reduces charging station deviation costs, and increases charging station revenue. The results show that this strategy is suitable for various load conditions and can be used to achieve optimal pricing under different scenarios.

articleTitle: Feature Dimensionality Reduction for Ultra-Short-Term Wind Power Forecasting Based on Global Surrogate Model
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Accurate ultra-short-term wind power forecasting is the key to balancing power supply and load demand, and to further improve its prediction accuracy, deep learning algorithms are often used for wind power forecasting that also considers the effects of spatial and temporal correlation. Deep learning is a black box model, which can be poorly interpreted for wind power forecasting, and because it uses data from multiple wind farms, the prediction model is not only large and complex but may also be unsolvable due to the “dimensional disaster”. To address the problem, a feature dimensionality reduction method for ultra-short-term wind power forecasting based on a global surrogate model is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the wind power forecasting model was constructed based on data-driven approach considering all wind farm characteristic variables, i.e., global variables. Then, a global surrogate model is constructed to replace the original model, and the surrogate model coefficients represent the contribution of the input features, based on which feature dimensionality reduction is performed. Results show that the secondary modeling after dimensionality reduction forms a more efficient wind power forecasting model. In comparison with PCA and FA dimensionality reduction methods, it is proved that the method proposed in this paper can achieve better prediction accuracy. The prediction model after feature dimensionality reduction decreases the model complexity and improves the computational efficiency to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on Cooperative Control Algorithm Based on Distributed Multi-Region Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, an OQL-SA (opposite Q learning-simulated annealing) cooperative control algorithm for distributed multi-region integrated energy systems is proposed from the perspective of automatic generation control. The proposed algorithm combines the SA algorithm with the OQL algorithm. The SA algorithm effectively avoids the damage of too much exploration on the process of learning algorithm and even the learning result, while the OQL algorithm improves the learning speed by updating two Q values at the same time. Through the simulation analysis of the multi-region load frequency control model based on the Southwest Power Grid, the results show that the proposed algorithm can obtain the multi-region optimal cooperative control, and has better control performance and faster convergence rate compared with other reinforcement learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Topology and Configuration Optimization of Wind-Solar-Hydrogen Combined System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Hydrogen energy storages play crucial roles in enhancing the consumption of renewable energy, reducing energy loss, and improving the comprehensive energy utilization rates. The installation of a wind-solar-hydrogen combined system, which includes wind turbines (WTs), photovoltaics (PV), and hydrogen energy storage, can effectively promote the application of renewable energy resources. The overall investment and operation cost are the primary factors that affect the promotion of the wind-solar-hydrogen combined system. This paper proposes a joint topology and configuration optimization method to address these challenges and minimize the overall cost. The topology optimization mainly focuses on the connection design between the medium voltage direct current (MVDC), medium voltage alternating current (MVAC), low voltage direct current (LVDC), and low voltage alternating cur-rent (LVAC) buses. The configuration optimization aims to optimize the installed capacity of WTs, PVs, and hydrogen energy storages in each bus. Case studies based on a certain renewable energy penetrated microgrid are carried out to validate the effectiveness of our method. Simulation results show that our methods can achieve the lowest overall cost.

articleTitle: Analysis of Small Disturbance Synchronization Stability of Grid-Connected Side of Energy Router Based on VSG
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As the core device of the energy internet, the energy router is related to the effective consumption of renewable energy and the safe and reliable operation of the power grid. Therefore, the energy router based on virtual synchronous generator (VSG) grid-connected control technology is gradually being applied. This technology provides virtual inertia and active support capability for the energy router by simulating the rotor equations of motion of synchronous generators. However, it may also cause low-frequency oscillation and endanger the safe operation of the power grid. To address this issue, the small-signal state-space equations of the energy router grid-connected VSG system are established in this paper. The mechanism of the main participating factors in the low-frequency oscillation modes of the system is analyzed, and measures to enhance the small disturbance synchronous stability of the energy router grid-connected VSG system are proposed.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Evaluation of Horizontal Axis Tidal Stream Turbines in San Bernardino Strait, Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: According to studies, the Philippines, an archipelagic country, has a large ocean renewable energy capability, with a total potential of 170 GW. This research looked at the energy potential, performance of horizontal axis tidal stream technology, and economics of turbines in the San Bernardino Strait. Results show a yearly average velocity of 1.28m/s in the study area. A map was also created to identify potential deployment sites based on certain exclusion criteria. The study analyzed three turbines: Seagen S, SR2000, and TiDEL. All turbines performed well in terms of energy generation, but TiDEL comes out on top due to its lower cut-in, rated speed requirements, LCOE, and electricity cost. The use of tidal energy modeling software will also aid in the optimization, energy prediction, and economic evaluation of various technologies in the area. Considering this, harnessing the potential of the San Bernardino Strait can assist the Philippines' National Renewable Energy Board in meeting its additional target capacity from ocean energy by 2030.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Optimal Dispatch of Power System with Pumped Storage Units Considering New Energy Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The uneven power output and geographically dislocated distribution due to the endowment of scenic resources are the most important problems facing the solution of new energy consumption at present. In order to improve the system capacity and operational reliability of new energy consumption, this paper proposes a multi-scale coordinated and optimal scheduling strategy for power systems with pumped storage units considering new energy uncertainty. Firstly, a day-ahead scheduling scheme is developed, and then the system prediction errors are further compensated by intra-day rolling and real-time corrections, and the constructed model can effectively improve the system capacity of new energy consumption.

articleTitle: Transformer Fault Detection Based on SSA-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The study of transformer defect detection is critical to the safe and dependable operation of the electrical system. This paper introduces the theory of neural networks and combines Salp swarm algorithm with BP neural network to enhance the performance of transformer fault detection, improve the accuracy and convergence rate of detection methods, and solve the main issues present in the practical application of transformer fault detection technology. A method based on BP neural network optimization using the Salp swarm algorithm is proposed in order to detect transformer defects during operation. The final simulation outcomes demonstrate that the enhanced method put forward in this research has strong global optimization capability, stability, and application value in detecting transformer faults.

articleTitle: A Medium and Long Term Load Forecasting Method Based on BP Neural Network and S-Shaped Curve Fitting
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The purpose of this article is to propose a medium to long-term load forecasting method based on BP neural network and S-curve fitting. This article first uses a knowledge graph to determine the factors that affect power load forecasting, and selects the key factors that affect load forecasting. Secondly, in order to compensate for the shortcomings of the BP neural network method for forecasting, the paper proposes a load forecasting method based on BP neural network and S-curve fitting. This method compensates for the uncertainty of the neural network prediction results and the low accuracy of S-curve fitting in predicting load development trends. Finally, the accuracy of this method for load forecasting was verified through simulation examples.

articleTitle: A Novel Non-isolated Bidirectional 48V-12V DCX Converter with Transformer-Coupled Gate Driver
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: In this paper, a novel non-isolated bidirectional DCX (NBDCX) converter is proposed. Compared with the conventional LLC-DCX converter, the NBDCX converter retains the original ZVS / ZCS soft-switching characteristics and has the advantages of smaller winding turns and higher efficiency, by connecting the primary and secondary sides of traditional LLC in series. Meanwhile, all switches in NBDCX converter have the same voltage and current stress, and the RMS currents in each winding of the transformer are also more balanced. Besides, a transformer-coupled gate driver is proposed for the NBDCX converter to reduce drive loss. Finally, the proposed converter is verified on a 150kHz NBDCX prototype with the highest efficiency of 96%.

articleTitle: Operation Mode and Economic Analysis of Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) can be regarded as a platform for aggregating a variety of resources including distributed generation systems, energy storage systems (ESS) and controllable loads. It can also provide electricity trading and auxiliary services in electricity market as resources aggregator. In China, VPP is in a rapid development stage, but its operation mode is not yet mature. This paper will propose a feasible VPP operation structure based on the experience from other regions and then analyze the economic performance through cases.

articleTitle: Chance-Constrained Scheduling for Wind-Hydrogen System with Bilateral Contract Decomposition, Day-Ahead Market Bidding and Hydrogen Production
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: As a clean energy, wind power is vital in the electricity and hydrogen (H2) markets. This study proposes a wind-hydrogen system (WHS) scheduling model to coordinate the decomposition of bilateral contract, bidding in the day-ahead energy market, and H2 production. Chance-constrained programming is used to deal with the uncertainty of wind power forecast errors in the WHS. The scheduling problem of the WHS is a mixed integer linear programming model. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed WHS scheduling model for multiple markets is verified by a case study. Moreover, a comparative analysis of the flexible and fixed bilateral contract decomposition showed that more profits could be obtained by coordinating bidding in the day-ahead market and H2 production.

articleTitle: A Control Strategy of Thermostatically Controlled Loads for Power System Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the higher proportion of renewable energy generation connected to the grid, the frequency stability of power system faces greater challenge. Utilizing demand response (DR) technology for frequency regulation has become a new and effective method. Among various kinds of demand side resources, there are some natural advantages for the thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs) due to their high proportion in the total load and capability of storing thermal energy, which makes short-term regulation will not affect the user's electricity consumption comfort. This paper takes inverter air-conditioners as typical TCLs to establish time-frequency domain model and evaluate the potentiality of TCLs for providing frequency regulation service. Then, the significance of TCLs participating in frequency regulation on the frequency stability of power system is analyzed by simulation. Finally, a hybrid control method considering user's electricity consumption comfort for large-scale TCLs participating in power system frequency regulation is proposed.

articleTitle: An Improved SD-Jaya Algorithm for Multi-Objective Edge Computing Problem in IRS-Aided Charging Electric Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Nowadays, the connection of electric vehicles (EVs) to the grid leads to significant load growth, which is a challenge for the safe and stable operation of the grid. In vehicle edge computing networks, as grid-charged EVs offloading tasks, offloading strategy optimization is a crucial method of reducing power purchase from the grid by EVs. Therefore, we first construct an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS)-aided task offloading networks for charging EVs, innovatively employing tethered UAVs (tUAVs) equipped with IRS to transmit the task. Communication efficiency can be improved by choosing single-IRS or double-IRS links. In addition, EV is equipped with the network in box (NIB) to provide flexible computing power. Subsequently, the multi-objective problem of minimizing transmission obstacle, power purchase cost, and transmission delay is formulated. However, finding the Pareto front for such a multi-objective optimization problem in this paper is challenging. An improved SD-Jaya algorithm is proposed to obtain the selection of policy operators through historical knowledge. The simulation results illustrate that the proposed algorithm can get better non-dominated solutions.

articleTitle: Security-constrained Fast Production Cost Minimization Simulation Based on Time Domain Partitioning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Production cost minimization (PCM) simulation has always played an important role in power system for long-term planning and assessment. However, some simplifications are always applied in PCM modeling in previous works, which makes the results significantly deviate from reality. Besides, due to the large scale of the PCM problem, it is time-consuming to solve. Therefore, this paper proposes a security constrained PCM simulation model considering the shift factor, and develops a fast solving method based on time domain partitioning. Simulation results on IEEE 118 bus system is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Wind Power Interval Prediction Based on CGAN and KELM under Extreme Weather Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
