abstract: As the proportion of wind power in grid continues to increase, more and more newly built or expanded wind farms are facing problems such as lack of historical samples and insufficient training of prediction models. With the increasing frequency of extreme weather events, most wind farms also face problems such as scarce samples of extreme weather scenarios and large power forecasting errors. In response to the above-mentioned issues, this paper proposes an wind power interval prediction method based on conditional generative adversarial networks (CGAN) and kernel extreme learning machines (KELM). With the historical samples of extreme weather scenarios, a large number of new samples are generated through CGAN. Based on KELM, an interval prediction model under extreme weather is constructed. Compared to point prediction, this model can provide richer probability information, and compared to other interval prediction methods, the results show an effective improvement in prediction performance.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on the Damage Mechanism of High-Frequency Partial Discharge of Multilayer PI Films under Repetitive Electrical Stress
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Partial discharge (PD)is an important factor leading to insulation degradation and failure of solid-state transformer (SST). To accurately evaluate the effect of voltage frequency on partial discharge characteristics under high-frequency sinusoidal waveforms, a high-frequency PD test system is designed. Considering the structural characteristics of the turn-to-turn insulation of SST, a three-layer polyimide (PI) laminated insulation model was designed, and PD tests on the samples at different frequencies were carried out using the pulse current method. This paper focuses specifically on the lifetime and discharge characteristics of the specimen, including maximum and average discharge amplitude, total number of discharges, and number of discharges per cycle or per second. Based on these data, the correlation law between voltage frequency and insulation lifetime was obtained, and the microstructure of damaged PI was also obtained, and the damage mechanism of PI at high-frequency was investigated. The results of the study provide a theoretical basis for the application of PI in electrical insulation.

articleTitle: Optimization of Ideal Transformer Interface Algorithm Based on Low-Pass Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Numerical-model hybrid simulation techniques are increasingly being applied to a variety of fields in power systems and power electronics. The interface of the hybrid simulation model is the key in the research of the hybrid simulation technology. The ideal transformer interface algorithm is the most widely used, and the current ideal transformer interface algorithm usually incorporates a low-pass filter in the physical side current return circuit, but the existing research only considers purely resistive or purely inductive networks, and for resistive-inductive networks, as well as nonlinear networks, the cutoff frequency of the low-pass filter is mostly selected by empirical values, and there is no reasonable theoretical guidance. In this paper, the cutoff frequency selection range of low-pass filter in the improved ideal transformer method is derived, and the low-pass filter cutoff frequency selection method is proposed to improve the interface stability by selecting the appropriate low-pass filter cutoff frequency. Verification is performed by simulation.

articleTitle: Innovative Exploration of Standard Digital Transformation in the Power Field: A New Mode of Blockchain Cooperation on and off the Chain
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of trust barriers for power users to traditional metering and payment services, an on-chain and off-chain collaborative model of power information collection integrating “standardization theory and blockchain technology” was proposed. In this paper, the standardization theory of “unification, combination and modularization” and blockchain technology are applied in the new power system electricity information collection scenarios, which can realize the security protection of power metering data source and transmission process, thus increasing the credibility of metering and payment data. Firstly, an on-chain and off-chain collaboration model is designed, including an off-chain procurement system model based on composition, an intermediate interactive interface model based on unification, and an on-chain blockchain system model based on modularization. Secondly, the typical application analysis of off-chain link, intermediate interactive interface link and on-chain link is carried out for the problem of on-chain trusted data. Aiming at the problem of off-chain data security, the terminal integration technology and distributed fusion authentication technology are proposed. Aiming at the problem of intermediate data transmission interface, two methods, API technology and intelligent contract technology, are proposed. A distributed transaction method is proposed to solve the blockchain transaction problem. Finally, the paper summarizes and prospects the whole paper.

articleTitle: Research on Source-Load Cooperative Scheduling Strategy Based on Probabilistic Distance Fast Reduction Method
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the increase of the proportion of renewable energy connected to the grid and the deepening of the coupling relationship of the energy system, the effect of the uncertainty of renewable energy and load prediction on the dispatching plan is becoming more and more prominent. To maximize the flexibility of renewable energy to the system, this article proposes a source-load-energy storage system cooperative scheduling strategy based on probabilistic distance rapid reduction method. First, the uncertain of photovoltaic power generation and wind power generation is processed by using scenario sampling generation and reduction technology, forming a classical scenario containing probabilistic information. Based on these scenarios, a joint scheduling model of power station with storing up energy and power system is established, and the nonlinear terms are processed equally by using big-M method. As can be obtained from the illustration that the subscriber daily operation prime cost will be greatly decreased after the participation of power station with storing up energy, and the accommodation rate of renewable energy will be significantly improved under a prerequisite to ensure the safe work of the electrified wire netting.

articleTitle: Power Supply Zonal Loads Prediction Considering Matching of Contact Line Characteristics Based on Deep Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To address the problems that the current power supply partitioning method relies heavily on the selection of load simultaneous rate parameters and does not consider the matching of inter-station contact lines, and the accuracy of the load learning prediction method still needs further improvement, a deep transfer learning prediction method for power supply partitioning considering the matching of contact line characteristics is proposed. Firstly, the overall technical framework of power supply partitioning and load prediction was constructed. Secondly, a model of power supply partitioning considering the matching characteristics of contact line loads was constructed and the corresponding solution method was proposed. On this basis, a partitioned load prediction method based on deep transfer learning and an integrated process of power supply partitioning and load prediction were proposed. Finally, the validity and applicability of the theoretical method proposed in this paper were verified through the simulation analysis of practical cases.

articleTitle: Fault Level Prediction Method for Urban Distribution Network Considering Class-Imbalance Problems
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: Urban Distribution network (UDN) fault diagnosis and risk warning are of great significance to the safe and stable operation of power system. At present, the class-imbalance problems greatly affect the accuracy of fault analysis and prediction in UDN. In this paper, a method of fault level prediction (FLP) based on improved natural breaks is proposed. The method of improved natural breaks is first introduced to achieve dynamic division of FLP and solve the class-imbalance problem of fault categories. Then, the precision and recall are selected as evaluation indicators for FLP. According to a certain area of UDN, the normal operation data and the fault simulation data are obtained and analyzed. Finally, the prediction results of different division methods under different data sets are compared. The results show that FLP method based on improved natural breaks can effectively improve the prediction precision and recall rates.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Hybrid Energy Storage Economy and Frequency Stability Considering Energy Storage Regulation Ability
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: With the emerging high penetrations of renewable energy in power systems, the percentage of conventional resources is shrinking, and the grid frequency regulations suffer from the subsequent challenges. In this work, a multi-objective optimization framework is formulated, considering both the frequency regulation requirement and economic feasibility, by utilizing the hybrid energy storage systems (HESS). The frequency regulation capability of energy storage systems (ESS) is also quantified based on the operational flexibility and adjustment ranges. The optimization problem is solved by using the Cplex with MATLAB. For case studies, the historical data from RegD of PJM regions in the United States is used. And the results verified that the proposed method can successfully improve the system frequency regulation and provide an economical friendly portfolio for ESS operators.

articleTitle: Study on the Decline of Voltage Blocking-Up Ability of High Power Thyristors
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: For the thyristor with reduced voltage blocking-up capacity in the HVDC transmission project, optical microscope observation, adhesion analysis, morphology analysis, Thermogravimetric Analysis and volume resistivity measurement were carried out. Compared with normal thyristor, the reason for the reduction of voltage blocking-up capacity was found out. The silicon rubber filler particles of the thyristor were precipitated, and more holes were formed, which indicated that the silicon rubber was aging and degraded. The volume resistivity of silicone rubber is reduced, which can not protect the thyristor chip. According to the research results, the follow-up operation and maintenance suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Interval Multi-Objective Optimization Combined with Deep Reinforcement Learning for Building Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: To fully tap and effectively use the potential of building energy conservation and emission reduction, a low-carbon optimization dispatch method for intelligent buildings based on deep reinforcement learning interval multi-objective optimization is proposed. Firstly, interval mathematics is used to model the multiple uncertainties in the system. Secondly, considering the system's carbon emissions and carbon transaction costs, optimize the system operation with the goal of the lowest comprehensive operating cost and the best user comfort. To solve the problem of interval multi-objective optimization, deep reinforcement learning (DQN) and interval multi-objective particle swarm optimization (IMOPSO) are proposed for “offline training” and “online guidance”. The low-carbon optimization scheduling problem of intelligent buildings under multiple uncertain factors is efficiently solved. The results of an example show that the proposed IMOPSO based on DQN can consider the system's low carbon, economical and user comfort, which effectively improves the system's ability to deal with multiple uncertain factors.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Tracking for Low Frequency Offshore Wind Farm Based on Wind Speed Prediction by Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The wind turbines in low-frequency offshore wind farms can achieve the goal of efficient utilization of wind energy by adjusting the low-frequency side frequency to change the operating status of the wind turbines. This article establishes a power-frequency model for wind farms by analyzing the operating characteristics of low-frequency wind farm. The frequency optimization algorithm is used to obtain the optimal operating frequency of the wind farm and achieve maximum power tracking of the wind farm. Convolutional neural network(CNN) is used for ultra-short-term prediction of offshore wind speed, thus a wind speed model is established for low-frequency wind farm. Then, through the analysis and verification of examples, the low-frequency wind farm can track the change of wind speed in real time to adjust the operating frequency, and then to realize the maximum power tracking of the wind farm.

articleTitle: The Thin Film Evaporation of R32/ R600 Mixture: A Molecular Dynamic Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The utilization of mixed refrigerants in thermodynamic cycles is expected to improve the efficiency of the system. In the present paper, the evaporation behavior of the equimolar mixture of R32 and R600 on the copper surface is investigated by molecular dynamics approaches. The results denote that the evaporation process of the mixed R32/R600 liquid film can be roughly divided into the slow evaporation stage, stable evaporation stage and equilibrium stage. The evaporation rate of both R32 and R600 is maintained at a constant value during the stable evaporation phase, with the value of R32 being higher than that of R600. Besides, the evaporation of R32 and R600 is not synchronous. R600 enters both the stable evaporation phase and the equilibrium phase later than R32, indicating that the heat transfer thermal resistance of R600 is higher than that of R32. Furthermore, the three-dimensional vapor-liquid interface structure is obtained during the evaporation of the mixed R32/R600 liquid film. It is noticed that the undulation of the interface structure is greatest during the stable evaporation phase, where the vapor-liquid interface area is greater.

articleTitle: Study on the Mould Formation Method of High Power Electric Fracturing Pump
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: High-power electric fracturing pumping units are currently commonly used in shale oil and gas fields. Their large capacity and high volatility significantly impact the voltage of the distribution network. This paper first develops a six-phase induction motor model for a 5500HP fracturing pump, followed by a 24-pulse wave rectification and NPC three-level inverter model based on a triangle extension connection. The developed model can prepare to respond to the electric fracturing pump behavior. On this basis, the IEEE-33 node distribution network is used to study the impact of the fracturing pump on the distribution network voltage after it is connected to the distribution network.

articleTitle: An Improved Sampled-Date-Based Distributed Event-Triggered Secondary Control in Islanded Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: At the microgrid secondary control level, distributed event triggering is widely studied to improve system efficiency, but the general event triggering schemes are continuous state domain. The majority of control algorithms used in current control systems, particularly system-level control algorithms, are implemented using digital controllers and digital communication in discrete time. For this reason, this paper proposes a event-triggered control strategy based on sampled data at the secondary control level for frequency recovery and power sharing in islanded microgrids. Unlike existing event-triggered control schemes, the control algorithm proposed in this paper is based on sampled data. Therefore, only at the instant of sample moment can an event be initiated or a controller updated, and the communication transfer between agents at each sampling time is no longer required, which reduces the communication and computation cost and effectively avoids Zeno behavior. Finally, a simulation model is built in MATLAB/Simulink environment to verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: A Study on Mechanical Durability of Insulating Materials for Dry-Type Transformers
publicationTitle: 2023 IEEE/IAS Industrial and Commercial Power System Asia (I&CPS Asia)
abstract: The winding of dry-type transformers is primarily cast with epoxy resin insulation material. During a short-circuit fault, the winding is subjected to a huge short-circuit electromagnetic force, which can cause changes in the insulation performance. This paper investigates the maximum stress of transformers under short-circuit impact based on simulation experiments, and explores the mechanical tolerance performance of epoxy resin insulation materials using this as a basis. Tensile tests have been carried out to demonstrate that the extreme short-circuit electromagnetic stress does not reach the tensile strength limit of epoxy resin insulation materials. Through fatigue testing, it was confirmed that a single short-circuit fault of short duration would not cause epoxy resin to fracture and fail. Furthermore, considering that a short-duration short-circuit impact fault does not result in insulation failure, the dielectric properties of epoxy resin before and after short-circuit impact fatigue degradation have been tested. By comparing the dielectric parameters of epoxy resin specimens before and after degradation, the evolution of electrical insulation performance characteristics caused by changes in the mechanical properties of insulation materials under the stress of dry-type transformer winding has been analyzed. The results show that under short-circuit electromagnetic stress, the complex capacitance and dielectric loss factor of the dielectric material change with the same trend as before degradation, and the maximum dielectric loss factor rises to 103.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> of the value before degradation. The insulation dielectric performance decreases, and this law can provide a reference for the assessment of the life expectancy of dry-type transformers.
